title: Genesis 21:21
text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran. And his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 21:22
text: ¶And it came to pass at that time that Abimelech, and Phichol the captain of his host, spoke to Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest.

title: Genesis 21:23
text: And now swear to me here by God that thou wilt not deal deceitfully with me, nor with my son, nor with my grandson. According to the kindness that I have done to thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land in which thou sojournest.

title: Genesis 21:24
text: And Abraham said, I will swear.

title: Genesis 21:25
text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water that Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

title: Genesis 21:26
text: And Abimelech said, I do not know who has done this, neither hast thou told me [of it], neither have I heard [of it] but to-day.

title: Genesis 21:27
text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them to Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

title: Genesis 21:28
text: And Abraham set seven ewe-lambs of the flock by themselves.

title: Genesis 21:29
text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What [mean] these seven ewe-lambs, these which thou hast set by themselves?

title: Genesis 21:30
text: And he said, That thou take the seven ewe-lambs of my hand, that they may be a witness to me that I have dug this well.

title: Genesis 21:31
text: Therefore he called that place Beer-sheba, because there they had sworn, both of them.

title: Genesis 21:32
text: And they made a covenant at Beer-sheba. And Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the captain of his host, and returned into the land of the Philistines.

title: Genesis 21:33
text: ¶And [Abraham] planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Jehovah, the Eternal *God.

title: Genesis 21:34
text: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

title: Genesis 22:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that God tried Abraham, and said to him, Abraham! and he said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 22:2
text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only [son], whom thou lovest, Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah, and there offer him up for a burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

title: Genesis 22:3
text: ¶And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he clave the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up and went to the place that God had told him of.

title: Genesis 22:4
text: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place from afar.

title: Genesis 22:5
text: And Abraham said to his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

title: Genesis 22:6
text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it on Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and the knife, and they went both of them together.

title: Genesis 22:7
text: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, My father! And he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood; but where is the sheep for a burnt-offering?

title: Genesis 22:8
text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself with the sheep for a burnt-offering. And they went both of them together.

title: Genesis 22:9
text: And they came to the place of which God had told him. And Abraham built the altar there, and piled the wood; and he bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

title: Genesis 22:10
text: And Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to slaughter his son.

title: Genesis 22:11
text: ¶And the Angel of Jehovah called to him from the heavens, and said, Abraham, Abraham! And he said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 22:12
text: And he said, Stretch not out thy hand against the lad, neither do anything to him; for now I know that thou fearest God, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son], from me.

title: Genesis 22:13
text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold, behind was a ram caught in the thicket by its horns; and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a burnt-offering instead of his son.

title: Genesis 22:14
text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh; as it is said at the present day, On the mount of Jehovah will be provided.

title: Genesis 22:15
text: ¶And the Angel of Jehovah called to Abraham from the heavens a second time,

title: Genesis 22:16
text: and said, By myself I swear, saith Jehovah, that, because thou hast done this, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son],

title: Genesis 22:17
text: I will richly bless thee, and greatly multiply thy seed, as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that is on the sea-shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

title: Genesis 22:18
text: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth bless themselves, because thou hast hearkened to my voice.

title: Genesis 22:19
text: And Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba. And Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 22:20
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she also has borne sons to thy brother Nahor:

title: Genesis 22:21
text: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

title: Genesis 22:22
text: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

title: Genesis 22:23
text: (And Bethuel begot Rebecca.) These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

title: Genesis 22:24
text: And his concubine, named Reumah, she also bore Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maacah.

title: Genesis 23:1
text: ¶And the life of Sarah was a hundred and twenty-seven years: [these were] the years of the life of Sarah.

title: Genesis 23:2
text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-Arba: that is Hebron, in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

title: Genesis 23:3
text: ¶And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,

title: Genesis 23:4
text: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you; give me a possession of a sepulchre with you, that I may bury my dead from before me.

title: Genesis 23:5
text: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

title: Genesis 23:6
text: Hear us, my lord: thou art a prince of God among us: in the choicest of our sepulchres bury thy dead: none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre for burying thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:7
text: And Abraham rose up, and bowed down to the people of the land, to the sons of Heth,

title: Genesis 23:8
text: and spoke to them, saying, If it be your will that I should bury my dead from before me, hear me, and entreat for me Ephron the son of Zohar,

title: Genesis 23:9
text: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which is his, which is at the end of his field; for the full money let him give it to me amongst you for a possession of a sepulchre.

title: Genesis 23:10
text: And Ephron was dwelling among the sons of Heth. And Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham, in the ears of the sons of Heth, [even] of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

title: Genesis 23:11
text: No, my lord: hear me. The field give I thee; and the cave that is in it, to thee I give it; before the eyes of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:12
text: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the land;

title: Genesis 23:13
text: and he spoke to Ephron, in the ears of the people of the land, saying, But if only thou wouldst listen to me, I give the money for the field: take [it] of me, and I will bury my dead there.

title: Genesis 23:14
text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

title: Genesis 23:15
text: My lord, hearken to me. A field of four hundred shekels of silver, what is that between me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

title: Genesis 23:16
text: ¶And Abraham hearkened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the money that he had named in the ears of the sons of Heth--four hundred shekels of silver, current with the merchant.

title: Genesis 23:17
text: So the field of Ephron, which was at Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave that was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all its borders round about,

title: Genesis 23:18
text: were assured to Abraham for a possession before the eyes of the sons of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

title: Genesis 23:19
text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field at Machpelah, opposite to Mamre: that is Hebron, in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 23:20
text: And the field and the cave that was in it were assured to Abraham for a possession of a sepulchre by the sons of Heth.

title: Genesis 24:1
text: ¶And Abraham was old, [and] advanced in age; and Jehovah had blessed Abraham in all things.

title: Genesis 24:2
text: And Abraham said to his servant, the eldest of his house, who ruled over all that he had, Put thy hand, I pray thee, under my thigh,

title: Genesis 24:3
text: and I will make thee swear by Jehovah, the God of the heavens and the God of the earth, that thou take not a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am dwelling;

title: Genesis 24:4
text: but thou shalt go to my land and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.

title: Genesis 24:5
text: And the servant said to him, Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land: must I, then, bring thy son again in any case to the land from which thou hast removed?

title: Genesis 24:6
text: And Abraham said to him, Beware that thou bring not my son thither again.

title: Genesis 24:7
text: Jehovah the God of the heavens, who took me out of my father's house, and out of the land of my nativity, and who has spoken to me, and who has sworn to me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land--he will send his angel before thee, that thou mayest take a wife for my son thence.

title: Genesis 24:8
text: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be quit of this my oath: only, bring not my son thither again.

title: Genesis 24:9
text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore unto him concerning that matter.

title: Genesis 24:10
text: ¶And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; now all the treasure of his master was under his hand; and he arose and went to Aram-naharaim, to the city of Nahor.

title: Genesis 24:11
text: And he made the camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water, at the time of the evening, when the women came out to draw [water].

title: Genesis 24:12
text: And he said, Jehovah, God of my master Abraham, meet me, I pray thee, [with thy blessing] this day, and deal kindly with my master Abraham.

title: Genesis 24:13
text: Behold, I stand [here] by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.

title: Genesis 24:14
text: And let it come to pass, [that] the maiden to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink, and who will say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also, be she whom thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and hereby I shall know that thou hast dealt kindly with my master.

title: Genesis 24:15
text: And it came to pass before he had ended speaking, that behold, Rebecca came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother; and [she had] her pitcher upon her shoulder.

title: Genesis 24:16
text: And the maiden was very fair in countenance; a virgin, and no man had known her. And she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

title: Genesis 24:17
text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, sip a little water out of thy pitcher.

title: Genesis 24:18
text: And she said, Drink, my lord! And she hasted and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him to drink.

title: Genesis 24:19
text: And when she had given him enough to drink, she said, I will draw [water] for thy camels also, until they have drunk enough.

title: Genesis 24:20
text: And she hasted and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw [water]; and she drew for all his camels.

title: Genesis 24:21
text: And the man was astonished at her, remaining silent, to know whether Jehovah had made his journey prosperous or not.

title: Genesis 24:22
text: And it came to pass when the camels had drunk enough, that the man took a gold ring, of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands, ten [shekels] weight of gold,

title: Genesis 24:23
text: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee. Is there room [in] thy father's house for us to lodge?

title: Genesis 24:24
text: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.

title: Genesis 24:25
text: And she said to him, There is straw, and also much provender with us; also room to lodge.

title: Genesis 24:26
text: And the man stooped, and bowed down before Jehovah,

title: Genesis 24:27
text: and said, Blessed be Jehovah, God of my master Abraham, who has not withdrawn his loving-kindness and his faithfulness from my master; I being in the way, Jehovah has led me to the house of my master's brethren.

title: Genesis 24:28
text: And the maiden ran and told these things to her mother's house.

title: Genesis 24:29
text: ¶And Rebecca had a brother, named Laban; and Laban ran out to the man, to the well.

title: Genesis 24:30
text: And it came to pass when he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sister's hand, and when he heard the words of Rebecca his sister, saying, Thus spoke the man to me--that he came to the man, and behold, he was standing by the camels, by the well.

title: Genesis 24:31
text: And he said, Come in, blessed of Jehovah! why standest thou outside? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

title: Genesis 24:32
text: And the man came into the house; and he ungirded the camels, and gave the camels straw and provender, and water to wash his feet, and the feet of the men who were with him.

title: Genesis 24:33
text: And there was set [meat] before him to eat; but he said, I will not eat until I have made known my business. And he said, Speak on.

title: Genesis 24:34
text: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

title: Genesis 24:35
text: And Jehovah has blessed my master greatly, and he is become great; and he has given him sheep and cattle, and silver and gold, and bondmen and bondwomen, and camels and asses.

title: Genesis 24:36
text: And Sarah, my master's wife, bore a son to my master after she had grown old; and unto him has he given all that he has.

title: Genesis 24:37
text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanite, in whose land I am dwelling;

title: Genesis 24:38
text: but thou shalt by all means go to my father's house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.

title: Genesis 24:39
text: And I said to my master, Perhaps the woman will not follow me?

title: Genesis 24:40
text: And he said to me, Jehovah, before whom I have walked, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way, that thou mayest take a wife for my son of my family, and out of my father's house.

title: Genesis 24:41
text: Then shalt thou be quit of my oath, when thou shalt have come to my family. And if they give thee not [one], thou shalt be quit of my oath.

title: Genesis 24:42
text: And I came this day to the well, and said, Jehovah, God of my master Abraham, if now thou wilt prosper my way on which I go,

title: Genesis 24:43
text: behold, I stand by the well of water, and let it come to pass that the damsel who cometh forth to draw [water], and to whom I shall say, Give me, I pray thee, a little water out of thy pitcher to drink,

title: Genesis 24:44
text: and she shall say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels--that she should be the woman whom Jehovah hath appointed for my master's son.

title: Genesis 24:45
text: Before I ended speaking in my heart, behold, Rebecca came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder, and went down to the well, and drew [water]; and I said to her, Give me, I pray thee, to drink.

title: Genesis 24:46
text: And she hasted and let down her pitcher from her [shoulder], and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. And I drank; and she gave the camels drink also.

title: Genesis 24:47
text: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him. And I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

title: Genesis 24:48
text: And I stooped, and bowed down before Jehovah; and I blessed Jehovah, God of my master Abraham, who has led me the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.

title: Genesis 24:49
text: And now, if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me; and if not, tell me; and I will turn to the right hand or to the left.

title: Genesis 24:50
text: And Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceeds from Jehovah: we cannot speak to thee bad or good.

title: Genesis 24:51
text: Behold, Rebecca is before thee: take [her], and go away; and let her be wife of thy master's son, as Jehovah has said.

title: Genesis 24:52
text: And it came to pass, when Abraham's servant heard their words, that he bowed down to the earth before Jehovah.

title: Genesis 24:53
text: And the servant brought forth silver articles, and gold articles, and clothing, and he gave [them] to Rebecca; and he gave to her brother, and to her mother, precious things.

title: Genesis 24:54
text: ¶And they ate and drank, he and the men that were with him, and lodged. And they rose up in the morning; and he said, Send me away to my master.

title: Genesis 24:55
text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the maiden abide with us [some] days, or [say] ten; after that she shall go.

title: Genesis 24:56
text: And he said to them, Do not hinder me, seeing Jehovah has prospered my way: send me away, and I will go to my master.

title: Genesis 24:57
text: And they said, Let us call the maiden and inquire at her mouth.

title: Genesis 24:58
text: And they called Rebecca and said to her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

title: Genesis 24:59
text: And they sent away Rebecca their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

title: Genesis 24:60
text: And they blessed Rebecca, and said to her, Thou art our sister; mayest thou become thousands of tens of thousands; and may thy seed possess the gate of their enemies!

title: Genesis 24:61
text: And Rebecca arose, and her maids, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man. And the servant took Rebecca, and went away.

title: Genesis 24:62
text: ¶And Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi; for he was dwelling in the south country.

title: Genesis 24:63
text: And Isaac had gone out to meditate in the fields toward the beginning of evening. And he lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, camels were coming.

title: Genesis 24:64
text: And Rebecca lifted up her eyes and saw Isaac, and she sprang off the camel.

title: Genesis 24:65
text: And she had said to the servant, Who is the man that is walking in the fields to meet us? And the servant said, That is my master! Then she took the veil, and covered herself.

title: Genesis 24:66
text: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

title: Genesis 24:67
text: And Isaac led her into his mother Sarah's tent; and he took Rebecca, and she became his wife, and he loved her. And Isaac was comforted after [the death of] his mother.

title: Genesis 25:1
text: ¶And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

title: Genesis 25:2
text: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

title: Genesis 25:3
text: And Jokshan begot Sheba and Dedan; and the sons of Dedan were the Asshurim, and the Letushim, and the Leummim.

title: Genesis 25:4
text: And the sons of Midian were Ephah, and Epher, and Enoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were sons of Keturah.

title: Genesis 25:5
text: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

title: Genesis 25:6
text: And to the sons of the concubines that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and, while he yet lived, sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward to the east country.

title: Genesis 25:7
text: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived: a hundred and seventy-five years.

title: Genesis 25:8
text: And Abraham expired and died in a good old age, old and full [of days]; and was gathered to his peoples.

title: Genesis 25:9
text: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which was opposite to Mamre--

title: Genesis 25:10
text: the field that Abraham had purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

title: Genesis 25:11
text: ¶And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac dwelt at Beer-lahai-roi.

title: Genesis 25:12
text: And these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's bondwoman, bore to Abraham.

title: Genesis 25:13
text: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their names according to their generations: Nebaioth, the firstborn of Ishmael; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

title: Genesis 25:14
text: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

title: Genesis 25:15
text: Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedmah.

title: Genesis 25:16
text: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, in their hamlets and their encampments--twelve princes of their peoples.

title: Genesis 25:17
text: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael: a hundred and thirty-seven years; and he expired and died, and was gathered to his peoples.

title: Genesis 25:18
text: And they dwelt from Havilah to Shur, which is opposite to Egypt, as one goes towards Assyria. He settled before the face of all his brethren.

title: Genesis 25:19
text: ¶And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham begot Isaac.

title: Genesis 25:20
text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebecca as wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.

title: Genesis 25:21
text: And Isaac entreated Jehovah for his wife, because she was barren; and Jehovah was entreated of him, and Rebecca his wife conceived.

title: Genesis 25:22
text: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If [it be] so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 25:23
text: And Jehovah said to her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels; And one people shall be stronger than the other people, And the elder shall serve the younger.

title: Genesis 25:24
text: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

title: Genesis 25:25
text: And the first came out red--all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

title: Genesis 25:26
text: And after that came his brother out; and his hand took hold of Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when they were born.

title: Genesis 25:27
text: And the boys grew, and Esau became a man skilled in hunting, a man of the field; and Jacob was a homely man, dwelling in tents.

title: Genesis 25:28
text: And Isaac loved Esau, because venison was to his taste; and Rebecca loved Jacob.

title: Genesis 25:29
text: ¶And Jacob had cooked a dish; and Esau came from the field, and he was faint.

title: Genesis 25:30
text: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with the red--the red thing there, for I am faint. Therefore was his name called Edom.

title: Genesis 25:31
text: And Jacob said, Sell me now thy birthright.

title: Genesis 25:32
text: And Esau said, Behold, I am going to die, and of what use can the birthright be to me?

title: Genesis 25:33
text: And Jacob said, Swear unto me now. And he swore unto him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.

title: Genesis 25:34
text: And Jacob gave Esau bread and the dish of lentils; and he ate and drank, and rose up and went away. Thus Esau despised the birthright.

title: Genesis 26:1
text: ¶And there was a famine in the land, besides the former famine which had been in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech the king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

title: Genesis 26:2
text: And Jehovah appeared to him and said, Go not down to Egypt: dwell in the land that I shall tell thee of.

title: Genesis 26:3
text: Sojourn in this land; and I will be with thee and bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries; and I will perform the oath which I swore unto Abraham thy father.

title: Genesis 26:4
text: And I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and unto thy seed will I give all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth bless themselves--

title: Genesis 26:5
text: because that Abraham hearkened to my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

title: Genesis 26:6
text: ¶And Isaac dwelt at Gerar.

title: Genesis 26:7
text: And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, She is my sister; for he feared to say, my wife, [saying to himself,] Lest the men of the place slay me on account of Rebecca--because she was fair in countenance.

title: Genesis 26:8
text: And it came to pass when he had been there some time, that Abimelech the king of the Philistines looked out of the window, and saw, and behold, Isaac was dallying with Rebecca his wife.

title: Genesis 26:9
text: Then Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, she is certainly thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? and Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I die on account of her.

title: Genesis 26:10
text: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done to us? But a little and one of the people might have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought a trespass on us.

title: Genesis 26:11
text: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that touches this man or his wife shall certainly be put to death.

title: Genesis 26:12
text: ¶And Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year a hundredfold; and Jehovah blessed him.

title: Genesis 26:13
text: And the man became great, and he became continually greater, until he was very great.

title: Genesis 26:14
text: And he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great number of servants; and the Philistines envied him.

title: Genesis 26:15
text: And all the wells that his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines stopped them and filled them with earth.

title: Genesis 26:16
text: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go from us; for thou art become much mightier than we.

title: Genesis 26:17
text: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his camp in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

title: Genesis 26:18
text: And Isaac dug again the wells of water that they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, and that the Philistines had stopped after the death of Abraham; and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

title: Genesis 26:19
text: And Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

title: Genesis 26:20
text: But the shepherds of Gerar strove with Isaac's shepherds, saying, The water is ours. And he called the name of the well Esek, because they had quarrelled with him.

title: Genesis 26:21
text: And they dug another well, and they strove for that also; and he called the name of it Sitnah.

title: Genesis 26:22
text: And he removed thence and dug another well; and they did not strive for that. And he called the name of it Rehoboth, and said, For now Jehovah has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

title: Genesis 26:23
text: And he went up thence to Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 26:24
text: And Jehovah appeared to him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

title: Genesis 26:25
text: And he built an altar there, and called upon the name of Jehovah. And he pitched his tent there; and there Isaac's servants dug a well.

title: Genesis 26:26
text: ¶And Abimelech, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phichol the captain of his host, went to him from Gerar.

title: Genesis 26:27
text: And Isaac said to them, Why are ye come to me, seeing ye hate me, and have driven me away from you?

title: Genesis 26:28
text: And they said, We saw certainly that Jehovah is with thee; and we said, Let there be then an oath between us--between us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee,

title: Genesis 26:29
text: that thou wilt do us no wrong, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done to thee nothing but good, and have let thee go in peace; thou art now blessed of Jehovah.

title: Genesis 26:30
text: And he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

title: Genesis 26:31
text: And they rose early in the morning, and swore one to another; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

title: Genesis 26:32
text: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well that they had dug, and said to him, We have found water.

title: Genesis 26:33
text: And he called it Shebah; therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba to this day.

title: Genesis 26:34
text: ¶And Esau was forty years old, when he took as wives Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basmath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

title: Genesis 26:35
text: And they were a grief of mind to Isaac and to Rebecca.

title: Genesis 27:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Isaac had become old, and his eyes were dim so that he could not see, that he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, My son! And he said to him, Here am I.

title: Genesis 27:2
text: And he said, Behold now, I am become old; I know not the day of my death.

title: Genesis 27:3
text: And now, I pray thee, take thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field and hunt me venison,

title: Genesis 27:4
text: and prepare me a savoury dish such as I love, and bring it to me that I may eat, in order that my soul may bless thee before I die.

title: Genesis 27:5
text: And Rebecca heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt venison, to bring it.

title: Genesis 27:6
text: ¶And Rebecca spoke to Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak to Esau thy brother, saying,

title: Genesis 27:7
text: Bring me venison, and prepare me a savoury dish, that I may eat, and bless thee before Jehovah, before my death.

title: Genesis 27:8
text: And now, my son, hearken to my voice in that which I command thee.

title: Genesis 27:9
text: Go, I pray thee, to the flock, and fetch me thence two good kids of the goats. And I will make of them a savoury dish for thy father, such as he loves.

title: Genesis 27:10
text: And thou shalt bring [it] to thy father, that he may eat, in order that he may bless thee before his death.

title: Genesis 27:11
text: And Jacob said to Rebecca his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

title: Genesis 27:12
text: My father perhaps will feel me, and I shall be in his sight as one who mocks [him], and I shall bring a curse on me, and not a blessing.

title: Genesis 27:13
text: And his mother said to him, On me [be] thy curse, my son! Only hearken to my voice, and go, fetch [them].

title: Genesis 27:14
text: And he went, and fetched and brought [them] to his mother. And his mother prepared a savoury dish such as his father loved.

title: Genesis 27:15
text: And Rebecca took the clothes of her elder son Esau, the costly ones which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son;

title: Genesis 27:16
text: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck;

title: Genesis 27:17
text: and she gave the savoury dishes and the bread that she had prepared into the hand of her son Jacob.

title: Genesis 27:18
text: ¶And he came to his father, and said, My father! And he said, Here am I: who art thou, my son?

title: Genesis 27:19
text: And Jacob said to his father, I am Esau, thy firstborn. I have done according as thou didst say to me. Arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, in order that thy soul may bless me.

title: Genesis 27:20
text: And Isaac said to his son, How is it that thou hast found [it] so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Jehovah thy God put [it] in my way.

title: Genesis 27:21
text: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be really my son Esau or not.

title: Genesis 27:22
text: And Jacob drew near to Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

title: Genesis 27:23
text: And he did not discern him, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands; and he blessed him.

title: Genesis 27:24
text: And he said, Art thou really my son Esau? And he said, It is I.

title: Genesis 27:25
text: And he said, Bring [it] near to me, that I may eat of my son's venison, in order that my soul may bless thee. And he brought [it] near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.

title: Genesis 27:26
text: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near, now, and kiss me, my son.

title: Genesis 27:27
text: And he came near, and kissed him. And he smelt the smell of his clothes, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Jehovah hath blessed.

title: Genesis 27:28
text: And God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of corn and new wine.

title: Genesis 27:29
text: Let peoples serve thee, And races bow down to thee. Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee. Cursed be they that curse thee, And blessed be they that bless thee.

title: Genesis 27:30
text: ¶And it came to pass when Isaac had ended blessing Jacob, and when Jacob was only just gone out from Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came from his hunting.

title: Genesis 27:31
text: And he also had prepared savoury dishes, and he brought [them] in to his father, and said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's venison, in order that thy soul may bless me.

title: Genesis 27:32
text: And Isaac his father said to him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn, Esau.

title: Genesis 27:33
text: Then Isaac trembled with exceeding great trembling, and said, Who was he, then, that hunted venison and brought [it] to me? And I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him; also blessed he shall be.

title: Genesis 27:34
text: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said to his father, Bless me--me also, my father!

title: Genesis 27:35
text: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and has taken away thy blessing.

title: Genesis 27:36
text: And he said, Is it not therefore he was named Jacob, for he has supplanted me now twice? He took away my birthright, and behold, now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

title: Genesis 27:37
text: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, Behold, I have made him lord over thee, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants, and with corn and new wine have I supplied him--and what can I do now for thee, my son?

title: Genesis 27:38
text: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou then but one blessing, my father? bless me--me also, my father! And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

title: Genesis 27:39
text: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above;

title: Genesis 27:40
text: And by thy sword shalt thou live; And thou shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass when thou rovest about, That thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

title: Genesis 27:41
text: ¶And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him. And Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand, and I will slay my brother Jacob.

title: Genesis 27:42
text: And the words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebecca. And she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, comforts himself that he will kill thee.

title: Genesis 27:43
text: And now, my son, hearken to my voice, and arise, flee to Laban my brother, to Haran;

title: Genesis 27:44
text: and abide with him some days, until thy brother's fury turn away--

title: Genesis 27:45
text: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget what thou hast done to him; then I will send and fetch thee thence. Why should I be bereaved even of you both in one day?

title: Genesis 27:46
text: And Rebecca said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good should my life do me?

title: Genesis 28:1
text: ¶And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

title: Genesis 28:2
text: Arise, go to Padan-Aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father, and take a wife thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

title: Genesis 28:3
text: And the Almighty *God bless thee, and make thee fruitful and multiply thee, that thou mayest become a company of peoples.

title: Genesis 28:4
text: And may he give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee and to thy seed with thee, in order that thou mayest possess the land of thy sojourning, which God gave to Abraham!

title: Genesis 28:5
text: And Isaac sent away Jacob; and he went to Padan-Aram, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

title: Genesis 28:6
text: ¶And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-Aram, to take a wife thence, blessing him, and giving him a charge saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

title: Genesis 28:7
text: and [that] Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-Aram.

title: Genesis 28:8
text: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were evil in the sight of Isaac his father.

title: Genesis 28:9
text: And Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

title: Genesis 28:10
text: ¶And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went towards Haran.

title: Genesis 28:11
text: And he lighted on a certain place, and lodged there, because the sun had set. And he took [one] of the stones of the place, and made [it] his pillow, and lay down in that place.

title: Genesis 28:12
text: And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to the heavens. And behold, angels of God ascended and descended upon it.

title: Genesis 28:13
text: And behold, Jehovah stood above it. And he said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham, thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.

title: Genesis 28:14
text: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Genesis 28:15
text: And behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all [places] to which thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee until I have done what I have spoken to thee of.

title: Genesis 28:16
text: ¶And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, Surely Jehovah is in this place, and I knew [it] not.

title: Genesis 28:17
text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

title: Genesis 28:18
text: And Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had made his pillow, and set it up [for] a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

title: Genesis 28:19
text: And he called the name of that place Beth-el; but the name of that city was Luz at the first.

title: Genesis 28:20
text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and keep me on this road that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and a garment to put on,

title: Genesis 28:21
text: and I come again to my father's house in peace--then shall Jehovah be my God.

title: Genesis 28:22
text: And this stone, which I have set up [for] a pillar, shall be God's house; and of all that thou wilt give me I will without fail give the tenth to thee.

title: Genesis 29:1
text: ¶And Jacob continued his journey, and went into the land of the children of the east.

title: Genesis 29:2
text: And he looked, and behold, there was a well in the fields, and behold there, three flocks of sheep were lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks, and a great stone was at the mouth of the well.

title: Genesis 29:3
text: And when all the flocks were gathered there, they rolled the stone from the mouth of the well, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again on the mouth of the well in its place.

title: Genesis 29:4
text: And Jacob said to them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

title: Genesis 29:5
text: And he said to them, Do ye know Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We do know [him].

title: Genesis 29:6
text: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, [He is] well; and behold, there comes Rachel his daughter with the sheep.

title: Genesis 29:7
text: And he said, Behold, it is yet high day; it is not time that the cattle should be gathered together; water the sheep, and go, feed [them].

title: Genesis 29:8
text: And they said, We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the mouth of the well, and we water the sheep.

title: Genesis 29:9
text: ¶While he was still speaking to them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she was a shepherdess.

title: Genesis 29:10
text: And it came to pass when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the mouth of the well, and watered the sheep of Laban his mother's brother.

title: Genesis 29:11
text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice and wept.

title: Genesis 29:12
text: And Jacob told Rachel that he was a brother of her father, and that he was Rebecca's son; and she ran and told her father.

title: Genesis 29:13
text: And it came to pass when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house; and he told Laban all these things.

title: Genesis 29:14
text: And Laban said to him, Thou art indeed my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him a month's time.

title: Genesis 29:15
text: ¶And Laban said to Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou serve me for nothing? tell me, what shall be thy wages?

title: Genesis 29:16
text: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger, Rachel.

title: Genesis 29:17
text: And the eyes of Leah were tender; but Rachel was of beautiful form and beautiful countenance.

title: Genesis 29:18
text: And Jacob loved Rachel, and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

title: Genesis 29:19
text: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

title: Genesis 29:20
text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they were in his eyes as single days, because he loved her.

title: Genesis 29:21
text: And Jacob said to Laban, Give [me] my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.

title: Genesis 29:22
text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

title: Genesis 29:23
text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in to her.

title: Genesis 29:24
text: And Laban gave to her Zilpah, his maidservant, to be maidservant to Leah his daughter.

title: Genesis 29:25
text: And it came to pass in the morning, that behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done to me? Have I not served thee for Rachel? Why then hast thou deceived me?

title: Genesis 29:26
text: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

title: Genesis 29:27
text: Fulfil the week [with] this one: then we will give thee the other one also, for the service that thou shalt serve me yet seven other years.

title: Genesis 29:28
text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled the week [with] this one, and he gave him Rachel his daughter to be his wife.

title: Genesis 29:29
text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, Bilhah, his maidservant, to be her maidservant.

title: Genesis 29:30
text: And he went in also to Rachel; and he loved also Rachel more than Leah. And he served with him yet seven other years.

title: Genesis 29:31
text: ¶And when Jehovah saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.

title: Genesis 29:32
text: And Leah conceived, and bore a son, and called his name Reuben; for she said, Because Jehovah has looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.

title: Genesis 29:33
text: And she again conceived, and bore a son, and said, Because Jehovah has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this one also; and she called his name Simeon.

title: Genesis 29:34
text: And she again conceived, and bore a son, and said, Now this time will my husband be united to me, for I have borne him three sons; therefore was his name called Levi.

title: Genesis 29:35
text: And she again conceived, and bore a son, and said, This time will I praise Jehovah; therefore she called his name Judah. And she ceased to bear.

title: Genesis 30:1
text: ¶And when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister, and said to Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

title: Genesis 30:2
text: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel, and he said, Am I in God's stead, who has withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

title: Genesis 30:3
text: And she said, Behold, there is my maid, Bilhah: go in to her, in order that she may bear on my knees, and I may also be built up by her.

title: Genesis 30:4
text: And she gave him Bilhah her maidservant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

title: Genesis 30:5
text: And Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

title: Genesis 30:6
text: And Rachel said, God has done me justice, and has also heard my voice, and given me a son; therefore she called his name Dan.

title: Genesis 30:7
text: And Bilhah Rachel's maidservant again conceived, and bore Jacob a second son.

title: Genesis 30:8
text: And Rachel said, Wrestlings of God have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed; and she called his name Naphtali.

title: Genesis 30:9
text: And when Leah saw that she had ceased to bear, she took Zilpah her maidservant and gave her to Jacob as wife.

title: Genesis 30:10
text: And Zilpah Leah's maidservant bore Jacob a son.

title: Genesis 30:11
text: And Leah said, Fortunately! and she called his name Gad.

title: Genesis 30:12
text: And Zilpah Leah's maidservant bore Jacob a second son.

title: Genesis 30:13
text: And Leah said, Happy am I; for the daughters will call me blessed! and she called his name Asher.

title: Genesis 30:14
text: ¶And Reuben went out in the days of wheat-harvest, and found mandrakes in the fields; and he brought them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

title: Genesis 30:15
text: And she said to her, Is it [too] little that thou hast taken my husband, that thou wilt take my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.

title: Genesis 30:16
text: And when Jacob came from the fields in the evening, Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in to me, for indeed I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

title: Genesis 30:17
text: And God hearkened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

title: Genesis 30:18
text: And Leah said, God has given me my hire, because I have given my maidservant to my husband; and she called his name Issachar.

title: Genesis 30:19
text: And Leah again conceived, and bore Jacob a sixth son;

title: Genesis 30:20
text: and Leah said, God has endowed me with a good dowry; this time will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons. And she called his name Zebulun.

title: Genesis 30:21
text: And afterwards she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

title: Genesis 30:22
text: And God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

title: Genesis 30:23
text: And she conceived, and bore a son, and said, God has taken away my reproach.

title: Genesis 30:24
text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, Jehovah will add to me another son.

title: Genesis 30:25
text: ¶And it came to pass when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, Send me away, that I may go to my place and to my country.

title: Genesis 30:26
text: Give [me] my wives for whom I have served thee, and my children; that I may go away, for thou knowest my service which I have served thee.

title: Genesis 30:27
text: And Laban said to him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes--I have discovered that Jehovah has blessed me for thy sake.

title: Genesis 30:28
text: And he said, Appoint to me thy wages, and I will give it.

title: Genesis 30:29
text: And he said to him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and what thy cattle has become with me.

title: Genesis 30:30
text: For it was little that thou hadst before me, and it is increased to a multitude, and Jehovah has blessed thee from the time I came; and now, when shall I also provide for my house?

title: Genesis 30:31
text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me anything. If thou doest this for me, I will again feed [and] keep thy flock:

title: Genesis 30:32
text: I will pass through all thy flock to-day, to remove thence all the speckled and spotted sheep, and all the brown lambs, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and [that] shall be my hire.

title: Genesis 30:33
text: And my righteousness shall answer for me hereafter, when thou comest about my hire, before thy face: all that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the lambs, let that be stolen with me.

title: Genesis 30:34
text: And Laban said, Well, let it be according to thy word.

title: Genesis 30:35
text: And he removed that day the he-goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the brown among the lambs, and gave [them] into the hand of his sons.

title: Genesis 30:36
text: And he put three days' journey between himself and Jacob. And Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flock.

title: Genesis 30:37
text: ¶And Jacob took fresh rods of white poplar, almond-tree, and maple; and peeled off white stripes in them, uncovering the white which was on the rods.

title: Genesis 30:38
text: And he set the rods which he had peeled before the flock, in the troughs at the watering-places where the flock came to drink, and they were ardent when they came to drink.

title: Genesis 30:39
text: And the flock was ardent before the rods; and the flock brought forth ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

title: Genesis 30:40
text: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flock toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he made himself separate flocks, and did not put them with Laban's flock.

title: Genesis 30:41
text: And it came to pass whensoever the strong cattle were ardent, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might become ardent among the rods;

title: Genesis 30:42
text: but when the sheep were feeble, he put [them] not in; so the feeble were Laban's, and the strong Jacob's.

title: Genesis 30:43
text: And the man increased very, very much, and had much cattle, and bondwomen, and bondmen, and camels, and asses.

title: Genesis 31:1
text: ¶And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that was our father's, and of what was our father's he has acquired all this glory.

title: Genesis 31:2
text: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and behold, it was not toward him as previously.

title: Genesis 31:3
text: And Jehovah said to Jacob, Return into the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

title: Genesis 31:4
text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the fields to his flock,

title: Genesis 31:5
text: and said to them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as previously; but the God of my father has been with me.

title: Genesis 31:6
text: And you know that with all my power I have served your father.

title: Genesis 31:7
text: And your father has mocked me, and has changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

title: Genesis 31:8
text: If he said thus; The speckled shall be thy hire, then all the flocks bore speckled; and if he said thus: The ringstraked shall be thy hire, then all the flocks bore ringstraked.

title: Genesis 31:9
text: And God has taken away the cattle of your father, and given [them] to me.

title: Genesis 31:10
text: And it came to pass at the time of the ardour of the flocks, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams that leaped upon the flocks were ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

title: Genesis 31:11
text: And the Angel of God said to me in a dream, Jacob! And I said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 31:12
text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see: all the rams that leap upon the flock are ringstraked, speckled, and spotted; for I have seen all that Laban does to thee.

title: Genesis 31:13
text: I am the *God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, where thou vowedst a vow to me. Now arise, depart out of this land, and return to the land of thy kindred.

title: Genesis 31:14
text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

title: Genesis 31:15
text: Are we not reckoned of him strangers? for he has sold us, and has even constantly devoured our money.

title: Genesis 31:16
text: For all the wealth that God has taken from our father is ours and our children's; and now whatever God has said to thee do.

title: Genesis 31:17
text: ¶And Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels,

title: Genesis 31:18
text: and carried away all his cattle, and all his property that he had acquired--the cattle of his possessions that he had acquired in Padan-Aram, to go to Isaac his father, into the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 31:19
text: And Laban had gone to shear his sheep. And Rachel stole the teraphim that [belonged] to her father.

title: Genesis 31:20
text: And Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he fled.

title: Genesis 31:21
text: And he fled with all that he had; and he rose up and passed over the river, and set his face [toward] mount Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:22
text: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.

title: Genesis 31:23
text: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey, and overtook him on mount Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:24
text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, Take care thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

title: Genesis 31:25
text: ¶And Laban came up with Jacob; and Jacob had pitched his tent on the mountain; Laban also with his brethren pitched on mount Gilead.

title: Genesis 31:26
text: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast deceived me, and hast carried away my daughters as captives of war?

title: Genesis 31:27
text: Why didst thou flee away covertly, and steal away from me, and didst not tell me, that I might have conducted thee with mirth and with songs, with tambour and with harp;

title: Genesis 31:28
text: and hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now thou hast acted foolishly.

title: Genesis 31:29
text: It would be in the power of my hand to do you hurt; but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, Take care that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

title: Genesis 31:30
text: And now that thou must needs be gone, because thou greatly longedst after thy father's house, why hast thou stolen my gods?

title: Genesis 31:31
text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, I was afraid; for I said, Lest thou shouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

title: Genesis 31:32
text: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live. Before our brethren discern what is thine with me, and take [it] to thee. But Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

title: Genesis 31:33
text: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two handmaids' tents, and found nothing; and he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

title: Genesis 31:34
text: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim and put them under the camel's saddle; and she sat upon them. And Laban explored all the tent, but found nothing.

title: Genesis 31:35
text: And she said to her father, Let it not be an occasion of anger in the eyes of my lord that I cannot rise up before thee, for it is with me after the manner of women. And he searched carefully, but did not find the teraphim.

title: Genesis 31:36
text: ¶And Jacob was angry, and he disputed with Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my fault, what my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

title: Genesis 31:37
text: Whereas thou hast explored all my baggage, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set [it] here before my brethren and thy brethren, and let them decide between us both.

title: Genesis 31:38
text: These twenty years have I been with thee: thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock I have not eaten.

title: Genesis 31:39
text: What was torn I have not brought to thee; I had to bear the loss of it: of my hand hast thou required it, [whether] stolen by day or stolen by night.

title: Genesis 31:40
text: Thus it was with me: in the day the heat consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.

title: Genesis 31:41
text: I have been these twenty years in thy house: I have served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock; and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

title: Genesis 31:42
text: Had not the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, been with me, it is certain thou wouldest have sent me away now empty. God has looked upon my affliction and the labour of my hands, and has judged last night.

title: Genesis 31:43
text: ¶And Laban answered and said to Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the sons are my sons, and the flock is my flock, and all that thou seest is mine; but as for my daughters, what can I do this day to them, or to their sons whom they have brought forth?

title: Genesis 31:44
text: And now, come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be a witness between me and thee.

title: Genesis 31:45
text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up [for] a pillar.

title: Genesis 31:46
text: And Jacob said to his brethren, Gather stones. And they took stones, and made a heap, and ate there upon the heap.

title: Genesis 31:47
text: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

title: Genesis 31:48
text: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed,

title: Genesis 31:49
text: --and Mizpah; for he said, Let Jehovah watch between me and thee, when we shall be hidden one from another:

title: Genesis 31:50
text: if thou shouldest afflict my daughters, or if thou shouldest take wives besides my daughters, --no man is with us; see, God is witness between me and thee!

title: Genesis 31:51
text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar which I have set up between me and thee:

title: Genesis 31:52
text: [let] this heap be witness, and the pillar a witness, that neither I pass this heap [to go] to thee, nor thou pass this heap and this pillar [to come] to me, for harm.

title: Genesis 31:53
text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us! And Jacob swore by the fear of his father Isaac.

title: Genesis 31:54
text: And Jacob offered a sacrifice upon the mountain, and invited his brethren to eat bread: and they ate bread, and lodged on the mountain.

title: Genesis 31:55
text: And Laban rose early in the morning, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them; and Laban went and returned to his place.

title: Genesis 32:1
text: ¶And Jacob went on his way; and the angels of God met him.

title: Genesis 32:2
text: And when Jacob saw them he said, This is the camp of God. And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

title: Genesis 32:3
text: ¶And Jacob sent messengers before his face to Esau his brother, into the land of Seir, the fields of Edom.

title: Genesis 32:4
text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak to my lord, to Esau: Thy servant Jacob speaks thus--With Laban have I sojourned and tarried until now;

title: Genesis 32:5
text: and I have oxen, and asses, sheep, and bondmen, and bondwomen; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favour in thine eyes.

title: Genesis 32:6
text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother, to Esau; and he also is coming to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

title: Genesis 32:7
text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid, and was distressed; and he divided the people that were with him, and the sheep and the cattle and the camels, into two troops.

title: Genesis 32:8
text: And he said, If Esau come to the one troop and smite it, then the other troop which is left shall escape.

title: Genesis 32:9
text: ¶And Jacob said, God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Jehovah, who saidst unto me: Return into thy country and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good,

title: Genesis 32:10
text: --I am too small for all the loving-kindness and all the faithfulness that thou hast shewn unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan, and now I am become two troops.

title: Genesis 32:11
text: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, [and] the mother with the children.

title: Genesis 32:12
text: And thou saidst, I will certainly deal well with thee, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

title: Genesis 32:13
text: ¶And he lodged there that night; and took of what came to his hand a gift for Esau his brother--

title: Genesis 32:14
text: two hundred she-goats, and twenty he-goats; two hundred ewes, and twenty rams;

title: Genesis 32:15
text: thirty milch camels with their colts; forty kine, and ten bulls; twenty she-asses, and ten young asses.

title: Genesis 32:16
text: And he delivered [them] into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself; and he said to his servants, Go on before me, and put a space between drove and drove.

title: Genesis 32:17
text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meets thee, and asks thee, saying, Whose art thou, and where goest thou, and whose are these before thee?

title: Genesis 32:18
text: --then thou shalt say, Thy servant Jacob's: it is a gift sent to my lord, to Esau. And behold, he also is behind us.

title: Genesis 32:19
text: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, According to this word shall ye speak to Esau when ye find him.

title: Genesis 32:20
text: And, moreover, ye shall say, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will propitiate him with the gift that goes before me, and afterwards I will see his face: perhaps he will accept me.

title: Genesis 32:21
text: And the gift went over before him; and he himself lodged that night in the camp.

title: Genesis 32:22
text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok;

title: Genesis 32:23
text: and he took them and led them over the river, and led over what he had.

title: Genesis 32:24
text: ¶And Jacob remained alone; and a man wrestled with him until the rising of the dawn.

title: Genesis 32:25
text: And when he saw that he did not prevail against him, he touched the joint of his thigh; and the joint of Jacob's thigh was dislocated as he wrestled with him.

title: Genesis 32:26
text: And he said, Let me go, for the dawn ariseth. And he said, I will not let thee go except thou bless me.

title: Genesis 32:27
text: And he said to him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

title: Genesis 32:28
text: And he said, Thy name shall not henceforth be called Jacob, but Israel; for thou hast wrestled with God, and with men, and hast prevailed.

title: Genesis 32:29
text: And Jacob asked and said, Tell [me], I pray thee, thy name. And he said, How is it that thou askest after my name? And he blessed him there.

title: Genesis 32:30
text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel--For I have seen God face to face, and my life has been preserved.

title: Genesis 32:31
text: And as he passed over Peniel, the sun rose upon him; and he limped upon his hip.

title: Genesis 32:32
text: Therefore the children of Israel do not eat of the sinew that is over the joint of the thigh, to this day; because he touched the joint of Jacob's thigh--the sinew.

title: Genesis 33:1
text: ¶And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. And he distributed the children to Leah, and to Rachel, and to the two maidservants:

title: Genesis 33:2
text: and he put the maidservants and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindmost.

title: Genesis 33:3
text: And he passed on before them, and bowed to the earth seven times, until he came near to his brother.

title: Genesis 33:4
text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they wept.

title: Genesis 33:5
text: ¶And he lifted up his eyes and saw the women and the children, and said, Who are these with thee? And he said, The children that God has graciously given thy servant.

title: Genesis 33:6
text: And the maidservants drew near, they and their children, and they bowed.

title: Genesis 33:7
text: And Leah also, with her children, drew near, and they bowed. And lastly Joseph drew near, and Rachel, and they bowed.

title: Genesis 33:8
text: And he said, What [meanest] thou by all the drove which I met? And he said, To find favour in the eyes of my lord.

title: Genesis 33:9
text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let what thou hast be thine.

title: Genesis 33:10
text: And Jacob said, No, I pray thee; if now I have found favour in thine eyes, then receive my gift from my hand; for therefore have I seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou hast received me with pleasure.

title: Genesis 33:11
text: Take, I pray thee, my blessing which has been brought to thee; because God has been gracious to me, and because I have everything. And he urged him, and he took [it].

title: Genesis 33:12
text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and go on, and I will go before thee.

title: Genesis 33:13
text: And he said to him, My lord knows that the children are tender, and the suckling sheep and kine are with me; and if they should overdrive them only one day, all the flock would die.

title: Genesis 33:14
text: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass on before his servant, and I will drive on at my ease according to the pace of the cattle that is before me, and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord, to Seir.

title: Genesis 33:15
text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee [some] of the people that are with me. And he said, What need? Let me find favour in the eyes of my lord.

title: Genesis 33:16
text: ¶And Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

title: Genesis 33:17
text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built himself a house, and for his cattle he made booths. Therefore the name of the place was called Succoth.

title: Genesis 33:18
text: And Jacob came safely [to the] city Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-Aram; and he encamped before the city.

title: Genesis 33:19
text: And he bought the portion of the field where he had spread his tent, of the hand of the sons of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred kesitahs.

title: Genesis 33:20
text: And there he set up an altar, and called it El-Elohe-Israel.

title: Genesis 34:1
text: ¶And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

title: Genesis 34:2
text: And when Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.

title: Genesis 34:3
text: And his soul fastened on Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the maiden, and spoke consolingly to the maiden.

title: Genesis 34:4
text: And Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, Take me this girl as wife.

title: Genesis 34:5
text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; but his sons were with his cattle in the fields, and Jacob said nothing until they came.

title: Genesis 34:6
text: ¶And Hamor the father of Shechem came out to Jacob, to speak to him.

title: Genesis 34:7
text: And the sons of Jacob came from the fields when they heard [it]; and the men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had wrought what was disgraceful in Israel, in lying with Jacob's daughter, which thing ought not to be done.

title: Genesis 34:8
text: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, My son Shechem's soul cleaves to your daughter: I pray you, give her to him as wife.

title: Genesis 34:9
text: And make marriages with us: give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to you.

title: Genesis 34:10
text: And dwell with us, and the land shall be before you: dwell and trade in it, and get yourselves possessions in it.

title: Genesis 34:11
text: And Shechem said to her father and to her brethren, Let me find favour in your eyes; and what ye shall say to me I will give.

title: Genesis 34:12
text: Impose on me very much as dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say to me; but give me the maiden as wife.

title: Genesis 34:13
text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and spoke--because he had defiled Dinah their sister--

title: Genesis 34:14
text: and said to them, We cannot do this, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that [were] a reproach to us.

title: Genesis 34:15
text: But only in this will we consent to you, if ye will be as we, that every male of you be circumcised;

title: Genesis 34:16
text: then will we give our daughters to you, and take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and be one people.

title: Genesis 34:17
text: But if ye do not hearken to us, to be circumcised, then will we take our daughter and go away.

title: Genesis 34:18
text: ¶And their words were good in the eyes of Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.

title: Genesis 34:19
text: And the youth did not delay to do this, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter. And he was honourable above all in the house of his father.

title: Genesis 34:20
text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke to the men of their city, saying,

title: Genesis 34:21
text: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade in it. And the land--behold, it is of wide extent before them. We will take their daughters as wives, and give them our daughters.

title: Genesis 34:22
text: But only in this will the men consent to us to dwell with us, to be one people--if every male among us be circumcised, just as they are circumcised.

title: Genesis 34:23
text: Their cattle, and their possessions, and every beast of theirs, shall they not be ours? only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us.

title: Genesis 34:24
text: And all that went out at the gate of his city hearkened to Hamor and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised--all that went out at the gate of his city.

title: Genesis 34:25
text: ¶And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

title: Genesis 34:26
text: And Hamor and Shechem his son they slew with the edge of the sword; and took Dinah out of Shechem's house; and went out.

title: Genesis 34:27
text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

title: Genesis 34:28
text: Their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and what [was] in the city, and what [was] in the field they took;

title: Genesis 34:29
text: and all their goods, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and plundered them, and all that was in the houses.

title: Genesis 34:30
text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me, in that ye make me odious among the inhabitants of the land--among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and I am few men in number, and they will gather themselves against me and smite me, and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

title: Genesis 34:31
text: And they said, Should people deal with our sister as with a harlot?

title: Genesis 35:1
text: ¶And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there, and make there an altar unto the *God that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

title: Genesis 35:2
text: And Jacob said to his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and cleanse yourselves, and change your garments;

title: Genesis 35:3
text: and we will arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar to the *God that answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way that I went.

title: Genesis 35:4
text: And they gave to Jacob all the strange gods that were in their hand, and the rings that were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the terebinth that [is] by Shechem.

title: Genesis 35:5
text: And they journeyed; and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

title: Genesis 35:6
text: ¶And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

title: Genesis 35:7
text: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God had appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.

title: Genesis 35:8
text: And Deborah, Rebecca's nurse, died; and she was buried beneath Bethel, under the oak; and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

title: Genesis 35:9
text: And God appeared to Jacob again after he had come from Padan-Aram, and blessed him.

title: Genesis 35:10
text: And God said to him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not henceforth be called Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name. And he called his name Israel.

title: Genesis 35:11
text: And God said to him, I am the Almighty *God: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee; and kings shall come out of thy loins.

title: Genesis 35:12
text: And the land that I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

title: Genesis 35:13
text: And God went up from him in the place where he had talked with him.

title: Genesis 35:14
text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had talked with him, a pillar of stone, and poured on it a drink-offering, and poured oil on it.

title: Genesis 35:15
text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God had talked with him, Beth-el.

title: Genesis 35:16
text: ¶And they journeyed from Bethel. And there was yet a certain distance to come to Ephrath, when Rachel travailed in childbirth; and it went hard with her in her childbearing.

title: Genesis 35:17
text: And it came to pass when it went hard with her in her childbearing, that the midwife said to her, Fear not; for this also is a son for thee.

title: Genesis 35:18
text: And it came to pass as her soul was departing--for she died--that she called his name Benoni; but his father called him Benjamin.

title: Genesis 35:19
text: And Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath, which [is] Bethlehem.

title: Genesis 35:20
text: And Jacob erected a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave to [this] day.

title: Genesis 35:21
text: ¶And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent on the other side of Migdal-Eder.

title: Genesis 35:22
text: And it came to pass when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine; and Israel heard of it. And the sons of Jacob were twelve.

title: Genesis 35:23
text: The sons of Leah: Reuben--Jacob's firstborn--and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun.

title: Genesis 35:24
text: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

title: Genesis 35:25
text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant: Dan and Naphtali.

title: Genesis 35:26
text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's maidservant: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob that were born to him in Padan-Aram.

title: Genesis 35:27
text: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre--to Kirjath-Arba, which is Hebron; where Abraham had sojourned, and Isaac.

title: Genesis 35:28
text: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.

title: Genesis 35:29
text: And Isaac expired and died, and was gathered to his peoples, old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

title: Genesis 36:1
text: ¶And these are the generations of Esau, that is Edom.

title: Genesis 36:2
text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

title: Genesis 36:3
text: and Basmath Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.

title: Genesis 36:4
text: And Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz; and Basmath bore Reuel.

title: Genesis 36:5
text: And Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jaalam and Korah. These are the sons of Esau that were born to him in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 36:6
