text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went into a country away from his brother Jacob.

title: Genesis 36:7
text: For their property was too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they were sojourners could not bear them, because of their cattle.

title: Genesis 36:8
text: Thus Esau dwelt in mount Seir; Esau is Edom.

title: Genesis 36:9
text: ¶And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom, in mount Seir.

title: Genesis 36:10
text: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah the wife of Esau; Reuel, the son of Basmath the wife of Esau.

title: Genesis 36:11
text: --And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

title: Genesis 36:12
text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:13
text: --And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These are the sons of Basmath Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:14
text: --And these are the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bore to Esau Jeush and Jaalam and Korah.

title: Genesis 36:15
text: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

title: Genesis 36:16
text: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

title: Genesis 36:17
text: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basmath Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:18
text: --And these are the sons of Oholibamah Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jaalam, chief Korah; these are the chiefs of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:19
text: These are the sons of Esau, and these their chiefs: he is Edom.

title: Genesis 36:20
text: ¶These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitant of the land: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

title: Genesis 36:21
text: and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.

title: Genesis 36:22
text: --And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

title: Genesis 36:23
text: --And these are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

title: Genesis 36:24
text: --And these are the sons of Zibeon: both Ajah and Anah. This is the Anah that found the warm springs in the wilderness as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

title: Genesis 36:25
text: --And these are the sons of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.

title: Genesis 36:26
text: --And these are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

title: Genesis 36:27
text: --These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

title: Genesis 36:28
text: --These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

title: Genesis 36:29
text: These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

title: Genesis 36:30
text: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

title: Genesis 36:31
text: ¶And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before there reigned a king over the children of Israel.

title: Genesis 36:32
text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

title: Genesis 36:33
text: And Bela died; and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:34
text: And Jobab died; and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:35
text: And Husham died; and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the fields of Moab, reigned in his stead. And the name of his city was Avith.

title: Genesis 36:36
text: And Hadad died; and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:37
text: And Samlah died; and Saul of Rehoboth on the river reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:38
text: And Saul died; and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

title: Genesis 36:39
text: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died; and Hadar reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.

title: Genesis 36:40
text: And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, after their places, with their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

title: Genesis 36:41
text: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

title: Genesis 36:42
text: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

title: Genesis 36:43
text: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling-places in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of Edom.

title: Genesis 37:1
text: ¶And Jacob dwelt in the land where his father sojourned--in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 37:2
text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, fed the flock with his brethren; and he was doing service with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought to his father an evil report of them.

title: Genesis 37:3
text: And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was son of his old age; and he made him a vest of many colours.

title: Genesis 37:4
text: And his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, and they hated him, and could not greet him with friendliness.

title: Genesis 37:5
text: ¶And Joseph dreamed a dream, and told [it] to his brethren, and they hated him yet the more.

title: Genesis 37:6
text: And he said to them, Hear, I pray you, this dream, which I have dreamt:

title: Genesis 37:7
text: Behold, we were binding sheaves in the fields, and lo, my sheaf rose up, and remained standing; and behold, your sheaves came round about and bowed down to my sheaf.

title: Genesis 37:8
text: And his brethren said to him, Wilt thou indeed be a king over us? wilt thou indeed rule over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams and for his words.

title: Genesis 37:9
text: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamt another dream, and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.

title: Genesis 37:10
text: And he told [it] to his father and to his brethren. And his father rebuked him, and said to him, What is this dream which thou hast dreamt? Shall we indeed come, I and thy mother and thy brethren, to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

title: Genesis 37:11
text: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying.

title: Genesis 37:12
text: ¶And his brethren went to feed their father's flock at Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:13
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed [the flock] at Shechem? Come, that I may send thee to them. And he said to him, Here am I.

title: Genesis 37:14
text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see after the welfare of thy brethren, and after the welfare of the flock; and bring me word again. And he sent him out of the vale of Hebron; and he came towards Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:15
text: And a man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the country; and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

title: Genesis 37:16
text: And he said, I am seeking my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed [their flocks].

title: Genesis 37:17
text: And the man said, They have removed from this; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them at Dothan.

title: Genesis 37:18
text: And when they saw him from afar, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to put him to death.

title: Genesis 37:19
text: And they said one to another, Behold, there comes that dreamer!

title: Genesis 37:20
text: And now come and let us kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, An evil beast has devoured him; and we will see what becomes of his dreams.

title: Genesis 37:21
text: And Reuben heard [it], and delivered him out of their hand, and said, Let us not take his life.

title: Genesis 37:22
text: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood: cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness; but lay no hand upon him--in order that he might deliver him out of their hand, to bring him to his father again.

title: Genesis 37:23
text: ¶And it came to pass when Joseph came to his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his vest, the vest of many colours, which he had on;

title: Genesis 37:24
text: and they took him and cast him into the pit; now the pit was empty--there was no water in it.

title: Genesis 37:25
text: And they sat down to eat bread; and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites came from Gilead; and their camels bore tragacanth, and balsam, and ladanum--going to carry [it] down to Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:26
text: And Judah said to his brethren, What profit is it that we kill our brother and secrete his blood?

title: Genesis 37:27
text: Come and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites; but let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brethren hearkened [to him].

title: Genesis 37:28
text: And Midianitish men, merchants, passed by; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty silver-pieces; and they brought Joseph to Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:29
text: And Reuben returned to the pit, and behold, Joseph [was] not in the pit; and he rent his garments,

title: Genesis 37:30
text: and returned to his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, where shall I go?

title: Genesis 37:31
text: ¶And they took Joseph's vest, and slaughtered a buck of the goats, and dipped the vest in the blood;

title: Genesis 37:32
text: and they sent the vest of many colours and had it carried to their father, and said, This have we found: discern now whether it is thy son's vest or not.

title: Genesis 37:33
text: And he discerned it, and said, [It is] my son's vest! an evil beast has devoured him: Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces!

title: Genesis 37:34
text: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth on his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

title: Genesis 37:35
text: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted, and said, For I will go down to my son into Sheol mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

title: Genesis 37:36
text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt, to Potiphar, a chamberlain of Pharaoh, the captain of the life-guard.

title: Genesis 38:1
text: ¶And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a man of Adullam whose name was Hirah.

title: Genesis 38:2
text: And Judah saw there the daughter of a Canaanitish man whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in to her.

title: Genesis 38:3
text: And she conceived and bore a son; and he called his name Er.

title: Genesis 38:4
text: And she again conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.

title: Genesis 38:5
text: And again she bore a son, and she called his name Shelah; and he was at Chezib when she bore him.

title: Genesis 38:6
text: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

title: Genesis 38:7
text: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah, and Jehovah slew him.

title: Genesis 38:8
text: Then Judah said to Onan, Go in to thy brother's wife, and fulfil to her the brother-in-law's duty, and raise up seed to thy brother.

title: Genesis 38:9
text: But when Onan knew that the seed should not be his own, it came to pass when he went in to his brother's wife, that he spilled [it] on the ground, in order to give no seed to his brother.

title: Genesis 38:10
text: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and he slew him also.

title: Genesis 38:11
text: And Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in thy father's house, until Shelah my son is grown; for he said, Lest he die also, as his brethren. And Tamar went and remained in her father's house.

title: Genesis 38:12
text: ¶And as the days were multiplied, Judah's wife, the daughter of Shua, died. And Judah was comforted, and he went up to his sheep-shearers, to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

title: Genesis 38:13
text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

title: Genesis 38:14
text: And she put the garments of her widowhood off from her, and covered herself with a veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the entry of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given to him as wife.

title: Genesis 38:15
text: And Judah saw her, and took her for a harlot; because she had covered her face.

title: Genesis 38:16
text: And he turned aside to her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me go in to thee; for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in to me?

title: Genesis 38:17
text: And he said, I will send [thee] a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give [me] a pledge, until thou send it?

title: Genesis 38:18
text: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy lace, and thy staff which is in thy hand. And he gave [it] her, and went in to her; and she conceived by him.

title: Genesis 38:19
text: And she arose and went away; and she laid by her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

title: Genesis 38:20
text: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand; but he found her not.

title: Genesis 38:21
text: And he asked the men of her place, saying, Where is the prostitute that was at Enaim, by the way-side? And they said, There was no prostitute here.

title: Genesis 38:22
text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, No prostitute has been here.

title: Genesis 38:23
text: Then Judah said, Let her take [it] for herself, lest we be put to shame. Behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

title: Genesis 38:24
text: ¶And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter-in-law has committed fornication, and behold, she is also with child by fornication. And Judah said, Bring her forth, that she may be burned.

title: Genesis 38:25
text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man to whom these [belong] am I with child; and she said, Acknowledge, I pray thee, whose are this signet, and this lace, and this staff.

title: Genesis 38:26
text: And Judah acknowledged [them], and said, She is more righteous than I, because I have not given her to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

title: Genesis 38:27
text: And it came to pass at the time of her delivery, that behold, twins were in her womb.

title: Genesis 38:28
text: And it came to pass when she brought forth, that one stretched out [his] hand, and the midwife took it and bound round his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

title: Genesis 38:29
text: And it came to pass as he drew back his hand, that behold, his brother came out; and she said, How hast thou broken forth! on thee be the breach! And they called his name Pherez.

title: Genesis 38:30
text: And afterwards came out his brother, round whose hand was the scarlet thread; and they called his name Zerah.

title: Genesis 39:1
text: ¶And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, a chamberlain of Pharaoh, the captain of the life-guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites who had brought him down thither.

title: Genesis 39:2
text: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

title: Genesis 39:3
text: And his master saw that Jehovah was with him, and that Jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

title: Genesis 39:4
text: And Joseph found favour in his eyes, and attended on him; and he set him over his house, and all that he had he gave into his hand.

title: Genesis 39:5
text: And it came to pass from the time he had set him over his house and all that he had, that Jehovah blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of Jehovah was on all that he had in the house and in the field.

title: Genesis 39:6
text: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand, and took cognizance of nothing with him, save the bread that he ate. And Joseph was of a beautiful form and of a beautiful countenance.

title: Genesis 39:7
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes on Joseph, and said, Lie with me!

title: Genesis 39:8
text: But he refused, and said to his master's wife, Behold, my master takes cognizance of nothing with me: what is in the house, and all that he has, he has given into my hand.

title: Genesis 39:9
text: There is none greater in this house than I; neither has he withheld anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife; and how should I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

title: Genesis 39:10
text: And it came to pass as she spoke to Joseph day by day and he hearkened not to her, to lie with her [and] to be with her,

title: Genesis 39:11
text: that on a certain day he went into the house to do his business, and there was none of the men of the house there in the house.

title: Genesis 39:12
text: Then she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me! But he left his garment in her hand, and fled and ran out.

title: Genesis 39:13
text: ¶And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled forth,

title: Genesis 39:14
text: that she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, See, he has brought in a Hebrew man to us, to mock us: he came in to me, to lie with me; and I cried with a loud voice;

title: Genesis 39:15
text: and it came to pass when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled and went out.

title: Genesis 39:16
text: And she laid his garment by her until his lord came home.

title: Genesis 39:17
text: And she spoke to him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew bondman that thou hast brought to us came in to me to mock me;

title: Genesis 39:18
text: and it came to pass as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled forth.

title: Genesis 39:19
text: ¶And it came to pass when his lord heard the words of his wife which she spoke to him, saying, After this manner did thy bondman to me, that his wrath was kindled.

title: Genesis 39:20
text: And Joseph's lord took him and put him into the tower-house, [the] place where the king's prisoners were confined; and he was there in the tower-house.

title: Genesis 39:21
text: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and extended mercy to him, and gave him favour in the eyes of the chief of the tower-house.

title: Genesis 39:22
text: And the chief of the tower-house committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the tower-house; and whatever they had to do there he did.

title: Genesis 39:23
text: The chief of the tower-house looked not to anything under his hand, because Jehovah was with him; and what he did, Jehovah made it prosper.

title: Genesis 40:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, [that] the cup-bearer of the king of Egypt and the baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.

title: Genesis 40:2
text: And Pharaoh was wroth with his two chamberlains--with the chief of the cup-bearers and with the chief of the bakers;

title: Genesis 40:3
text: and he put them in custody into the house of the captain of the life-guard, into the tower-house, into the place where Joseph was imprisoned.

title: Genesis 40:4
text: And the captain of the life-guard appointed Joseph to them, that he should attend on them. And they were [several] days in custody.

title: Genesis 40:5
text: ¶And they dreamed a dream, both of them in one night, each his dream, each according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup-bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were imprisoned in the tower-house.

title: Genesis 40:6
text: And Joseph came in to them in the morning, and looked on them, and behold, they were sad.

title: Genesis 40:7
text: And he asked Pharaoh's chamberlains that were with him in custody in his lord's house, saying, Why are your faces [so] sad to-day?

title: Genesis 40:8
text: And they said to him, We have dreamt a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said to them, [Do] not interpretations [belong] to God? tell me [your dreams], I pray you.

title: Genesis 40:9
text: Then the chief of the cup-bearers told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

title: Genesis 40:10
text: and in the vine were three branches; and it was as though it budded: its blossoms shot forth, its clusters ripened into grapes.

title: Genesis 40:11
text: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

title: Genesis 40:12
text: And Joseph said to him, This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days.

title: Genesis 40:13
text: In yet three days will Pharaoh lift up thy head and restore thee to thy place, and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his cup-bearer.

title: Genesis 40:14
text: Only bear a remembrance with thee of me when it goes well with thee, and deal kindly, I pray thee, with me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house;

title: Genesis 40:15
text: for indeed I was stolen out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

title: Genesis 40:16
text: And when the chief of the bakers saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

title: Genesis 40:17
text: And in the uppermost basket there were all manner of victuals for Pharaoh that the baker makes, and the birds ate them out of the basket upon my head.

title: Genesis 40:18
text: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation of it: the three baskets are three days.

title: Genesis 40:19
text: In yet three days will Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and hang thee on a tree; and the birds will eat thy flesh from off thee.

title: Genesis 40:20
text: ¶And it came to pass the third day--Pharaoh's birthday--that he made a feast to all his bondmen. And he lifted up the head of the chief of the cup-bearers, and the head of the chief of the bakers among his bondmen.

title: Genesis 40:21
text: And he restored the chief of the cup-bearers to his office of cup-bearer again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

title: Genesis 40:22
text: And he hanged the chief of the bakers, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

title: Genesis 40:23
text: But the chief of the cup-bearers did not remember Joseph, and forgot him.

title: Genesis 41:1
text: ¶And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

title: Genesis 41:2
text: And behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fine-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the reed-grass.

title: Genesis 41:3
text: And behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, bad-looking and lean-fleshed, and stood by the kine on the bank of the river.

title: Genesis 41:4
text: And the kine that were bad-looking and lean-fleshed ate up the seven kine that were fine-looking and fat. And Pharaoh awoke.

title: Genesis 41:5
text: And he slept and dreamed the second time; and behold, seven ears of corn grew up on one stalk, fat and good.

title: Genesis 41:6
text: And behold, seven ears, thin and parched with the east wind, sprung up after them.

title: Genesis 41:7
text: And the thin ears devoured the seven fat and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke; and behold, it was a dream.

title: Genesis 41:8
text: And it came to pass in the morning, that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the scribes of Egypt, and all the sages who were therein, and Pharaoh told them his dream; but [there was] none to interpret them to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:9
text: ¶Then spoke the chief of the cup-bearers to Pharaoh, saying, I remember mine offences this day.

title: Genesis 41:10
text: Pharaoh was wroth with his bondmen, and put me in custody into the captain of the life-guard's house, me and the chief of the bakers.

title: Genesis 41:11
text: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each according to the interpretation of his dream.

title: Genesis 41:12
text: And there was there with us a Hebrew youth, a bondman of the captain of the life-guard, to whom we told [them], and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each he interpreted according to his dream.

title: Genesis 41:13
text: And it came to pass, just as he interpreted to us, so it came about: me has he restored to my office, and him he hanged.

title: Genesis 41:14
text: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph; and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. And he shaved [himself], and changed his clothes, and came in to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:15
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have dreamt a dream, and there is none to interpret it. And I have heard say of thee, thou understandest a dream to interpret it.

title: Genesis 41:16
text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

title: Genesis 41:17
text: ¶And Pharaoh said to Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood on the bank of the river.

title: Genesis 41:18
text: And behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and of fine form, and they fed in the reed-grass.

title: Genesis 41:19
text: And behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor, and very ill-formed, and lean-fleshed--such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness.

title: Genesis 41:20
text: And the lean and bad kine ate up the seven first fat kine;

title: Genesis 41:21
text: and they came into their belly, and it could not be known that they had come into their belly; and their look was bad, as at the beginning. And I awoke.

title: Genesis 41:22
text: And I saw in my dream, and behold, seven ears came up on one stalk, full and good.

title: Genesis 41:23
text: And behold, seven ears, withered, thin, parched with the east wind, sprung up after them;

title: Genesis 41:24
text: and the thin ears devoured the seven good ears. And I told it to the scribes; but there was none to make it known to me.

title: Genesis 41:25
text: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God will do he has made known to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:26
text: The seven fine kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

title: Genesis 41:27
text: And the seven lean and bad kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears, parched with the east wind, will be seven years of famine.

title: Genesis 41:28
text: This is the word which I have spoken to Pharaoh: what God is about to do he has let Pharaoh see.

title: Genesis 41:29
text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:30
text: And there will arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt, and the famine will waste away the land.

title: Genesis 41:31
text: And the plenty will not be known afterwards in the land by reason of that famine; for it will be very grievous.

title: Genesis 41:32
text: And as regards the double repetition of the dream to Pharaoh, it is that the thing is established by God, and God will hasten to do it.

title: Genesis 41:33
text: ¶And now let Pharaoh look himself out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:34
text: Let Pharaoh do [this]: let him appoint overseers over the land, and take the fifth part of the land of Egypt during the seven years of plenty,

title: Genesis 41:35
text: and let them gather all the food of these coming good years, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, for food in the cities, and keep [it].

title: Genesis 41:36
text: And let the food be as store for the land for the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt, that the land perish not through the famine.

title: Genesis 41:37
text: And the word was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his bondmen.

title: Genesis 41:38
text: And Pharaoh said to his bondmen, Shall we find [one] as this, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

title: Genesis 41:39
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since God has made all this known to thee, there is none [so] discreet and wise as thou.

title: Genesis 41:40
text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according to thy commandment shall all my people regulate themselves; only concerning the throne will I be greater than thou.

title: Genesis 41:41
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:42
text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in clothes of byssus, and put a gold chain on his neck.

title: Genesis 41:43
text: And he caused him to ride in the second chariot that he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee! and he set him over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:44
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh; and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:45
text: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah, and gave him as wife Asnath the daughter of Potipherah the priest in On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:46
text: ¶And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh, and passed through the whole land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:47
text: And in the seven years of plenty the land brought forth by handfuls.

title: Genesis 41:48
text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years that was in the land of Egypt, and put the food in the cities; the food of the fields of the city, which were round about it, he laid up in it.

title: Genesis 41:49
text: And Joseph laid up corn as sand of the sea exceeding much, until they left off numbering; for it was without number.

title: Genesis 41:50
text: And to Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asnath the daughter of Potipherah the priest in On bore to him.

title: Genesis 41:51
text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh--For God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

title: Genesis 41:52
text: And the name of the second he called Ephraim--For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

title: Genesis 41:53
text: And the seven years of plenty that were in the land of Egypt were ended;

title: Genesis 41:54
text: and the seven years of the dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said. And there was dearth in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

title: Genesis 41:55
text: And all the land of Egypt suffered from the dearth. And the people cried to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, Go to Joseph: what he says to you, that do.

title: Genesis 41:56
text: And the famine was on all the earth. And Joseph opened every place in which there was [provision], and sold grain to the Egyptians; and the famine was grievous in the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:57
text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph, to buy [grain], because the famine was grievous on the whole earth.

title: Genesis 42:1
text: ¶And Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

title: Genesis 42:2
text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt; go down thither and buy [grain] for us from thence, in order that we may live, and not die.

title: Genesis 42:3
text: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy [grain] out of Egypt.

title: Genesis 42:4
text: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest mischief may befall him.

title: Genesis 42:5
text: So the sons of Israel came to buy [grain] among those that came; for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:6
text: And Joseph, he was the governor over the land--he it was that sold [the corn] to all the people of the land. And Joseph's brethren came and bowed down to him, the face to the earth.

title: Genesis 42:7
text: ¶And Joseph saw his brethren, and knew them; but he made himself strange to them, and spoke roughly to them, and said to them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan, to buy food.

title: Genesis 42:8
text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they did not know him.

title: Genesis 42:9
text: And Joseph remembered the dreams that he had dreamt of them; and he said to them, Ye are spies: to see the exposed places of the land ye are come.

title: Genesis 42:10
text: And they said to him, No, my lord; but to buy food are thy servants come.

title: Genesis 42:11
text: We are all one man's sons; we are honest: thy servants are not spies.

title: Genesis 42:12
text: And he said to them, No; but to see the exposed places of the land are ye come.

title: Genesis 42:13
text: And they said, Thy servants were twelve brethren, sons of one man, in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

title: Genesis 42:14
text: And Joseph said to them, That is it that I have spoken to you, saying, Ye are spies.

title: Genesis 42:15
text: By this ye shall be put to the proof: as Pharaoh lives, ye shall not go forth hence, unless your youngest brother come hither!

title: Genesis 42:16
text: Send one of you, that he may fetch your brother, but ye shall be imprisoned, and your words shall be put to the proof, whether the truth is in you; and if not, as Pharaoh lives, ye are spies.

title: Genesis 42:17
text: And he put them in custody three days.

title: Genesis 42:18
text: And Joseph said to them the third day, This do, that ye may live: I fear God.

title: Genesis 42:19
text: If ye are honest, let one of your brethren remain bound in the house of your prison, but go ye, carry grain for the hunger of your households;

title: Genesis 42:20
text: and bring your youngest brother to me, in order that your words be verified, and that ye may not die. And they did so.

title: Genesis 42:21
text: ¶Then they said one to another, We are indeed guilty concerning our brother, whose anguish of soul we saw when he besought us, and we did not hearken; therefore this distress is come upon us.

title: Genesis 42:22
text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Did I not speak to you, saying, Do not sin against the lad? But ye did not hearken; and now behold, his blood also is required.

title: Genesis 42:23
text: And they did not know that Joseph understood, for the interpreter was between them.

title: Genesis 42:24
text: And he turned away from them, and wept. And he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

title: Genesis 42:25
text: And Joseph gave orders to fill their vessels with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way. And thus did they to them.

title: Genesis 42:26
text: And they loaded their asses with their grain, and departed thence.

title: Genesis 42:27
text: And one of them opened his sack to give his ass food in the inn, and saw his money, and behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

title: Genesis 42:28
text: And he said to his brethren, My money is returned [to me], and behold, it is even in my sack. And their heart failed [them], and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this [that] God has done to us?

title: Genesis 42:29
text: ¶And they came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father, and told him all that had befallen them, saying,

title: Genesis 42:30
text: The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us, and treated us as spies of the land.

title: Genesis 42:31
text: And we said to him, We are honest; we are not spies:

title: Genesis 42:32
text: we are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:33
text: And the man, the lord of the land, said to us, Hereby shall I know that ye are honest: leave one of your brethren with me, and take [for] the hunger of your households, and go,

title: Genesis 42:34
text: and bring your youngest brother to me, and I shall know that ye are not spies, but are honest. Your brother will I give up to you; and ye may trade in the land.

title: Genesis 42:35
text: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that behold, every man had his bundle of money in his sack; and they saw their bundles of money, they and their father, and were afraid.

title: Genesis 42:36
text: And Jacob their father said to them, Ye have bereaved me of children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin! All these things are against me.

title: Genesis 42:37
text: And Reuben spoke to his father, saying, Slay my two sons if I bring him not back to thee: give him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

title: Genesis 42:38
text: But he said, My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left; and if mischief should befall him by the way in which ye go, then would ye bring down my grey hairs with sorrow to Sheol.

title: Genesis 43:1
text: ¶And the famine was grievous in the land.

title: Genesis 43:2
text: And it came to pass, when they had finished eating the grain which they had brought from Egypt, that their father said to them, Go again, buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 43:3
text: And Judah spoke to him, saying, The man did positively testify to us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, unless your brother be with you.

title: Genesis 43:4
text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food;

title: Genesis 43:5
text: but if thou do not send [him], we will not go down, for the man said to us, Ye shall not see my face, unless your brother be with you.

title: Genesis 43:6
text: And Israel said, Why did ye deal [so] ill with me [as] to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

title: Genesis 43:7
text: And they said, The man asked very closely after us, and after our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye a brother? And we told him according to the tenor of these words. Could we at all know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

title: Genesis 43:8
text: And Judah said to Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live, and not die, both we and thou and our little ones.

title: Genesis 43:9
text: I will be surety for him: of my hand shalt thou require him; if I bring him not to thee, and set him before thy face, then shall I be guilty toward thee for ever.

title: Genesis 43:10
text: For had we not lingered, we should now certainly have returned already twice.

title: Genesis 43:11
text: ¶And their father Israel said to them, If it is then so, do this: take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a gift: a little balsam and a little honey, tragacanth and ladanum, pistacia-nuts and almonds.

title: Genesis 43:12
text: And take other money in your hand, and the money that was returned to you in the mouth of your sacks, carry back in your hand: perhaps it is an oversight.

title: Genesis 43:13
text: And take your brother, and arise, go again to the man.

title: Genesis 43:14
text: And the Almighty *God give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother and Benjamin! And I, if I be bereaved of children, am bereaved.

title: Genesis 43:15
text: ¶And the men took that gift, and took double money in their hand, and Benjamin, and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and came before Joseph.

title: Genesis 43:16
text: And Joseph saw Benjamin with them, and said to the [man] who was over his house, Bring the men into the house, and slaughter cattle, and make ready; for the men shall eat with me at noon.

title: Genesis 43:17
text: And the man did as Joseph had said; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

title: Genesis 43:18
text: And the men were afraid because they were brought into Joseph's house, and said, Because of the money that was returned to us in our sacks at the beginning are we brought in, that he may turn against us, and fall upon us and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

title: Genesis 43:19
text: And they came up to the man that was over Joseph's house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

title: Genesis 43:20
text: and said, Ah! my lord, we came indeed down at the first to buy food.

title: Genesis 43:21
text: And it came to pass when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and behold, [every] man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money according to its weight; and we have brought it again in our hand.

title: Genesis 43:22
text: And other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food. We do not know who put our money in our sacks.

title: Genesis 43:23
text: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; your money came to me. And he brought Simeon out to them.

title: Genesis 43:24
text: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses food.

title: Genesis 43:25
text: And they made ready the gift for Joseph's coming at noon; for they had heard that they should eat bread there.

title: Genesis 43:26
text: ¶When Joseph came home, they brought him the gift that was in their hand, into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

title: Genesis 43:27
text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well--the old man of whom ye spoke? Is he yet alive?

title: Genesis 43:28
text: And they said, Thy servant our father is well; he is yet alive. And they bowed, and made obeisance.

title: Genesis 43:29
text: And he lifted up his eyes and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother of whom ye spoke to me? And he said, God be gracious to thee, my son!

title: Genesis 43:30
text: And Joseph made haste, for his bowels burned for his brother; and he sought [a place] to weep, and he went into the chamber, and wept there.

title: Genesis 43:31
text: And he washed his face, and came out, and controlled himself, and said, Set on bread.

title: Genesis 43:32
text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves; because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 43:33
text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth; and the men marvelled one at another.

title: Genesis 43:34
text: And he had portions carried to them from before him. And Benjamin's portion was five times greater than the portions of them all. And they drank, and made merry with him.

title: Genesis 44:1
text: ¶And he commanded him who was over his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry; and put every man's money in the mouth of his sack.

title: Genesis 44:2
text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain-money. And he did according to the word of Joseph which he had spoken.

title: Genesis 44:3
text: In the morning, when it was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

title: Genesis 44:4
text: They were gone out of the city, [and] not [yet] far off, when Joseph said to him who was over his house, Up! follow after the men; and when thou overtakest them, thou shalt say to them, Why have ye rewarded evil for good?

title: Genesis 44:5
text: Is not this [it] in which my lord drinks, and in which indeed he divines? Ye have done evil [in] what ye have done.

title: Genesis 44:6
text: And he overtook them, and he spoke to them these words.

title: Genesis 44:7
text: And they said to him, Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from thy servants to do such a thing!

title: Genesis 44:8
text: Behold, the money that we found in our sacks' mouths we have brought again to thee from the land of Canaan; and how should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

title: Genesis 44:9
text: With whomsoever of thy servants it is found, let him die; and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

title: Genesis 44:10
text: And he said, Now also [let] it [be] according to your words: let him with whom it is found be my bondman, but ye shall be blameless.

title: Genesis 44:11
text: And they hasted and laid down every man his sack on the ground, and opened every man his sack.

title: Genesis 44:12
text: And he searched carefully: he began at the eldest, and ended at the youngest; and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

title: Genesis 44:13
text: Then they rent their clothes, and loaded every man his ass, and they returned to the city.

title: Genesis 44:14
text: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; and he was still there; and they fell down before him to the ground.

title: Genesis 44:15
text: And Joseph said to them, What deed is this which ye have done? Did ye not know that such a man as I can certainly divine?

title: Genesis 44:16
text: And Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? what shall we speak, and how justify ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of thy servants; behold, we are my lord's bondmen, both we, and he in whose hand the cup has been found.

title: Genesis 44:17
text: And he said, Far be it from me to do so! The man in whose hand the cup has been found, he shall be my bondman; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.

title: Genesis 44:18
text: ¶Then Judah came near to him, and said, Ah! my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant; for thou art even as Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 44:19
text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

title: Genesis 44:20
text: And we said to my lord, We have an aged father, and a child born to him in his old age, [yet] young; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.

title: Genesis 44:21
text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down to me, that I may set mine eye on him.

title: Genesis 44:22
text: And we said to my lord, The youth cannot leave his father: if he should leave his father, [his father] would die.

title: Genesis 44:23
text: And thou saidst to thy servants, Unless your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

title: Genesis 44:24
text: And it came to pass when we came up to thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

title: Genesis 44:25
text: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 44:26
text: But we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down; for we cannot see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.

title: Genesis 44:27
text: And thy servant my father said to us, Ye know that my wife bore me two [sons];

title: Genesis 44:28
text: and the one went out from me, and I said, He must certainly have been torn in pieces; and I have not seen him [again] hitherto.

title: Genesis 44:29
text: And if ye take this one also from me, and mischief should befall him, ye will bring down my grey hairs with misery to Sheol.

title: Genesis 44:30
text: And now, when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us, --seeing that his life is bound up with his life,

title: Genesis 44:31
text: it will come to pass when he sees that the lad is not [there], that he will die; and thy servants will bring down the grey hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.

title: Genesis 44:32
text: For thy servant became surety for the lad to my father, saying, If I bring him not to thee, then I shall be guilty toward my father all my days.

title: Genesis 44:33
text: And now, let thy servant stay, I pray thee, instead of the lad a bondman to my lord, and let the lad go up with his brethren;

title: Genesis 44:34
text: for how should I go up to my father if the lad were not with me? --lest I see the evil that would come on my father.

title: Genesis 45:1
text: ¶And Joseph could not control himself before all them that stood by him, and he cried, Put every man out from me! And no man stood with him when Joseph made himself known to his brethren.

title: Genesis 45:2
text: And he raised his voice in weeping; and the Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

title: Genesis 45:3
text: And Joseph said to his brethren, I am Joseph. Does my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him, for they were troubled at his presence.

title: Genesis 45:4
text: And Joseph said to his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:5
text: And now, be not grieved, and be not angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

title: Genesis 45:6
text: For the famine has been these two years in the land; and yet there are five years in which there will be neither ploughing nor harvest.

title: Genesis 45:7
text: So God sent me before you to preserve you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

title: Genesis 45:8
text: And now it was not you [that] sent me here, but God; and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and governor over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:9
text: Haste and go up to my father, and say to him, Thus says thy son Joseph: God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, tarry not.

title: Genesis 45:10
text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near to me, thou, and thy sons, and thy sons' sons, and thy sheep, and thy cattle, and all that thou hast.

title: Genesis 45:11
text: And there will I maintain thee; for yet there are five years of famine; in order that thou be not impoverished, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.

title: Genesis 45:12
text: And behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth which speaks to you.

title: Genesis 45:13
text: And tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen, and haste and bring down my father hither.

title: Genesis 45:14
text: And he fell on his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept on his neck.

title: Genesis 45:15
text: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them; and after that his brethren talked with him.

title: Genesis 45:16
text: ¶And the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come. And it was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his bondmen.

title: Genesis 45:17
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to thy brethren, Do this: load your beasts and depart, go into the land of Canaan,

title: Genesis 45:18
text: and take your father and your households, and come to me; and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

title: Genesis 45:19
text: And thou art commanded--this do: take waggons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and take up your father, and come.

title: Genesis 45:20
text: And let not your eye regret your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt shall be yours.

title: Genesis 45:21
text: And the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them waggons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

title: Genesis 45:22
text: To each one of them all he gave changes of clothing; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred [pieces] of silver and five changes of clothing.

title: Genesis 45:23
text: And to his father he sent this: ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses laden with corn and bread, and food for his father by the way.

title: Genesis 45:24
text: And he sent his brethren away, and they departed. And he said to them, Do not quarrel on the way.

title: Genesis 45:25
text: ¶And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan to Jacob their father.

title: Genesis 45:26
text: And they told him, saying, Joseph is still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And his heart fainted, for he did not believe them.

title: Genesis 45:27
text: And they spoke to him all the words of Joseph, which he had spoken to them. And he saw the waggons that Joseph had sent to carry him. And the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

title: Genesis 45:28
text: And Israel said, It is enough: Joseph my son is yet alive; I will go and see him before I die.

title: Genesis 46:1
text: ¶And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba; and he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

title: Genesis 46:2
text: And God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night and said, Jacob, Jacob! And he said, Here am I.

title: Genesis 46:3
text: And he said, I am *God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down to Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation.

title: Genesis 46:4
text: I will go down with thee to Egypt, and I will also certainly bring thee up; and Joseph shall put his hand on thine eyes.

title: Genesis 46:5
text: ¶And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, on the waggons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

title: Genesis 46:6
text: And they took their cattle, and their goods which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him;

title: Genesis 46:7
text: his sons and his sons' sons with him, his daughters and his sons' daughters and all his seed he brought with him to Egypt.

title: Genesis 46:8
text: And these are the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt: Jacob and his sons. Jacob's firstborn, Reuben.

title: Genesis 46:9
text: And the sons of Reuben: Enoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

title: Genesis 46:10
text: --And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Saul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

title: Genesis 46:11
text: --And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

title: Genesis 46:12
text: --And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pherez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pherez were Hezron and Hamul.

title: Genesis 46:13
text: --And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, and Job, and Shimron.

title: Genesis 46:14
text: --And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

title: Genesis 46:15
text: --These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan-Aram; and his daughter, Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

title: Genesis 46:16
text: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion and Haggi, Shuni and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

title: Genesis 46:17
text: --And the sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Jishvah, and Jishvi, and Beriah; and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

title: Genesis 46:18
text: --These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and she bore these to Jacob: sixteen souls.

title: Genesis 46:19
text: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

title: Genesis 46:20
text: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asnath bore to him, the daughter of Potipherah the priest in On.

title: Genesis 46:21
text: --And the sons of Benjamin: Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

title: Genesis 46:22
text: --These are the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

title: Genesis 46:23
text: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

title: Genesis 46:24
text: --And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

title: Genesis 46:25
text: --These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter; and she bore these to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

title: Genesis 46:26
text: All the souls that came with Jacob to Egypt, that had come out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives: all the souls were sixty-six.

title: Genesis 46:27
text: And the sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob that came to Egypt were seventy.

title: Genesis 46:28
text: ¶And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to give notice before he came to Goshen. And they came into the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 46:29
text: Then Joseph yoked his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and he presented himself to him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

title: Genesis 46:30
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, after I have seen thy face, since thou still livest.

title: Genesis 46:31
text: And Joseph said to his brethren and to his father's house, I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and say to him, My brethren and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come to me;

title: Genesis 46:32
text: and the men are shepherds, for they have been occupied with cattle; and they have brought their sheep, and their cattle, and all that they have.

title: Genesis 46:33
text: And it shall come to pass that when Pharaoh shall call you and say, What is your occupation?

title: Genesis 46:34
text: then ye shall say, Thy servants are men that have been occupied with cattle from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers; in order that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 47:1
text: ¶And Joseph came and told Pharaoh and said, My father and my brethren, and their sheep and their cattle, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 47:2
text: And he took from the whole number of his brethren, five men, and set them before Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:3
text: And Pharaoh said to his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said to Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers.

title: Genesis 47:4
text: And they said to Pharaoh, To sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for the sheep that thy servants have, for the famine is grievous in the land of Canaan; and now, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 47:5
text: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come to thee.

title: Genesis 47:6
text: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land settle thy father and thy brethren: let them dwell in the land of Goshen. And if thou knowest men of activity among them, then set them as overseers of cattle over what I have.

title: Genesis 47:7
text: And Joseph brought Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:8
text: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, How many are the days of the years of thy life?

title: Genesis 47:9
text: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, The days of the years of my sojourning are a hundred and thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they do not attain to the days of the years of the life of my fathers, in the days of their sojourning.

title: Genesis 47:10
text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:11
text: And Joseph settled his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

title: Genesis 47:12
text: And Joseph maintained his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to the number of the little ones.

title: Genesis 47:13
text: ¶And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very grievous; and the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan were exhausted through the famine.

title: Genesis 47:14
text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought; and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

title: Genesis 47:15
text: And when money came to an end in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, saying, Give us bread! for why should we die before thee? for [our] money is all gone.

title: Genesis 47:16
text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle, and I will give you for your cattle, if [your] money be all gone.

title: Genesis 47:17
text: And they brought their cattle to Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread for horses, and for flocks of sheep, and for herds of cattle, and for asses; and he fed them with bread for all their cattle that year.

title: Genesis 47:18
text: And that year ended; and they came to him the second year, and said to him, We will not hide [it] from my lord that since [our] money is come to an end, and the herds of cattle are in the possession of my lord, nothing is left before my lord but our bodies and our land.

title: Genesis 47:19
text: Why should we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be bondmen to Pharaoh; and give seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land be not desolate.

title: Genesis 47:20
text: And Joseph bought all the soil of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them; and the land became Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:21
text: And as for the people, he removed them into the cities, from [one] end of the borders of Egypt even to the [other] end of it.

title: Genesis 47:22
text: Only the land of the priests he did not buy; for the priests had an assigned portion from Pharaoh, and ate their assigned portion which Pharaoh had given them; so they did not sell their land.

title: Genesis 47:23
text: And Joseph said to the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and sow the land.

title: Genesis 47:24
text: And it shall come to pass in the increase that ye shall give the fifth to Pharaoh, and the four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

title: Genesis 47:25
text: And they said, Thou hast saved us alive. Let us find favour in the eyes of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's bondmen.

title: Genesis 47:26
text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt to this day, [that] the fifth should be for Pharaoh, except the land of the priests: theirs alone did not become Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:27
text: ¶And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they had possessions in it, and were fruitful and multiplied exceedingly.

title: Genesis 47:28
text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years; and the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred and forty-seven years.

title: Genesis 47:29
text: And the days of Israel approached that he should die. And he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If now I have found favour in thine eyes, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me: bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt;

title: Genesis 47:30
text: but when I shall lie with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their sepulchre. And he said, I will do according to thy word.

title: Genesis 47:31
text: And he said, Swear to me; and he swore to him. And Israel worshipped on the bed's head.

title: Genesis 48:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick. And he took with him his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim.

title: Genesis 48:2
text: And one told Jacob and said, Behold, thy son Joseph is coming to thee. And Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

title: Genesis 48:3
text: And Jacob said to Joseph, The Almighty *God appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

title: Genesis 48:4
text: and he said to me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a company of peoples; and will give this land to thy seed after thee [for] an everlasting possession.

title: Genesis 48:5
text: And now thy two sons, who were born to thee in the land of Egypt before I came to thee into Egypt, shall be mine: Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, as Reuben and Simeon.

title: Genesis 48:6
text: And thy family which thou hast begotten after them shall be thine: they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

title: Genesis 48:7
text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was yet a certain distance to come to Ephrath; and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem.

title: Genesis 48:8
text: ¶And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

title: Genesis 48:9
text: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God has given me here. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, to me, that I may bless them.

title: Genesis 48:10
text: But the eyes of Israel were heavy from age: he could not see. And he brought them nearer to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

title: Genesis 48:11
text: And Israel said to Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face; and behold, God has let me see also thy seed.

title: Genesis 48:12
text: And Joseph brought them out from his knees, and bowed down with his face to the earth.

title: Genesis 48:13
text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought [them] near to him.

title: Genesis 48:14
text: But Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid [it] on Ephraim's head--now he was the younger--and his left hand on Manasseh's head; guiding his hands intelligently, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

title: Genesis 48:15
text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God that shepherded me all my life long to this day,

title: Genesis 48:16
text: the Angel that redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named upon them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the land!

title: Genesis 48:17
text: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it was evil in his eyes; and he took hold of his father's hand to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

title: Genesis 48:18
text: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn: put thy right hand on his head.

title: Genesis 48:19
text: But his father refused and said, I know, my son, I know: he also will become a people, and he also will be great; but truly his younger brother will be greater than he; and his seed will become the fulness of nations.

title: Genesis 48:20
text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee will Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and Manasseh! And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

title: Genesis 48:21
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die; and God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

title: Genesis 48:22
text: And *I* have given to thee one tract [of land] above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

title: Genesis 49:1
text: ¶And Jacob called his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, and I will tell you what will befall you at the end of days.

title: Genesis 49:2
text: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob, And listen to Israel your father.

title: Genesis 49:3
text: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, My might, and the firstfruits of my vigour: Excellency of dignity, and excellency of strength.

title: Genesis 49:4
text: Impetuous as the waters, thou shalt have no pre-eminence; Because thou wentest up to thy father's couch: Then defiledst thou [it]: he went up to my bed.

title: Genesis 49:5
text: ¶Simeon and Levi are brethren: Instruments of violence their swords.

title: Genesis 49:6
text: My soul, come not into their council; Mine honour, be not united with their assembly; For in their anger they slew men, And in their wantonness houghed oxen.

title: Genesis 49:7
text: Cursed be their anger, for it [was] violent; And their rage, for it [was] cruel! I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel.

title: Genesis 49:8
text: ¶Judah--[as to] thee, thy brethren will praise thee; Thy hand will be upon the neck of thine enemies; Thy father's children will bow down to thee.

title: Genesis 49:9
text: Judah is a young lion; From the prey, my son, thou art gone up. He stoopeth, he layeth himself down as a lion, And as a lioness: who will rouse him up?

title: Genesis 49:10
text: The sceptre will not depart from Judah, Nor the lawgiver from between his feet, Until Shiloh come, And to him will be the obedience of peoples.

title: Genesis 49:11
text: He bindeth his foal to the vine, And his ass's colt to the choice vine; He washeth his dress in wine, And his garment in the blood of grapes.

title: Genesis 49:12
text: The eyes are red with wine, And the teeth [are] white with milk.

title: Genesis 49:13
text: ¶Zebulun will dwell at the shore of the seas; Yea, he will be at the shore of the ships, And his side [toucheth] upon Sidon.

title: Genesis 49:14
text: Issachar is a bony ass, Crouching down between two hurdles.

title: Genesis 49:15
text: And he saw the rest that it was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And he bowed his shoulder to bear, And was a tributary servant.

title: Genesis 49:16
text: Dan will judge his people, As another of the tribes of Israel.

title: Genesis 49:17
text: Dan will be a serpent on the way, A horned snake on the path, Which biteth the horse's heels, So that the rider falleth backwards.

title: Genesis 49:18
text: I wait for thy salvation, O Jehovah.

title: Genesis 49:19
text: Gad--troops will rush upon him; But he will rush upon the heel.

title: Genesis 49:20
text: Out of Asher, his bread shall be fat, And he will give royal dainties.

title: Genesis 49:21
text: Naphtali is a hind let loose; He giveth goodly words.

title: Genesis 49:22
text: ¶Joseph is a fruitful bough; A fruitful bough by a well; [His] branches shoot over the wall.

title: Genesis 49:23
text: The archers have provoked him, And shot at, and hated him;

title: Genesis 49:24
text: But his bow abideth firm, And the arms of his hands are supple By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob. From thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:

title: Genesis 49:25
text: From the *God of thy father, and he will help thee; And from the Almighty, and he will bless thee--With blessings of heaven from above, With blessings of the deep that lieth under, With blessings of the breast and of the womb.

title: Genesis 49:26
text: The blessings of thy father surpass the blessings of my ancestors, Unto the bounds of the everlasting hills: They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

title: Genesis 49:27
text: Benjamin--[as] a wolf will he tear to pieces; In the morning he will devour the prey, And in the evening he will divide the booty.

title: Genesis 49:28
text: ¶All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them; and he blessed them: every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

title: Genesis 49:29
text: And he charged them, and said to them, I am gathered to my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

title: Genesis 49:30
text: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is opposite to Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought of Ephron the Hittite along with the field for a possession of a sepulchre.

title: Genesis 49:31
text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebecca his wife; and there I buried Leah.

title: Genesis 49:32
text: The purchase of the field, and of the cave that is in it, was from the children of Heth.

title: Genesis 49:33
text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered his feet into the bed, and expired, and was gathered to his peoples.

title: Genesis 50:1
text: ¶And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

title: Genesis 50:2
text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel.

title: Genesis 50:3
text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those who are embalmed. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

title: Genesis 50:4
text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found favour in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

title: Genesis 50:5
text: My father made me swear, saying, Behold, I die; in my grave which I have dug myself in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. And now, let me go up, I pray thee, that I may bury my father; and I will come again.

title: Genesis 50:6
text: And Pharaoh said, Go up and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

title: Genesis 50:7
text: ¶And Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the bondmen of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

title: Genesis 50:8
text: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house; only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 50:9
text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen; and the camp was very great.

title: Genesis 50:10
text: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan; and there they lamented with a great and very grievous lamentation; and he made a mourning for his father of seven days.

title: Genesis 50:11
text: And the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the threshing-floor of Atad, and they said, This is a grievous mourning of the Egyptians. Therefore the name of it was called Abel-Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

title: Genesis 50:12
text: And his sons did to him according as he had commanded them;

title: Genesis 50:13
text: and his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah which Abraham had bought along with the field, for a possession of a sepulchre, of Ephron the Hittite, opposite to Mamre.

title: Genesis 50:14
text: And, after he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brethren, and all that had gone up with him to bury his father.

title: Genesis 50:15
text: ¶And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, If now Joseph should be hostile to us, and should indeed requite us all the evil that we did to him!

title: Genesis 50:16
text: And they sent a messenger to Joseph, saying, Thy father commanded before he died, saying,

title: Genesis 50:17
text: Thus shall ye speak to Joseph: Oh forgive, I pray thee, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin! for they did evil to thee. And now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

title: Genesis 50:18
text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face, and said, Behold, we are thy bondmen.

title: Genesis 50:19
text: And Joseph said to them, Fear not: am I then in the place of God?

title: Genesis 50:20
text: Ye indeed meant evil against me: God meant it for good, in order that he might do as [it is] this day, to save a great people alive.

title: Genesis 50:21
text: And now, fear not: I will maintain you and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spoke consolingly to them.

title: Genesis 50:22
text: ¶And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his father's house; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

title: Genesis 50:23
text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third [generation]; the sons also of Machir the son of Manasseh were born on Joseph's knees.

title: Genesis 50:24
text: And Joseph said to his brethren, I die; and God will certainly visit you, and bring you up out of this land, into the land that he swore unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Genesis 50:25
text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will certainly visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones hence.

title: Genesis 50:26
text: And Joseph died, a hundred and ten years old; and they embalmed him; and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

title: Exodus 1:1
text: ¶And these are the names of the sons of Israel who had come into Egypt; with Jacob had they come, each with his household:

title: Exodus 1:2
text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;

title: Exodus 1:3
text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;

title: Exodus 1:4
text: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.

title: Exodus 1:5
text: And all the souls that had come out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls; and Joseph was in Egypt.

title: Exodus 1:6
text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

title: Exodus 1:7
text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and swarmed and multiplied, and became exceeding strong; and the land was full of them.

title: Exodus 1:8
text: ¶And there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.

title: Exodus 1:9
text: And he said to his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more numerous and stronger than we.

title: Exodus 1:10
text: Come on, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it come to pass that, if war occur, they take side with our enemies and fight against us, and go up out of the land.

title: Exodus 1:11
text: And they set over them service-masters to oppress them with their burdens. And they built store-cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Rameses.

title: Exodus 1:12
text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and spread; and they were distressed because of the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 1:13
text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel serve with harshness;

title: Exodus 1:14
text: and they embittered their life with hard labour in clay and bricks, and in all manner of labour in the field: all their labour with which they made them serve was with harshness.

title: Exodus 1:15
text: ¶And the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives--of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other was Puah--

title: Exodus 1:16
text: and he said, When ye help the Hebrew women in bearing, and see [them] on the stool, if it be a son, then ye shall kill him, but if a daughter, then she shall live.

title: Exodus 1:17
