title: Exodus 18:18
text: Thou wilt be quite exhausted, both thou and this people that is with thee; for the thing is too heavy for thee: thou canst not perform it alone.

title: Exodus 18:19
text: Hearken now to my voice: I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee. Be thou for the people with God, and bring the matters before God;

title: Exodus 18:20
text: and teach them the statutes and the laws, and make known to them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

title: Exodus 18:21
text: But do thou provide among all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place [them] over them, chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens,

title: Exodus 18:22
text: that they may judge the people at all times; and it shall be [that] they shall bring to thee every great matter, and that they shall judge every small matter, and they shall lighten [the task] on thee, and they shall bear [it] with thee.

title: Exodus 18:23
text: If thou do this thing, and God command thee [so], thou wilt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

title: Exodus 18:24
text: And Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

title: Exodus 18:25
text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens.

title: Exodus 18:26
text: And they judged the people at all times: the hard matters they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged.

title: Exodus 18:27
text: And Moses sent away his father-in-law, and he departed into his land.

title: Exodus 19:1
text: ¶In the third month after the departure of the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they [into] the wilderness of Sinai:

title: Exodus 19:2
text: they departed from Rephidim, and came [into] the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in the wilderness; and Israel encamped there before the mountain.

title: Exodus 19:3
text: And Moses went up to God, and Jehovah called to him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

title: Exodus 19:4
text: Ye have seen what I have done to the Egyptians, and [how] I have borne you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself.

title: Exodus 19:5
text: And now, if ye will hearken to my voice indeed and keep my covenant, then shall ye be my own possession out of all the peoples--for all the earth is mine--

title: Exodus 19:6
text: and ye shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak to the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 19:7
text: And Moses came and called the elders of the people, and laid before the mall these words which Jehovah had commanded him.

title: Exodus 19:8
text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Jehovah has spoken will we do! And Moses brought the words of the people back to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 19:9
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Lo, I will come to thee in the cloud's thick darkness, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee also for ever. And Moses told the words of the people to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 19:10
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Go to the people, and hallow them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their clothes;

title: Exodus 19:11
text: and let them be ready for the third day; for on the third day Jehovah will come down before the eyes of all the people on mount Sinai.

title: Exodus 19:12
text: And set bounds round about the people, saying, Take heed to yourselves, [not] to go up unto the mountain nor touch the border of it: whatever toucheth the mountain shall certainly be put to death:

title: Exodus 19:13
text: not a hand shall touch it, but it shall certainly be stoned, or shot through; whether it be a beast or a man, it shall not live. When the long drawn note of the trumpet soundeth, they shall come up to the mountain.

title: Exodus 19:14
text: And Moses came down from the mountain to the people, and hallowed the people; and they washed their clothes.

title: Exodus 19:15
text: And he said to the people, Be ready for the third day; do not come near [your] wives.

title: Exodus 19:16
text: ¶And it came to pass on the third day, when it was morning, that there were thunders and lightnings and a heavy cloud on the mountain, and the sound of the trumpet exceeding loud; and the whole people that was in the camp trembled.

title: Exodus 19:17
text: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

title: Exodus 19:18
text: And the whole of mount Sinai smoked, because Jehovah descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended as the smoke of a furnace; and the whole mountain shook greatly.

title: Exodus 19:19
text: And the sound of the trumpet increased and became exceeding loud; Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

title: Exodus 19:20
text: And Jehovah came down on mount Sinai, on the top of the mountain; and Jehovah called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

title: Exodus 19:21
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Go down, testify to the people that they break not through to Jehovah to gaze, and many of them perish.

title: Exodus 19:22
text: And the priests also, who come near to Jehovah, shall hallow themselves, lest Jehovah break forth on them.

title: Exodus 19:23
text: And Moses said to Jehovah, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai; for thou hast testified to us, saying, Set bounds about the mountain, and hallow it.

title: Exodus 19:24
text: And Jehovah said to him, Go, descend, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee; but the priests and the people shall not break through to go up to Jehovah, lest he break forth on them.

title: Exodus 19:25
text: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

title: Exodus 20:1
text: ¶And God spoke all these words, saying,

title: Exodus 20:2
text: I am Jehovah thy God, who have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Exodus 20:3
text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

title: Exodus 20:4
text: Thou shalt not make thyself any graven image, or any form of what is in the heavens above, or what is in the earth beneath, or what is in the waters under the earth:

title: Exodus 20:5
text: thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them; for I, Jehovah thy God, am a jealous *God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and to the fourth [generation] of them that hate me,

title: Exodus 20:6
text: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

title: Exodus 20:7
text: Thou shalt not idly utter the name of Jehovah thy God; for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that idly uttereth his name.

title: Exodus 20:8
text: Remember the sabbath day to hallow it.

title: Exodus 20:9
text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work;

title: Exodus 20:10
text: but the seventh day is the sabbath of Jehovah thy God: thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy bondman, nor thy handmaid, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates.

title: Exodus 20:11
text: For in six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested on the seventh day; therefore Jehovah blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

title: Exodus 20:12
text: ¶Honour thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be prolonged in the land that Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

title: Exodus 20:13
text: Thou shalt not kill.

title: Exodus 20:14
text: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

title: Exodus 20:15
text: Thou shalt not steal.

title: Exodus 20:16
text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

title: Exodus 20:17
text: Thou shalt not desire thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not desire thy neighbour's wife, nor his bondman, nor his handmaid, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that is thy neighbour's.

title: Exodus 20:18
text: ¶And all the people saw the thunderings, and the flames, and the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking; and when the people saw [it], they trembled, and stood afar off,

title: Exodus 20:19
text: and said to Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

title: Exodus 20:20
text: And Moses said to the people, Fear not; for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before you, that ye sin not.

title: Exodus 20:21
text: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near to the obscurity where God was.

title: Exodus 20:22
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Thus shalt thou say to the children of Israel: Ye have seen that I have spoken with you from the heavens.

title: Exodus 20:23
text: Ye shall not make beside me gods of silver, and ye shall not make to you gods of gold.

title: Exodus 20:24
text: An altar of earth shalt thou make unto me, and shalt sacrifice on it thy burnt-offerings, and thy peace-offerings, thy sheep and thine oxen: in all places where I shall make my name to be remembered, I will come unto thee, and bless thee.

title: Exodus 20:25
text: And if thou make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone; for if thou lift up thy sharp tool upon it, thou hast profaned it.

title: Exodus 20:26
text: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

title: Exodus 21:1
text: ¶And these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

title: Exodus 21:2
text: If thou buy a Hebrew bondman, six years shall he serve; and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

title: Exodus 21:3
text: If he came in alone, he shall go out alone: if he had a wife, then his wife shall go out with him.

title: Exodus 21:4
text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have borne him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out alone.

title: Exodus 21:5
text: But if the bondman shall say distinctly, I love my master, my wife, and my children, I will not go free;

title: Exodus 21:6
text: then his master shall bring him before the judges, and shall bring him to the door, or to the door-post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall be his bondman for ever.

title: Exodus 21:7
text: And if a man shall sell his daughter as a handmaid, she shall not go out as the bondmen go out.

title: Exodus 21:8
text: If she is unacceptable in the eyes of her master, who had taken her for himself, then shall he let her be ransomed: to sell her unto a foreign people he hath no power, after having dealt unfaithfully with her.

title: Exodus 21:9
text: And if he have appointed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the law of daughters.

title: Exodus 21:10
text: If he take himself another, her food, her clothing, and her conjugal rights he shall not diminish.

title: Exodus 21:11
text: And if he do not these three things unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

title: Exodus 21:12
text: ¶He that striketh a man, so that he die, shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 21:13
text: But if he have not lain in wait, and God have delivered [him] into his hand, I will appoint thee a place to which he shall flee.

title: Exodus 21:14
text: But if a man act wantonly toward his neighbour, and slay him with guile, thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

title: Exodus 21:15
text: And he that striketh his father, or his mother, shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 21:16
text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 21:17
text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 21:18
text: And if men dispute, and one strike the other with a stone, or with the fist, and he die not, but take to [his] bed,

title: Exodus 21:19
text: --if he rise, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that struck [him] be guiltless; only he shall pay [for] the loss of his time, and shall cause [him] to be thoroughly healed.

title: Exodus 21:20
text: And if a man strike his bondman or his handmaid with a staff, and he die under his hand, he shall certainly be avenged.

title: Exodus 21:21
text: Only, if he continue [to live] a day or two days, he shall not be avenged; for he is his money.

title: Exodus 21:22
text: ¶And if men strive together, and strike a woman with child, so that she be delivered, and no mischief happen, he shall in any case be fined, according as the woman's husband shall impose on him, and shall give it as the judges estimate.

title: Exodus 21:23
text: But if mischief happen, then thou shalt give life for life,

title: Exodus 21:24
text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

title: Exodus 21:25
text: branding for branding, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

title: Exodus 21:26
text: And if a man strike the eye of his bondman or the eye of his handmaid, and it be marred, he shall let him go for his eye.

title: Exodus 21:27
text: And if he knock out his bondman's tooth or his handmaid's tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth.

title: Exodus 21:28
text: And if an ox gore a man or a woman, so that they die, then the ox shall certainly be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be guiltless.

title: Exodus 21:29
text: But if the ox have gored heretofore, and it have been testified to its owner, and he have not kept it in, and it kill a man or a woman, --the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.

title: Exodus 21:30
text: If there be imposed on him a satisfaction, then he shall give the ransom of his life, according to what is imposed on him.

title: Exodus 21:31
text: Whether it gore a son or gore a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done to him.

title: Exodus 21:32
text: If the ox gore a bondman or a handmaid, he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

title: Exodus 21:33
text: --And if a man open a pit, or if a man dig a pit, and do not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall into it,

title: Exodus 21:34
text: the owner of the pit shall make it good, shall give money to the owner of them; and the dead [ox] shall be his.

title: Exodus 21:35
text: --And if one man's ox gore his neighbour's ox, and it die, then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money thereof, and divide the dead also.

title: Exodus 21:36
text: Or if it be known that the ox have gored heretofore, and its owner have not kept him in, he shall in any case restore ox for ox; and the dead shall be his.

title: Exodus 22:1
text: ¶If a man steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it, he shall restore five oxen for the ox, and four sheep for the sheep.

title: Exodus 22:2
text: If the thief be encountered breaking in, and be smitten so that he die, there shall be no blood-guiltiness for him.

title: Exodus 22:3
text: If the sun be risen on him, there shall be blood-guiltiness for him; he should have made full restitution: if he had nothing, he would have been sold for his theft.

title: Exodus 22:4
text: If the stolen thing be actually found alive in his hand, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep, he shall restore double.

title: Exodus 22:5
text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and put in his cattle, and pasture in another man's field, of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard shall he make [it] good.

title: Exodus 22:6
text: --If fire break out, and seize the thorns, and the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field be consumed, he that kindled the fire shall fully make it good.

title: Exodus 22:7
text: ¶--If a man deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him restore double;

title: Exodus 22:8
text: if the thief be not found, the master of the house shall be brought before the judges, [to see] if he has not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

title: Exodus 22:9
text: As to all manner of fraud, --as to ox, as to ass, as to sheep, as to clothing, as to everything lost, of which [a man] saith, It is this--the cause of both parties shall come before the judges: he whom the judges shall condemn shall restore double to his neighbour.

title: Exodus 22:10
text: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any cattle, to keep, and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, and no man see [it],

title: Exodus 22:11
text: an oath of Jehovah shall be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept it, and he shall not make [it] good.

title: Exodus 22:12
text: But if it have been stolen from him, he shall make [it] good unto its owner.

title: Exodus 22:13
text: If it have been torn in pieces, let him bring it [as] witness: he shall not make good what was torn.

title: Exodus 22:14
text: --And if a man borrow anything of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, its owner not being with it, he shall fully make it good;

title: Exodus 22:15
text: if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make [it] good; if it be a hired [thing], it came for its hire.

title: Exodus 22:16
text: ¶And if a man seduce a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall certainly endow her, to be his wife.

title: Exodus 22:17
text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall weigh money according to the dowry of virgins.

title: Exodus 22:18
text: --Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

title: Exodus 22:19
text: --Every one that lieth with a beast shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 22:20
text: --He that sacrificeth to [any] god, save to Jehovah only, shall be devoted to destruction.

title: Exodus 22:21
text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him; for ye have been strangers in the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 22:22
text: Ye shall not afflict any widow or fatherless child.

title: Exodus 22:23
text: If thou afflict him in any way, if he cry at all unto me, I will certainly hear his cry;

title: Exodus 22:24
text: and my anger shall burn, and I will slay you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

title: Exodus 22:25
text: ¶--If thou lend money to my people, the poor with thee, thou shalt not be to him as a usurer: ye shall charge him no interest.

title: Exodus 22:26
text: --If thou at all take thy neighbour's garment in pledge, thou shalt return it to him before the sun goes down;

title: Exodus 22:27
text: for that is his only covering, his garment for his skin: on what shall he lie down? And it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

title: Exodus 22:28
text: Thou shalt not revile the judges, nor curse a prince amongst thy people.

title: Exodus 22:29
text: --Thou shalt not delay the fulness of thy [threshing-floor] and the outflow of thy [winepress]. The firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

title: Exodus 22:30
text: Likewise shalt thou do with thy calf, with thy sheep: seven days shall it be with its dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

title: Exodus 22:31
text: --And ye shall be holy men unto me; and ye shall not eat flesh torn in the field: ye shall cast it to the dog.

title: Exodus 23:1
text: ¶Thou shalt not accept a false report; extend not thy hand to the wicked, to be an unrighteous witness.

title: Exodus 23:2
text: Thou shalt not follow the multitude for evil; neither shalt thou answer in a cause, to go after the multitude to pervert [judgment].

title: Exodus 23:3
text: Neither shalt thou favour a poor man in his cause.

title: Exodus 23:4
text: --If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt certainly bring it back to him.

title: Exodus 23:5
text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under its burden, beware of leaving [it] to him: thou shalt certainly loosen [it] with him.

title: Exodus 23:6
text: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

title: Exodus 23:7
text: Thou shalt keep far from the cause of falsehood; and the innocent and righteous slay not; for I will not justify the wicked.

title: Exodus 23:8
text: And thou shalt take no bribe; for the bribe blindeth those whose eyes are open, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

title: Exodus 23:9
text: And the stranger thou shalt not oppress; for ye know the spirit of the stranger, for ye have been strangers in the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 23:10
text: ¶And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and gather in its produce;

title: Exodus 23:11
text: but in the seventh thou shalt let it rest and lie [fallow], that the poor of thy people may eat [of it]; and what they leave, the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thine olive-tree.

title: Exodus 23:12
text: --Six days thou shalt do thy work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger may be refreshed.

title: Exodus 23:13
text: And ye shall be on your guard as to everything that I have said unto you; and shall make no mention of the name of other gods--it shall not be heard in thy mouth.

title: Exodus 23:14
text: Thrice in the year thou shalt celebrate a feast to me.

title: Exodus 23:15
text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread, (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I have commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt; and none shall appear in my presence empty;)

title: Exodus 23:16
text: and the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labours which thou hast sown in the field, and the feast of in-gathering, at the end of the year, when thou gatherest in thy labours out of the field.

title: Exodus 23:17
text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear in the presence of the Lord Jehovah.

title: Exodus 23:18
text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my feast remain all night until the morning.

title: Exodus 23:19
text: The first of the first-fruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Exodus 23:20
text: ¶Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee to the place that I have prepared.

title: Exodus 23:21
text: Be careful in his presence, and hearken unto his voice: do not provoke him, for he will not forgive your transgressions; for my name is in him.

title: Exodus 23:22
text: But if thou shalt diligently hearken unto his voice, and do all that I shall say, then I will be an enemy to thine enemies, and an adversary to thine adversaries.

title: Exodus 23:23
text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.

title: Exodus 23:24
text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their deeds; but thou shalt utterly destroy them, and utterly shatter their statues.

title: Exodus 23:25
text: And ye shall serve Jehovah your God; and he shall bless thy bread and thy water; and I will take sickness away from thy midst.

title: Exodus 23:26
text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land; the number of thy days will I fulfil.

title: Exodus 23:27
text: I will send my fear before thee, and confound every people to which thou comest, and will make all thine enemies turn their back to thee.

title: Exodus 23:28
text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

title: Exodus 23:29
text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year: lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

title: Exodus 23:30
text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou art fruitful, and possess the land.

title: Exodus 23:31
text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red Sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness unto the river; for I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hand, that thou mayest dispossess them from before thee.

title: Exodus 23:32
text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

title: Exodus 23:33
text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me; for if thou serve their gods, it is sure to be a snare unto thee.

title: Exodus 24:1
text: ¶And he said to Moses, Go up to Jehovah, thou and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship afar off.

title: Exodus 24:2
text: And let Moses alone come near Jehovah; but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.

title: Exodus 24:3
text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words that Jehovah has said will we do!

title: Exodus 24:4
text: And Moses wrote all the words of Jehovah, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Exodus 24:5
text: And he sent the youths of the children of Israel, and they offered up burnt-offerings, and sacrificed sacrifices of peace-offering of bullocks to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 24:6
text: And Moses took half the blood, and put [it] in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

title: Exodus 24:7
text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read [it] in the ears of the people; and they said, All that Jehovah has said will we do, and obey!

title: Exodus 24:8
text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled [it] on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant that Jehovah has made with you concerning all these words.

title: Exodus 24:9
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up;

title: Exodus 24:10
text: and they saw the God of Israel; and there was under his feet as it were work of transparent sapphire, and as it were the form of heaven for clearness.

title: Exodus 24:11
text: And on the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: they saw God, and ate and drank.

title: Exodus 24:12
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Come up to me into the mountain, and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, and the law, and the commandment that I have written, for their instruction.

title: Exodus 24:13
text: And Moses rose up, and Joshua his attendant; and Moses went up to the mountain of God.

title: Exodus 24:14
text: And he said to the elders, Wait here for us, until we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matter, let him come before them.

title: Exodus 24:15
text: And Moses went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

title: Exodus 24:16
text: And the glory of Jehovah abode on mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days; and on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

title: Exodus 24:17
text: And the appearance of the glory of Jehovah was like a consuming fire on the top of the mountain, before the eyes of the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 24:18
text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and ascended the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

title: Exodus 25:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 25:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me a heave-offering: of every one whose heart prompteth him, ye shall take my heave-offering.

title: Exodus 25:3
text: And this is the heave-offering that ye shall take of them: gold, and silver, and copper,

title: Exodus 25:4
text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and byssus, and goats' [hair],

title: Exodus 25:5
text: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins; and acacia-wood;

title: Exodus 25:6
text: oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil, and for the incense of fragrant drugs;

title: Exodus 25:7
text: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

title: Exodus 25:8
text: And they shall make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

title: Exodus 25:9
text: According to all that I shall shew thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the utensils thereof, even so shall ye make [it].

title: Exodus 25:10
text: ¶And they shall make an ark of acacia-wood; two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

title: Exodus 25:11
text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold: inside and outside shalt thou overlay it; and shalt make upon it a border of gold round about.

title: Exodus 25:12
text: And cast four rings of gold for it, and put [them] at the four corners thereof, that two rings may be upon the one side thereof and two rings upon the other side thereof.

title: Exodus 25:13
text: And make staves of acacia-wood and overlay them with gold.

title: Exodus 25:14
text: And put the staves into the rings upon the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

title: Exodus 25:15
text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not come out from it.

title: Exodus 25:16
text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony that I shall give thee.

title: Exodus 25:17
text: And thou shalt make a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

title: Exodus 25:18
text: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold; [of] beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat.

title: Exodus 25:19
text: And make one cherub at the end of the one side, and one cherub at the end of the other side; out of the mercy-seat shall ye make the cherubim at the two ends thereof.

title: Exodus 25:20
text: And the cherubim shall stretch out [their] wings over it, covering over with their wings the mercy-seat, and their faces opposite to one another: toward the mercy-seat shall the faces of the cherubim be [turned].

title: Exodus 25:21
text: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat above on the ark, and shalt put in the ark the testimony that I shall give thee.

title: Exodus 25:22
text: And there will I meet with thee, and will speak with thee from above the mercy-seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, everything that I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 25:23
text: ¶And thou shalt make a table of acacia-wood, two cubits the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

title: Exodus 25:24
text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make upon it a border of gold round about.

title: Exodus 25:25
text: And thou shalt make for it a margin of a handbreadth round about, and shalt make a border of gold for the margin thereof round about.

title: Exodus 25:26
text: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings at the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

title: Exodus 25:27
text: Close to the margin shall the rings be, as receptacles of the staves to carry the table.

title: Exodus 25:28
text: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold; and the table shall be carried upon them.

title: Exodus 25:29
text: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and cups thereof, and goblets thereof, and bowls thereof, with which to pour out: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

title: Exodus 25:30
text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me continually.

title: Exodus 25:31
text: ¶And thou shalt make a lamp-stand of pure gold; [of] beaten work shall the lamp-stand be made: its base and its shaft, its cups, its knobs, and its flowers shall be of the same.

title: Exodus 25:32
text: And six branches shall come out of the sides thereof--three branches of the lamp-stand out of one side thereof, and three branches of the lamp-stand out of the other side thereof;

title: Exodus 25:33
text: three cups shaped like almonds in the one branch, a knob and a flower: and three cups shaped like almonds in the other branch, a knob and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the lamp-stand.

title: Exodus 25:34
text: And in the lamp-stand four cups shaped like almonds, its knobs and its flowers;

title: Exodus 25:35
text: and a knob under two branches of it, and [again] a knob under two branches of it, and [again] a knob under two branches of it, for the six branches that proceed out of the lamp-stand.

title: Exodus 25:36
text: Their knobs and their branches shall be of itself--all of one beaten work of pure gold.

title: Exodus 25:37
text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof, and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may shine out before it;

title: Exodus 25:38
text: and the snuffers thereof, and the snuff-trays thereof, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 25:39
text: Of a talent of pure gold shall they make it, with all these utensils.

title: Exodus 25:40
text: And see that thou make [them] according to their pattern, which hath been shewn to thee in the mountain.

title: Exodus 26:1
text: ¶And thou shalt make the tabernacle [with] ten curtains of twined byssus, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubim of artistic work shalt thou make them.

title: Exodus 26:2
text: The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits--one measure for all the curtains.

title: Exodus 26:3
text: Five of the curtains shall be coupled one to another, and [the other] five curtains coupled one to another.

title: Exodus 26:4
text: And thou shalt make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain at the end of the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make [them] in the edge of the outermost curtain in the other coupling.

title: Exodus 26:5
text: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make at the end of the curtain in the other coupling: the loops shall be opposite to one another.

title: Exodus 26:6
text: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains together with the clasps, that the tabernacle may be one [whole].

title: Exodus 26:7
text: ¶And thou shalt make curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make them.

title: Exodus 26:8
text: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits--one measure for the eleven curtains.

title: Exodus 26:9
text: And thou shalt couple five of the curtains by themselves, and six of the curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the front of the tent.

title: Exodus 26:10
text: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain of the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the other coupling.

title: Exodus 26:11
text: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of copper, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent, that it may be one [whole].

title: Exodus 26:12
text: And that which remaineth hanging over of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the rear of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 26:13
text: And the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

title: Exodus 26:14
text: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins over [that].

title: Exodus 26:15
text: ¶And the boards for the tabernacle thou shalt make of acacia-wood, standing up;

title: Exodus 26:16
text: ten cubits the length of the board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of one board.

title: Exodus 26:17
text: One board shall have two tenons, connected one with the other: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 26:18
text: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

title: Exodus 26:19
text: And thou shalt make forty bases of silver under the twenty boards; two bases under one board for its two tenons, and two bases under another board for its two tenons.

title: Exodus 26:20
text: And for the other side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards.

title: Exodus 26:21
text: And their forty bases of silver; two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.

title: Exodus 26:22
text: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

title: Exodus 26:23
text: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear;

title: Exodus 26:24
text: and they shall be joined beneath, and together shall be united at the top thereof to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

title: Exodus 26:25
text: And there shall be eight boards, and their bases, of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.

title: Exodus 26:26
text: And thou shalt make bars of acacia-wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

title: Exodus 26:27
text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward;

title: Exodus 26:28
text: and the middle bar in the midst of the boards reaching from one end to the other.

title: Exodus 26:29
text: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make [of] gold their rings, the receptacles of the bars, and shalt overlay the bars with gold.

title: Exodus 26:30
text: And thou shalt set up the tabernacle according to its fashion, as hath been shewn thee on the mountain.

title: Exodus 26:31
text: ¶And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus; of artistic work shall it be made, with cherubim.

title: Exodus 26:32
text: And thou shalt attach it to four pillars of acacia-wood overlaid with gold, their hooks of gold; they shall be on four bases of silver.

title: Exodus 26:33
text: And thou shalt bring the veil under the clasps, and bring in thither, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony; and the curtain shall make a division to you between the holy [place] and the holiest of all.

title: Exodus 26:34
text: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat on the ark of the testimony in the holiest of all.

title: Exodus 26:35
text: And thou shalt set the table outside the veil, and the lamp-stand opposite to the table on the side of the tabernacle southward; and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

title: Exodus 26:36
text: And thou shalt make for the entrance of the tent a curtain of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus, of embroidery.

title: Exodus 26:37
text: And thou shalt make for the curtain five pillars of acacia[ -wood], and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold; and thou shalt cast five bases of copper for them.

title: Exodus 27:1
text: ¶And thou shalt make the altar of acacia-wood, five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth; the altar shall be square; and the height thereof three cubits.

title: Exodus 27:2
text: And thou shalt make its horns at the four corners thereof; its horns shall be of itself; and thou shalt overlay it with copper.

title: Exodus 27:3
text: And thou shalt make its pots to cleanse it of the fat, its shovels, and its bowls, and its forks, and its firepans; for all the utensils thereof thou shalt employ copper.

title: Exodus 27:4
text: And thou shalt make for it a grating of network of copper; and on the net shalt thou make four copper rings at its four corners;

title: Exodus 27:5
text: and thou shalt put it under the ledge of the altar beneath, and the net shall be to the very middle of the altar.

title: Exodus 27:6
text: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with copper.

title: Exodus 27:7
text: And its staves shall be put into the rings, that the staves may be on both sides of the altar, when it is carried.

title: Exodus 27:8
text: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it hath been shewn thee on the mountain, so shall they make [it].

title: Exodus 27:9
text: ¶And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle. On the south side, southward, hangings for the court of twined byssus; a hundred cubits the length for the one side,

title: Exodus 27:10
text: and the twenty pillars thereof, and their twenty bases of copper, the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 27:11
text: And likewise on the north side in length, hangings a hundred [cubits] long, and its twenty pillars, and their twenty bases of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 27:12
text: --And the breadth of the court on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten.

title: Exodus 27:13
text: --And the breadth of the court on the east side, eastward, fifty cubits;

title: Exodus 27:14
text: the hangings on the one wing, of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their bases three.

title: Exodus 27:15
text: And on the other wing hangings of fifteen [cubits]; their pillars three, and their bases three.

title: Exodus 27:16
text: --And for the gate of the court a curtain of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus, embroidered with needlework; their pillars four, and their bases four.

title: Exodus 27:17
text: All the pillars of the court round about shall be fastened together with [rods of] silver; their hooks of silver, and their bases of copper.

title: Exodus 27:18
text: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty everywhere, and the height five cubits of twined byssus; and their bases of copper.

title: Exodus 27:19
text: All the utensils of the tabernacle for the service thereof and all the pegs thereof, and all the pegs of the court shall be of copper.

title: Exodus 27:20
text: ¶And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee olive oil, pure, beaten, for the light, to light the lamp continually.

title: Exodus 27:21
text: In the tent of meeting outside the veil, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall dress them from evening to morning before Jehovah: [it is] an everlasting statute, for their generations, on the part of the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 28:1
text: ¶And thou shalt take thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may serve me as priest--Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

title: Exodus 28:2
text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for glory and for ornament.

title: Exodus 28:3
text: And thou shalt speak with all [that are] wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to hallow him, that he may serve me as priest.

title: Exodus 28:4
text: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a cloak, and a checkered vest, a turban, and a girdle; and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may serve me as priest.

title: Exodus 28:5
text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus,

title: Exodus 28:6
text: ¶and shall make the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, scarlet and twined byssus, of artistic work.

title: Exodus 28:7
text: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined at the two ends thereof, where it is joined together.

title: Exodus 28:8
text: And the girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to its work of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet and twined byssus.

title: Exodus 28:9
text: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel:

title: Exodus 28:10
text: six of their names on the one stone, and the six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

title: Exodus 28:11
text: According to the work of an engraver in stone, as the engravings of a seal, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel; surrounded by enclosures of gold shalt thou make them.

title: Exodus 28:12
text: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulder-pieces of the ephod [as] stones of memorial for the children of Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names before Jehovah upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

title: Exodus 28:13
text: And thou shalt make enclosures of gold;

title: Exodus 28:14
text: and two chains of pure gold; of laced work shalt thou make them, of wreathen work, and fasten the wreathen chains to the enclosures.

title: Exodus 28:15
text: ¶And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment of artistic work, like the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus shalt thou make it.

title: Exodus 28:16
text: Square shall it be, doubled; a span the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.

title: Exodus 28:17
text: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones--four rows of stones: [one] row, a sardoin, a topaz, and an emerald--the first row;

title: Exodus 28:18
text: and the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;

title: Exodus 28:19
text: and the third row, an opal, an agate, and an amethyst;

title: Exodus 28:20
text: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, and an onyx, and a jasper; enclosed in gold shall they be in their settings.

title: Exodus 28:21
text: And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, engraved as a seal: every one according to his name shall they be for the twelve tribes.

title: Exodus 28:22
text: And thou shalt make on the breastplate chains of laced work, of wreathen work, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 28:23
text: And thou shalt make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

title: Exodus 28:24
text: And thou shalt put the two wreathen [cords] of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate;

title: Exodus 28:25
text: and the two ends of the two wreathen [cords] thou shalt fasten to the two enclosures, and shalt put [them] on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, on the front thereof.

title: Exodus 28:26
text: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and shalt put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the border thereof, which faceth the ephod inwards.

title: Exodus 28:27
text: And two rings of gold shalt thou make, and shalt put them upon the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, to the front thereof just by the coupling thereof, above the girdle of the ephod.

title: Exodus 28:28
text: And they shall bind the breastplate with its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

title: Exodus 28:29
text: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.

title: Exodus 28:30
text: And thou shalt put into the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim, that they may be upon Aaron's heart when he goeth in before Jehovah; and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before Jehovah continually.

title: Exodus 28:31
text: ¶And thou shalt make the cloak of the ephod all of blue.

title: Exodus 28:32
text: And its opening for the head shall be in the midst thereof; there shall be a binding of woven work at its opening round about; as the opening of a coat of mail, it shall be in it--it shall not rend.

title: Exodus 28:33
text: And on the skirts thereof thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, round about the skirts thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

title: Exodus 28:34
text: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, in the skirts of the cloak round about.

title: Exodus 28:35
text: And it shall be on Aaron for service; that his sound may be heard when he goeth into the sanctuary before Jehovah, and when he cometh out, that he may not die.

title: Exodus 28:36
text: And thou shalt make a thin plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, as the engravings of a seal, Holiness to Jehovah!

title: Exodus 28:37
text: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the turban--upon the front of the turban shall it be.

title: Exodus 28:38
text: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all gifts of their holy things; and it shall be continually on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.

title: Exodus 28:39
text: And thou shalt weave the vest of byssus; and thou shalt make a turban of byssus; and thou shalt make a girdle of embroidery.

title: Exodus 28:40
text: ¶And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make vests; and thou shalt make for them girdles; and high caps shalt thou make for them, for glory and for ornament.

title: Exodus 28:41
text: And thou shalt clothe with them Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and hallow them, that they may serve me as priests.

title: Exodus 28:42
text: And thou shalt make them linen trousers to cover the flesh of nakedness; from the loins even to the hips shall they reach.

title: Exodus 28:43
text: And they shall be upon Aaron and his sons when they enter into the tent of meeting, or when they come near to the altar to serve in the sanctuary; that they may not bear iniquity and die--an everlasting statute for him and his seed after him.

title: Exodus 29:1
text: ¶And this is the thing which thou shalt do to them to hallow them, that they may serve me as priests: take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

title: Exodus 29:2
text: and unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil--of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

title: Exodus 29:3
text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and present them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

title: Exodus 29:4
text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring near the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shalt bathe them with water.

title: Exodus 29:5
text: And thou shalt take the garments, and clothe Aaron with the vest, and the cloak of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and shalt gird him with the girdle of the ephod.

title: Exodus 29:6
text: And thou shalt put the turban upon his head, and fasten the holy diadem to the turban,

title: Exodus 29:7
text: and shalt take the anointing oil, and pour [it] on his head, and anoint him.

title: Exodus 29:8
text: And thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with the vests.

title: Exodus 29:9
text: And thou shalt gird them with the girdle--Aaron and his sons, and bind the high caps on them; and the priesthood shall be theirs for an everlasting statute; and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

title: Exodus 29:10
text: And thou shalt present the bullock before the tent of meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock;

title: Exodus 29:11
text: and thou shalt slaughter the bullock before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting;

title: Exodus 29:12
text: and thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger, and shalt pour all the blood at the bottom of the altar.

title: Exodus 29:13
text: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

title: Exodus 29:14
text: And the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire outside the camp: it is a sin-offering.

title: Exodus 29:15
text: And thou shalt take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram;

title: Exodus 29:16
text: and thou shalt slaughter the ram, and shalt take its blood, and sprinkle [it] on the altar round about.

title: Exodus 29:17
text: And thou shalt cut up the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put [them] upon its pieces, and upon its head;

title: Exodus 29:18
text: and thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering to Jehovah--a sweet odour; it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 29:19
text: And thou shalt take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram;

title: Exodus 29:20
text: and thou shalt slaughter the ram, and take of its blood, and put [it] on the tip of the [right] ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and thou shalt sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

title: Exodus 29:21
text: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle [it] on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

title: Exodus 29:22
text: Also of the ram shalt thou take the fat, and the fat-tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder--for it is a ram of consecration--

title: Exodus 29:23
text: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened [bread] that is before Jehovah;

title: Exodus 29:24
text: and thou shalt put all this in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons, and shalt wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Exodus 29:25
text: And thou shalt receive them of their hand and burn [them] upon the altar over the burnt-offering, for a sweet odour before Jehovah: it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 29:26
text: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of consecration which is for Aaron, and wave it as a wave-offering before Jehovah; and it shall be thy part.

title: Exodus 29:27
text: And thou shalt hallow the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the heave-offering, that hath been waved and heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aaron, and of [that] which is for his sons.

title: Exodus 29:28
text: And they shall be for Aaron and his sons, as an everlasting statute, on the part of the children of Israel; for it is a heave-offering; and it shall be a heave-offering on the part of the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, [as] their heave-offering to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 29:29
text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

title: Exodus 29:30
text: The son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tent of meeting to serve in the sanctuary.

title: Exodus 29:31
text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and boil its flesh in a holy place.

title: Exodus 29:32
text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 29:33
text: They shall eat the things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate [and] to hallow them; but a stranger shall not eat [of them], for they are holy.

title: Exodus 29:34
text: And if [any] of the flesh of the consecration, and of the bread, remain until the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, for it is holy.

title: Exodus 29:35
text: And thus shalt thou do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

title: Exodus 29:36
text: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock as a sin-offering for atonement; and the altar shalt thou cleanse from sin, by making atonement for it, and shalt anoint it, to hallow it.

title: Exodus 29:37
text: Seven days shalt thou make atonement for the altar and hallow it; and the altar shall be most holy: whatever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

title: Exodus 29:38
text: ¶And this is what thou shalt offer upon the altar--two lambs of the first year, day by day continually.

title: Exodus 29:39
text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings.

title: Exodus 29:40
text: And with the one lamb a tenth part of wheaten flour mingled with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin; and a drink-offering, a fourth part of a hin of wine.

title: Exodus 29:41
text: And the second lamb shalt thou offer between the two evenings; as the oblation in the morning, and as its drink-offering shalt thou offer with this, for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 29:42
text: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah, where I will meet with you, to speak there with thee.

title: Exodus 29:43
text: And there will I meet with the children of Israel; and it shall be hallowed by my glory.

title: Exodus 29:44
text: And I will hallow the tent of meeting, and the altar; and I will hallow Aaron and his sons, that they may serve me as priests.

title: Exodus 29:45
text: And I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel, and will be their God.

title: Exodus 29:46
text: And they shall know that I am Jehovah their God, who have brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, to dwell in their midst: I am Jehovah their God.

title: Exodus 30:1
text: ¶And thou shalt make an altar for the burning of incense: of acacia-wood shalt thou make it;

title: Exodus 30:2
text: a cubit the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof--square shall it be; and two cubits its height; of itself shall be its horns.

title: Exodus 30:3
text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make upon it a border of gold round about.

title: Exodus 30:4
text: And two rings of gold shalt thou make for it under its border; by its two corners shalt thou make [them], on the two sides thereof; and they shall be for receptacles for the staves, with which to carry it.

title: Exodus 30:5
text: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold.

title: Exodus 30:6
text: And thou shalt put it in front of the veil which is before the ark of the testimony in front of the mercy-seat which is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

title: Exodus 30:7
text: And Aaron shall burn thereon fragrant incense: every morning, when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn the incense.

title: Exodus 30:8
text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps between the two evenings, he shall burn the incense--a continual incense before Jehovah throughout your generations.

title: Exodus 30:9
text: Ye shall offer up no strange incense thereon, nor burnt-offering, nor oblation; neither shall ye pour drink-offering thereon.

title: Exodus 30:10
text: And Aaron shall make atonement for its horns once in the year: with the blood of the sin-offering of atonement shall he make atonement for it, once in the year, throughout your generations: it is most holy to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 30:11
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 30:12
text: When thou shalt take the sum of the children of Israel according to those of them that are numbered, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to Jehovah on their being numbered, that there be no plague among them on their being numbered.

title: Exodus 30:13
text: This shall they give--every one that passeth among them that are numbered--half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary, --twenty gerahs the shekel; a half shekel shall be the heave-offering for Jehovah.

title: Exodus 30:14
text: Every one that passeth among those that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give the heave-offering of Jehovah.

title: Exodus 30:15
text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when ye give the heave-offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.

title: Exodus 30:16
text: And thou shalt take the atonement-money of the children of Israel, and devote it to the service of the tent of meeting; and it shall be a memorial to the children of Israel before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.

title: Exodus 30:17
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 30:18
text: Thou shalt also make a laver of copper, and its stand of copper, for washing; and thou shalt put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water in it.

title: Exodus 30:19
text: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet out of it.

title: Exodus 30:20
text: When they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, that they may not die; or when they come near to the altar to serve, to burn an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 30:21
text: And they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they may not die; and it shall be an everlasting statute for them, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.

title: Exodus 30:22
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 30:23
text: And thou, take best spices--of liquid myrrh five hundred [shekels], and of sweet cinnamon the half--two hundred and fifty, and of sweet myrtle two hundred and fifty,

title: Exodus 30:24
text: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin;

title: Exodus 30:25
text: and make of it an oil of holy ointment, a perfume of perfumery after the work of the perfumer: it shall be the holy anointing oil.

title: Exodus 30:26
text: And thou shalt anoint the tent of meeting with it, and the ark of the testimony,

title: Exodus 30:27
text: and the table and all its utensils, and the lamp-stand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

title: Exodus 30:28
text: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its utensils, and the laver and its stand.

title: Exodus 30:29
text: And thou shalt hallow them, that they may be most holy: whatever toucheth them shall be holy.

title: Exodus 30:30
text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt anoint, and shalt hallow them, that they may serve me as priests.

title: Exodus 30:31
text: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, A holy anointing oil shall this be unto me throughout your generations.

title: Exodus 30:32
text: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make [any] like it, after the preparation of it: it is holy--holy shall it be unto you.

title: Exodus 30:33
text: Whoever compoundeth [any] like it, or whoever putteth [any] of it upon any strange thing, shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Exodus 30:34
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take fragrant drugs--stacte, and onycha, and galbanum--fragrant drugs and pure frankincense; in like proportions shall it be.

title: Exodus 30:35
text: And thou shalt make it into incense, a perfume, after the work of the perfumer, salted, pure, holy.

title: Exodus 30:36
text: And thou shalt beat [some] of it to powder, and put [some] of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

title: Exodus 30:37
text: And the incense that thou shalt make, ye shall not make for yourselves according to the proportions of it; it shall be unto thee holy to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 30:38
text: Whoever maketh like unto it, to smell it, shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Exodus 31:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 31:2
text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

title: Exodus 31:3
text: and have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in every work,

title: Exodus 31:4
text: to devise artistic work--to work in gold, and in silver, and in copper,

title: Exodus 31:5
text: and in cutting of stones, for setting, and for carving of timber--to work in all manner of work.

title: Exodus 31:6
text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of every one that is wise-hearted have I given wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee--

title: Exodus 31:7
text: the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy-seat that is thereupon, and all the utensils of the tent,

title: Exodus 31:8
text: and the table and its utensils, and the pure lamp-stand and all its utensils, and the altar of incense;

title: Exodus 31:9
text: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its utensils, and the laver and its stand;

title: Exodus 31:10
text: and the garments of service, both the holy garments of Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests;

title: Exodus 31:11
text: and the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs for the sanctuary: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

title: Exodus 31:12
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 31:13
text: And thou, speak thou unto the children of Israel, saying, Surely my sabbaths shall ye keep; for this is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that ye may know that it is I, Jehovah, who do hallow you.

title: Exodus 31:14
text: Keep the sabbath, therefore; for it is holy unto you; every one that profaneth it shall certainly be put to death: yea, whoever doeth work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his peoples.

title: Exodus 31:15
text: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, holy to Jehovah: whoever doeth work on the sabbath day shall certainly be put to death.

title: Exodus 31:16
text: And the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations--[it is] an everlasting covenant.

title: Exodus 31:17
text: It shall be a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever; for [in] six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

title: Exodus 31:18
text: And he gave to Moses, when he had ended speaking with him on mount Sinai, the two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

title: Exodus 32:1
text: ¶And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people collected together to Aaron, and said to him, Up, make us a god, who will go before us; for this Moses, the man that has brought us up out of the land of Egypt, --we do not know what is become of him!

title: Exodus 32:2
text: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden rings that are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring [them] to me.

title: Exodus 32:3
text: Then all the people broke off the golden rings that were in their ears, and brought [them] to Aaron.

title: Exodus 32:4
text: And he took [them] out of their hand, and fashioned it with a chisel and made of it a molten calf: and they said, This is thy god, Israel, who has brought thee up out of the land of Egypt!

title: Exodus 32:5
text: And Aaron saw [it], and built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, To-morrow is a feast to Jehovah!

title: Exodus 32:6
text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered up burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to sport.

title: Exodus 32:7
text: ¶Then Jehovah said to Moses, Away, go down! for thy people, which thou hast brought out of the land of Egypt, is acting corruptly.

title: Exodus 32:8
text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way that I commanded them: they have made themselves a molten calf, and have bowed down to it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, This is thy god, Israel, who has brought thee up out of the land of Egypt!

title: Exodus 32:9
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, I see this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.

title: Exodus 32:10
text: And now let me alone, that my anger may burn against them, and I may consume them; and I will make of thee a great nation.

title: Exodus 32:11
text: And Moses besought Jehovah his God, and said, Why, Jehovah, doth thy wrath burn against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?

title: Exodus 32:12
text: Why should the Egyptians speak, and say, For misfortune he has brought them out, to slay them on the mountains, and to annihilate them from the face of the earth? Turn from the heat of thine anger, and repent of this evil against thy people!

title: Exodus 32:13
text: Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou sworest by thyself, and saidst to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall possess [it] for ever!

title: Exodus 32:14
text: And Jehovah repented of the evil that he had said he would do to his people.

title: Exodus 32:15
text: ¶And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, [with] the two tables of the testimony in his hand--tables written on both their sides: on this side and on that were they written.

title: Exodus 32:16
text: And the tables [were] God's work, and the writing was God's writing, engraven on the tables.

title: Exodus 32:17
text: And Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, and said to Moses, There is a shout of war in the camp.

title: Exodus 32:18
text: And he said, It is not the sound of a shout of victory, neither is it the sound of a shout of defeat: it is the noise of alternate singing I hear.

title: Exodus 32:19
text: And it came to pass, when he came near the camp, and saw the calf and the dancing, that Moses' anger burned, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and shattered them beneath the mountain.

title: Exodus 32:20
text: And he took the calf that they had made, and burned [it] with fire, and ground it to powder, and strewed [it] on the water, and made the children of Israel drink [it].

title: Exodus 32:21
text: ¶And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin on them?

title: Exodus 32:22
text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord burn! thou knowest the people, that they are [set] on mischief.

title: Exodus 32:23
text: And they said to me, Make us a god, who will go before us; for this Moses, the man that has brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what is become of him!

title: Exodus 32:24
text: And I said to them, Who has gold? They broke [it] off, and gave [it] me, and I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

title: Exodus 32:25
text: And Moses saw the people how they were stripped; for Aaron had stripped them to [their] shame before their adversaries.

title: Exodus 32:26
text: And Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, He that is for Jehovah, [let him come] to me. And all the sons of Levi gathered to him.

title: Exodus 32:27
text: And he said to them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Put every man his sword upon his hip; go and return from gate to gate through the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his friend, and every man his neighbour.

title: Exodus 32:28
text: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses; and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

title: Exodus 32:29
text: And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to-day to Jehovah, yea, every man with his son, and with his brother, and bring on yourselves a blessing to-day.

title: Exodus 32:30
text: ¶And it came to pass the next day, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to Jehovah: perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.

title: Exodus 32:31
text: And Moses returned to Jehovah, and said, Alas, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made themselves a god of gold!

title: Exodus 32:32
text: And now, if thou wilt forgive their sin...but if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book that thou hast written.

title: Exodus 32:33
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Whoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

title: Exodus 32:34
text: And now go, lead the people whither I have told thee: behold, my Angel shall go before thee; but in the day of my visiting I will visit their sin upon them.

title: Exodus 32:35
text: And Jehovah smote the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron had made.

title: Exodus 33:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Depart, go up hence, thou and the people that thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, into the land that I swore unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it,

title: Exodus 33:2
text: (and I will send an angel before thee, and dispossess the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,)

title: Exodus 33:3
text: into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in the midst of thee, for thou art a stiff-necked people, --lest I consume thee on the way.

title: Exodus 33:4
text: And when the people heard this evil word, they mourned; and no man put on his ornaments.

title: Exodus 33:5
text: Now Jehovah had said to Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiff-necked people: in one moment I will come up into the midst of thee and will consume thee. And now put off thine ornaments from thee, and I will know what I will do unto thee.

title: Exodus 33:6
text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments at mount Horeb.

title: Exodus 33:7
text: ¶And Moses took the tent, and pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and called it the Tent of meeting. And it came to pass [that] every one who sought Jehovah went out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.

title: Exodus 33:8
text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose up, and stood every man at the entrance of his tent, and they looked after Moses until he entered into the tent.

title: Exodus 33:9
text: And it came to pass when Moses entered into the tent, the pillar of cloud descended, and stood at the entrance of the tent, and [Jehovah] talked with Moses.

title: Exodus 33:10
text: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent; and all the people rose and worshipped, every man at the entrance of his tent.

title: Exodus 33:11
text: And Jehovah spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. And he returned to the camp; but his attendant, Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, departed not from within the tent.

title: Exodus 33:12
text: ¶And Moses said to Jehovah, Behold, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people; but thou dost not let me know whom thou wilt send with me; and thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in mine eyes.

title: Exodus 33:13
text: And now, if indeed I have found grace in thine eyes, make me now to know thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thine eyes; and consider that this nation is thy people!

title: Exodus 33:14
text: And he said, My presence shall go, and I will give thee rest.

title: Exodus 33:15
text: And he said to him, If thy presence do not go, bring us not up hence.

title: Exodus 33:16
text: And how shall it be known then that I have found grace in thine eyes--I and thy people? [Is it] not by thy going with us? so shall we be distinguished, I and thy people, from every people that is on the face of the earth.

title: Exodus 33:17
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast said; for thou hast found grace in mine eyes, and I know thee by name.

title: Exodus 33:18
text: And he said, Let me, I pray thee, see thy glory.

title: Exodus 33:19
text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thy face, and I will proclaim the name of Jehovah before thee; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

title: Exodus 33:20
text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for Man shall not see me, and live.

title: Exodus 33:21
text: And Jehovah said, Behold, [there is] a place by me: there shalt thou stand on the rock.

title: Exodus 33:22
text: And it shall come to pass, when my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand, until I have passed by.

title: Exodus 33:23
text: And I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see me from behind; but my face shall not be seen.

title: Exodus 34:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tables of stone like the first; and I will write upon the tables the words that were upon the first tables, which thou hast broken.

title: Exodus 34:2
text: And be ready for the morning, and go up in the morning to mount Sinai, and stand there before me on the top of the mountain.

title: Exodus 34:3
text: And let no man go up with thee, neither shall any man be seen on all the mountain; neither shall sheep and oxen feed in front of that mountain.

title: Exodus 34:4
text: And he hewed two tables of stone like the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning and went up to mount Sinai, as Jehovah had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

title: Exodus 34:5
text: ¶And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and stood beside him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.

title: Exodus 34:6
text: And Jehovah passed by before his face, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah *God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in goodness and truth,

title: Exodus 34:7
text: keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, but by no means clearing [the guilty]; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, upon the third and upon the fourth [generation].

title: Exodus 34:8
text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head to the earth and worshipped,

title: Exodus 34:9
text: and said, If indeed I have found grace in thine eyes, Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in our midst; for it is a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for an inheritance!

title: Exodus 34:10
text: ¶And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels that have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people in the midst of which thou [art] shall see the work of Jehovah; for a terrible thing it shall be that I will do with thee.

title: Exodus 34:11
text: Observe what I command thee this day: behold, I will drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

title: Exodus 34:12
text: Take heed to thyself, that thou make no covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which thou shalt come, lest it be a snare in the midst of thee;

title: Exodus 34:13
text: but ye shall demolish their altars, shatter their statues, and hew down their Asherahs.

title: Exodus 34:14
text: For thou shalt worship no other *God; for Jehovah--Jealous is his name--is a jealous *God;

title: Exodus 34:15
