text: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and then, when they go a whoring after their gods, and sacrifice unto their gods, thou be invited, and eat of their sacrifice,

title: Exodus 34:16
text: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

title: Exodus 34:17
text: --Thou shalt make thyself no molten gods.

title: Exodus 34:18
text: ¶--The feast of the unleavened bread shalt thou keep: seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I have commanded thee, at the appointed time of the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

title: Exodus 34:19
text: --All that openeth the womb [is] mine; and all the cattle that is born a male, the firstling of ox and sheep.

title: Exodus 34:20
text: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt ransom with a lamb; and if thou ransom [it] not, then shalt thou break its neck. All the first-born of thy sons thou shalt ransom; and none shall appear before me empty.

title: Exodus 34:21
text: --Six days shalt thou work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest; in ploughing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

title: Exodus 34:22
text: --And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the first-fruits of wheat-harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the turn of the year.

title: Exodus 34:23
text: Thrice in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Exodus 34:24
text: For I will dispossess the nations before thee, and enlarge thy border, and no man shall desire thy land, when thou goest up to appear before the face of Jehovah thy God thrice in the year.

title: Exodus 34:25
text: --Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left over night until the morning.

title: Exodus 34:26
text: --The first of the first-fruits of thy land shalt thou bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Exodus 34:27
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write thee these words; for after the tenor of these words have I made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

title: Exodus 34:28
text: ¶--And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he ate no bread, and drank no water. --And he wrote on the tables the words of the covenant, the ten words.

title: Exodus 34:29
text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai--and the two tables of testimony were in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mountain--that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone through his talking with him.

title: Exodus 34:30
text: And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

title: Exodus 34:31
text: And Moses called to them; and they turned to him, --Aaron and all the principal men of the assembly; and Moses talked with them.

title: Exodus 34:32
text: And afterwards, all the children of Israel came near; and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him on mount Sinai.

title: Exodus 34:33
text: And Moses ended speaking with them; and he had put on his face a veil.

title: Exodus 34:34
text: And when Moses went in before Jehovah to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel what he was commanded.

title: Exodus 34:35
text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone; and Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

title: Exodus 35:1
text: ¶And Moses collected all the assembly of the children of Israel, and said to them, These are the things which Jehovah has commanded, to do them.

title: Exodus 35:2
text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to Jehovah: whoever does work on it shall be put to death.

title: Exodus 35:3
text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings upon the sabbath day.

title: Exodus 35:4
text: And Moses spoke to all the assembly of the children of Israel, saying, This is the word which Jehovah has commanded, saying,

title: Exodus 35:5
text: Take from among you a heave-offering to Jehovah: every one whose heart [is] willing, let him bring it, Jehovah's heave-offering--gold, and silver, and copper,

title: Exodus 35:6
text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and byssus, and goats' [hair],

title: Exodus 35:7
text: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and acacia-wood,

title: Exodus 35:8
text: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the incense of fragrant drugs;

title: Exodus 35:9
text: and onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

title: Exodus 35:10
text: And all who are wise-hearted among you shall come and make all that Jehovah has commanded:

title: Exodus 35:11
text: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

title: Exodus 35:12
text: the ark, and its staves; the mercy-seat, and the veil of separation;

title: Exodus 35:13
text: the table and its staves, and all its utensils, and the shewbread;

title: Exodus 35:14
text: and the lamp-stand for the light, and its utensils, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;

title: Exodus 35:15
text: and the altar of incense, and its staves; and the anointing-oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs; and the entrance-curtain at the entrance of the tabernacle;

title: Exodus 35:16
text: the altar of burnt-offering, and the copper grating for it, its staves, and all its utensils; the laver and its stand;

title: Exodus 35:17
text: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the curtains of the gate of the court;

title: Exodus 35:18
text: the pegs of the tabernacle, and the pegs of the court, and their cords;

title: Exodus 35:19
text: the garments of service, to do service in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.

title: Exodus 35:20
text: ¶And all the assembly of the children of Israel departed from before Moses.

title: Exodus 35:21
text: And they came, every one whose heart moved him, and every one whose spirit prompted him; they brought Jehovah's heave-offering for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.

title: Exodus 35:22
text: And they came, both men and women; every one who was of willing heart brought nose-rings, and earrings, and rings, and bracelets, all kinds of utensils of gold: every man that waved a wave-offering of gold to Jehovah.

title: Exodus 35:23
text: And every man with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and byssus, and goats' [hair], and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, brought [them].

title: Exodus 35:24
text: All they that offered a heave-offering of silver and copper brought Jehovah's heave-offering. And every one with whom was found acacia-wood for all manner of work of the service, brought [it].

title: Exodus 35:25
text: And every woman that was wise-hearted spun with her hands, and brought what she had spun: the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the byssus.

title: Exodus 35:26
text: And all the women whose heart moved them in wisdom spun goats' [hair].

title: Exodus 35:27
text: And the principal men brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

title: Exodus 35:28
text: and the spice, and the oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the incense of fragrant drugs.

title: Exodus 35:29
text: The children of Israel brought a voluntary offering to Jehovah, every man and woman whose heart prompted them to bring for all manner of work, which Jehovah, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.

title: Exodus 35:30
text: ¶And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, Jehovah has called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

title: Exodus 35:31
text: and he has filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

title: Exodus 35:32
text: and to devise artistic things: to work in gold, and in silver, and in copper,

title: Exodus 35:33
text: and in cutting of stones, for setting, and in carving of wood, to execute all artistic work;

title: Exodus 35:34
text: and he has put in his heart to teach, he and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan:

title: Exodus 35:35
text: he has filled them with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work of the engraver, and of the artificer, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in byssus, and of the weaver, [even] of them that do every kind of work, and of those that devise artistic work

title: Exodus 36:1
text: ¶Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every man that was wise-hearted, in whom Jehovah had put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work of the service of the sanctuary--according to all that Jehovah had commanded.

title: Exodus 36:2
text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every man that was wise-hearted, in whose heart God had put wisdom, every one whose heart moved him to come to the work to do it.

title: Exodus 36:3
text: And they took from Moses every heave-offering that the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it. And they still brought him voluntary offerings morning by morning.

title: Exodus 36:4
text: And all the wise men that wrought all the work of the sanctuary came, every man from his work which they wrought,

title: Exodus 36:5
text: and spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work that Jehovah commanded to be done.

title: Exodus 36:6
text: Then Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed through the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the heave-offering of the sanctuary! So the people were restrained from bringing;

title: Exodus 36:7
text: for the work they had was sufficient for all the work to do it, and it was too much.

title: Exodus 36:8
text: ¶And every wise-hearted man among those that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of twined byssus, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: [with] cherubim of artistic work did he make them.

title: Exodus 36:9
text: The length of one curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits--one measure for all the curtains.

title: Exodus 36:10
text: And he coupled five of the curtains one to another, and [the other] five curtains coupled he one to another.

title: Exodus 36:11
text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain at the edge of the coupling; he did likewise in the edge of the outermost curtain in the other coupling.

title: Exodus 36:12
text: He made fifty loops in one curtain, and he made fifty loops at the end of the curtain that was in the other coupling: the loops were opposite to one another.

title: Exodus 36:13
text: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle became one.

title: Exodus 36:14
text: ¶And he made curtains of goats' [hair] for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains did he make them.

title: Exodus 36:15
text: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of one curtain--one measure for the eleven curtains.

title: Exodus 36:16
text: And he coupled five of the curtains by themselves, and six of the curtains by themselves.

title: Exodus 36:17
text: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he on the edge of the curtain in the other coupling.

title: Exodus 36:18
text: And he made fifty clasps of copper to couple the tent, that it might be one.

title: Exodus 36:19
text: And he made a covering for the tent [of] rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above [that].

title: Exodus 36:20
text: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia-wood, standing up;

title: Exodus 36:21
text: ten cubits the length of the boards, and one cubit and a half the breadth of one board;

title: Exodus 36:22
text: two tenons in one board, connected one with the other: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 36:23
text: And he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;

title: Exodus 36:24
text: and he made forty bases of silver under the twenty boards, two bases under one board, for its two tenons, and two bases under another board for its two tenons.

title: Exodus 36:25
text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, on the side toward the north, he made twenty boards,

title: Exodus 36:26
text: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.

title: Exodus 36:27
text: And at the rear of the tabernacle, westward, he made six boards;

title: Exodus 36:28
text: and he made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear;

title: Exodus 36:29
text: and they were joined beneath, and were coupled together at the top thereof into one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners;

title: Exodus 36:30
text: and there were eight boards, and their silver bases: sixteen bases, under every board two bases.

title: Exodus 36:31
text: --And he made bars of acacia-wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

title: Exodus 36:32
text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at the rear, westward.

title: Exodus 36:33
text: And he made the middle bar in the midst of the boards reach from one end to the other.

title: Exodus 36:34
text: And he overlaid the boards with gold; and made their rings of gold [as] receptacles for the bars; and overlaid the bars with gold.

title: Exodus 36:35
text: ¶And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus: of artistic work he made it [with] cherubim.

title: Exodus 36:36
text: And he made four pillars of acacia[ -wood] for it, and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four bases of silver.

title: Exodus 36:37
text: And he made a curtain for the entrance of the tent of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus, of embroidery;

title: Exodus 36:38
text: and its five pillars with their hooks; and he overlaid their capitals and their connecting-rods with gold; and their five bases were of copper.

title: Exodus 37:1
text: ¶And Bezaleel made the ark of acacia-wood; two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

title: Exodus 37:2
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a border of gold upon it round about.

title: Exodus 37:3
text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, for its four corners: two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

title: Exodus 37:4
text: And he made staves of acacia-wood and overlaid them with gold.

title: Exodus 37:5
text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark.

title: Exodus 37:6
text: --And he made a mercy-seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

title: Exodus 37:7
text: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work did he make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;

title: Exodus 37:8
text: one cherub at the end of one side, and one cherub at the end of the other side; out of the mercy-seat he made the two cherubim at the two ends thereof.

title: Exodus 37:9
text: And the cherubim spread out [their] wings over it, covering over with their wings the mercy-seat; and their faces were opposite to one another: the faces of the cherubim were [turned] toward the mercy-seat.

title: Exodus 37:10
text: ¶And he made the table of acacia-wood; two cubits the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

title: Exodus 37:11
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made upon it a border of gold round about.

title: Exodus 37:12
text: And he made for it a margin of a hand-breadth round about; and made a border of gold for the margin thereof round about.

title: Exodus 37:13
text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.

title: Exodus 37:14
text: Close to the margin were the rings, as receptacles of the staves to carry the table.

title: Exodus 37:15
text: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

title: Exodus 37:16
text: And he made the utensils that were on the table, the dishes thereof, and the cups thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the goblets with which to pour out, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:17
text: And he made the candlestick of pure gold; [of] beaten work he made the candlestick: its base, and its shaft, its cups, its knobs, and its flowers were of itself.

title: Exodus 37:18
text: And six branches went out of the sides thereof--three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof;

title: Exodus 37:19
text: [there were] three cups shaped like almonds in the one branch, a knob and a flower; and three cups shaped like almonds in the other branch, a knob and a flower: so in the six branches which went out of the candlestick.

title: Exodus 37:20
text: And in the candlestick were four cups, shaped like almonds, its knobs, and its flowers;

title: Exodus 37:21
text: and a knob under two branches thereof, and [again] a knob under two branches thereof, and [again] a knob under two branches thereof, for the six branches which went out of it.

title: Exodus 37:22
text: Their knobs and their branches were of itself--all of one beaten work of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:23
text: And he made the seven lamps thereof, and the snuffers thereof, and the snuff-trays thereof, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:24
text: Of a talent of pure gold he made it, and all its utensils.

title: Exodus 37:25
text: ¶And he made the altar of incense of acacia-wood; a cubit the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, square, and two cubits the height thereof: its horns were of itself.

title: Exodus 37:26
text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and made upon it a border of gold round about.

title: Exodus 37:27
text: And he made two rings of gold for it under its border, by its two corners, on the two sides thereof, as receptacles for the staves with which to carry it.

title: Exodus 37:28
text: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold.

title: Exodus 37:29
text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of fragrant drugs, according to the work of the perfumer.

title: Exodus 38:1
text: ¶And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia-wood; five cubits the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, square, and three cubits the height thereof.

title: Exodus 38:2
text: And he made its horns on the four corners thereof; its horns were of itself; and he overlaid it with copper.

title: Exodus 38:3
text: And he made all the utensils of the altar: the pots, and the shovels, and the bowls, the forks, and the firepans; all its utensils made he of copper.

title: Exodus 38:4
text: And he made for the altar a grating of network of copper under its ledge from beneath, to the very middle of it.

title: Exodus 38:5
text: And he cast four rings for the four corners of the grating of copper, as receptacles for the staves.

title: Exodus 38:6
text: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with copper.

title: Exodus 38:7
text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. Hollow with boards did he make it.

title: Exodus 38:8
text: And he made the laver of copper, and its stand of copper, of the mirrors of the crowds of women who crowded before the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 38:9
text: ¶And he made the court. On the south side southward, the hangings of the court were of twined byssus, a hundred cubits;

title: Exodus 38:10
text: their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 38:11
text: And on the north side, a hundred cubits; their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 38:12
text: And on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 38:13
text: And for the east side, eastward, fifty cubits;

title: Exodus 38:14
text: the hangings on the one wing of fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their bases three;

title: Exodus 38:15
text: and on the other wing, on this side as on that side of the gate of the court, hangings of fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their bases three.

title: Exodus 38:16
text: All the hangings of the court round about were of twined byssus;

title: Exodus 38:17
text: and the bases of the pillars of copper, the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals of silver; and all the pillars of the court were fastened together with [rods of] silver.

title: Exodus 38:18
text: --And the curtain of the gate of the court was of embroidery of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus; and the length was twenty cubits, and the height like the breadth, five cubits, just as the hangings of the court;

title: Exodus 38:19
text: and their pillars four, and their bases four, of copper; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their connecting-rods of silver.

title: Exodus 38:20
text: And all the pegs for the tabernacle and for the court round about were of copper.

title: Exodus 38:21
text: ¶These are the things numbered of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, which were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, by the service of the Levites, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.

title: Exodus 38:22
text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah had commanded Moses;

title: Exodus 38:23
text: and with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and artificer, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in byssus.

title: Exodus 38:24
text: All the gold that it took for the work in all the work of the sanctuary--the gold of the wave-offering, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Exodus 38:25
text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the assembly was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

title: Exodus 38:26
text: a bekah the head--half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed the numbering from twenty years old and upward, [of] the six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

title: Exodus 38:27
text: And there were a hundred talents of silver for casting the bases of the sanctuary, and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases of a hundred talents, a talent for a base.

title: Exodus 38:28
text: And of the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five [shekels] he made the hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and fastened them [with rods].

title: Exodus 38:29
text: And the copper of the wave-offering was seventy talents, and two thousand four hundred shekels.

title: Exodus 38:30
text: And he made with it the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the copper altar, and the copper grating for it, and all the utensils of the altar.

title: Exodus 38:31
text: And the bases of the court round about, and the bases of the gate of the court, and all the pegs of the tabernacle, and all the pegs of the court round about.

title: Exodus 39:1
text: ¶And of the blue and purple and scarlet they made garments of service, for service in the sanctuary, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:2
text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus.

title: Exodus 39:3
text: And they beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it [into] wires, to work it artistically into the blue, and into the purple, and into the scarlet, and into the byssus.

title: Exodus 39:4
text: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joining it: at its two ends was it joined together.

title: Exodus 39:5
text: And the girdle of his ephod, which was on it, was of the same, according to its work, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:6
text: And they wrought the onyx stones mounted in enclosures of gold, engraved with the engravings of a seal, according to the names of the sons of Israel.

title: Exodus 39:7
text: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, [as] stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:8
text: And he made the breastplate of artistic work, like the work of the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus.

title: Exodus 39:9
text: It was square; double did they make the breastplate, a span the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, doubled.

title: Exodus 39:10
text: And they set in it four rows of stones: [one] row, a sardoin, a topaz, and an emerald--the first row;

title: Exodus 39:11
text: and the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;

title: Exodus 39:12
text: and the third row, an opal, an agate, and an amethyst;

title: Exodus 39:13
text: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper; mounted in enclosures of gold in their settings.

title: Exodus 39:14
text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, engraved as a seal, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

title: Exodus 39:15
text: And they made on the breastplate chains of laced work of wreathen work, of pure gold.

title: Exodus 39:16
text: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

title: Exodus 39:17
text: And they put the two wreathen [cords] of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate;

title: Exodus 39:18
text: and the two ends of the two wreathen [cords] they fastened to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, on the front thereof.

title: Exodus 39:19
text: And they made two rings of gold, and put [them] on the two ends of the breastplate, on the border thereof, which faceth the ephod inwards.

title: Exodus 39:20
text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, to the front thereof, just by the coupling thereof, above the girdle of the ephod.

title: Exodus 39:21
text: And they bound the breastplate with its rings to the rings of the ephod with lace of blue, that it might be above the girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:22
text: And he made the cloak of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;

title: Exodus 39:23
text: and the opening of the cloak in its middle, as the opening of a coat of mail; a binding was round about the opening, that it should not rend.

title: Exodus 39:24
text: And they made on the skirts of the cloak pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet, twined.

title: Exodus 39:25
text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates, in the skirts of the cloak, round about, between the pomegranates:

title: Exodus 39:26
text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, in the skirts of the cloak round about, for service; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:27
text: And they made the vests of byssus of woven work, for Aaron, and for his sons;

title: Exodus 39:28
text: and the turban of byssus; and the ornamental caps, of byssus; and the linen trousers, of twined byssus;

title: Exodus 39:29
text: and the girdle, of twined byssus, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of embroidery; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:30
text: And they made the thin plate, the holy diadem, of pure gold, and wrote on it with the writing of the engravings of a seal, Holiness to Jehovah!

title: Exodus 39:31
text: And they fastened to it a lace of blue, to fasten [it] on the turban above; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:32
text: ¶And all the labour of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was ended; and the children of Israel had done [it] according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses--so had they done [it].

title: Exodus 39:33
text: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses--the tent, and all its utensils, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its bases;

title: Exodus 39:34
text: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the veil of separation;

title: Exodus 39:35
text: the ark of the testimony, and its staves, and the mercy-seat;

title: Exodus 39:36
text: the table, all its utensils, and the shewbread;

title: Exodus 39:37
text: the pure candlestick, its lamps, the lamps set in order, and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;

title: Exodus 39:38
text: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs; and the curtain for the entrance of the tent;

title: Exodus 39:39
text: the copper altar, and the copper grating that was for it, its staves and all its utensils; the laver and its stand;

title: Exodus 39:40
text: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases; and the curtain for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the vessel's of service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

title: Exodus 39:41
text: the garments of service, for service in the sanctuary; the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to serve as priests.

title: Exodus 39:42
text: According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so had the children of Israel done all the labour.

title: Exodus 39:43
text: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Jehovah had commanded--so had they done [it]; and Moses blessed them.

title: Exodus 40:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 40:2
text: On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:3
text: And thou shalt put in it the ark of the testimony, and shalt cover the ark with the veil.

title: Exodus 40:4
text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it. And thou shalt bring in the candlestick and light its lamps.

title: Exodus 40:5
text: And thou shalt set the golden altar for the incense before the ark of the testimony; and hang up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:6
text: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:7
text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water in it.

title: Exodus 40:8
text: And thou shalt fix the court round about, and hang up the curtain at the gate of the court.

title: Exodus 40:9
text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is in it, and shalt hallow it, and all its utensils; and it shall be holy.

title: Exodus 40:10
text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its utensils; and thou shalt hallow the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.

title: Exodus 40:11
text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its stand, and hallow it.

title: Exodus 40:12
text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons near, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and bathe them with water.

title: Exodus 40:13
text: And thou shalt clothe Aaron with the holy garments, and anoint him, and hallow him, that he may serve me as priest.

title: Exodus 40:14
text: And thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with vests.

title: Exodus 40:15
text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall be to them an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

title: Exodus 40:16
text: ¶And Moses did so: as Jehovah had commanded him, so did he.

title: Exodus 40:17
text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, that the tabernacle was set up.

title: Exodus 40:18
text: And Moses set up the tabernacle, and put in its bases, and fixed its boards, and put in its bars, and set up its pillars.

title: Exodus 40:19
text: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above over it; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:20
text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and put the staves in the ark, and put the mercy-seat above on the ark.

title: Exodus 40:21
text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and hung up the veil of separation, and covered the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:22
text: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil,

title: Exodus 40:23
text: and arranged the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:24
text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, opposite to the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Exodus 40:25
text: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:26
text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil.

title: Exodus 40:27
text: And he burnt on it fragrant incense; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:28
text: And he hung up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:29
text: And he put the altar of burnt-offering at the entrance to the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt-offering and the oblation; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:30
text: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.

title: Exodus 40:31
text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet out of it:

title: Exodus 40:32
text: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they drew near to the altar, they washed; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:33
text: And he set up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the curtain of the gate of the court. And so Moses finished the work.

title: Exodus 40:34
text: ¶And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:35
text: And Moses could not enter into the tent of meeting, for the cloud abode on it, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:36
text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel journeyed in all their journeys.

title: Exodus 40:37
text: And if the cloud were not taken up, then they did not journey until the day that it was taken up.

title: Exodus 40:38
text: For the cloud of Jehovah was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

title: Leviticus 1:1
text: ¶And Jehovah called to Moses and spoke to him out of the tent of meeting, saying,

title: Leviticus 1:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When any man of you presenteth an offering to Jehovah, ye shall present your offering of the cattle, of the herd and of the flock.

title: Leviticus 1:3
text: ¶If his offering be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall present it a male without blemish: at the entrance of the tent of meeting shall he present it, for his acceptance before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 1:4
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

title: Leviticus 1:5
text: And he shall slaughter the bullock before Jehovah; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood round about on the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 1:6
text: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it up into its pieces.

title: Leviticus 1:7
text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

title: Leviticus 1:8
text: and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat, in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

title: Leviticus 1:9
text: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash in water; and the priest shall burn all on the altar, a burnt-offering, an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 1:10
text: ¶And if his offering be of the flock, of the sheep or of the goats, for a burnt-offering, he shall present it a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 1:11
text: And he shall slaughter it on the side of the altar northward before Jehovah; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 1:12
text: And he shall cut it into its pieces, and its head, and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

title: Leviticus 1:13
text: but the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water; and the priest shall present [it] all, and burn [it] on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 1:14
text: And if his offering to Jehovah be a burnt-offering of fowls, then he shall present his offering of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.

title: Leviticus 1:15
text: And the priest shall bring it near to the altar and pinch off its head and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be pressed out at the side of the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:16
text: And he shall remove its crop with its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east, into the place of the ashes;

title: Leviticus 1:17
text: and he shall split it open at its wings, [but] shall not divide [it] asunder; and the priest shall burn it on the altar on the wood that is on the fire: it is a burnt-offering, an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 2:1
text: ¶And when any one will present an oblation to Jehovah, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense thereon.

title: Leviticus 2:2
text: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests; and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial thereof on the altar, an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 2:3
text: And the remainder of the oblation shall be Aaron's and his sons': [it is] most holy of Jehovah's offerings by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:4
text: And if thou present an offering of an oblation baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:5
text: And if thine offering be an oblation [baken] on the pan, it shall be fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:6
text: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is an oblation.

title: Leviticus 2:7
text: And if thine offering be an oblation [prepared] in the cauldron, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:8
text: And thou shalt bring the oblation that is made of these things to Jehovah; and it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:9
text: And the priest shall take from the oblation a memorial thereof, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 2:10
text: And the remainder of the oblation [shall be] Aaron's and his sons': [it is] most holy of Jehovah's offerings by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:11
text: ¶No oblation which ye shall present to Jehovah shall be made with leaven; for no leaven and no honey shall ye burn [in] any fire-offering to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 2:12
text: As to the offering of the first-fruits, ye shall present them to Jehovah; but they shall not be offered upon the altar for a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 2:13
text: And every offering of thine oblation shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thine oblation: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

title: Leviticus 2:14
text: And if thou present an oblation of thy first-fruits to Jehovah, thou shalt present as the oblation of thy first-fruits green ears of corn roasted in fire, corn beaten out of full ears.

title: Leviticus 2:15
text: And thou shalt put oil on it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is an oblation.

title: Leviticus 2:16
text: And the priest shall burn the memorial thereof, [part] of the beaten corn thereof, and [part] of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: [it is] an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:1
text: ¶And if his offering be a sacrifice of peace-offering, --if he present [it] of the herd, whether a male or female, he shall present it without blemish before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:2
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:3
text: And he shall present of the sacrifice of peace-offering an offering by fire to Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the net above the liver which he shall take away as far as the kidneys;

title: Leviticus 3:5
text: and Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt-offering which [lieth] on the wood that is upon the fire: [it is] an offering by fire to Jehovah of a sweet odour.

title: Leviticus 3:6
text: ¶And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah be of small cattle, male or female, he shall present it without blemish.

title: Leviticus 3:7
text: If he present a sheep for his offering, then shall he present it before Jehovah,

title: Leviticus 3:8
text: and shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and slaughter it before the tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:9
text: And he shall present of the sacrifice of peace-offering an offering by fire to Jehovah; the fat thereof, the whole fat tail, which he shall take off close by the backbone, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:10
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the net above the liver which he shall take away as far as the kidneys;

title: Leviticus 3:11
text: and the priest shall burn it on the altar: [it is] the food of the offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:12
text: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall present it before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 3:13
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of it, and slaughter it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 3:14
text: And he shall present thereof his offering, an offering by fire to Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards and all the fat that is on the inwards,

title: Leviticus 3:15
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the net above the liver which he shall take away as far as the kidneys;

title: Leviticus 3:16
text: and the priest shall burn them on the altar: [it is] the food of the offering by fire for a sweet odour. All the fat [shall be] Jehovah's.

title: Leviticus 3:17
text: [It is] an everlasting statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings: no fat and no blood shall ye eat.

title: Leviticus 4:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 4:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through inadvertence against any of the commandments of Jehovah [in things] that ought not to be done, and do any of them;

title: Leviticus 4:3
text: if the priest that is anointed sin according to the trespass of the people; then for his sin which he hath sinned shall he present a young bullock without blemish to Jehovah for a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:4
text: And he shall bring the bullock to the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah; and shall lay his hand on the bullock's head, and slaughter the bullock before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 4:5
text: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it into the tent of meeting;

title: Leviticus 4:6
text: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before Jehovah before the veil of the sanctuary;

title: Leviticus 4:7
text: and the priest shall put of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense, which is in the tent of meeting, before Jehovah; and he shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:8
text: And all the fat of the bullock of the sin-offering shall he take off from it; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

title: Leviticus 4:9
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the net above the liver which he shall take away as far as the kidneys,

title: Leviticus 4:10
text: as it is taken off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace-offering; and the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:11
text: And the skin of the bullock, and all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, and its inwards, and its dung,

title: Leviticus 4:12
text: even the whole bullock shall he carry forth outside the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out shall it be burnt.

title: Leviticus 4:13
text: ¶And if the whole assembly of Israel sin inadvertently, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the congregation, and they do [somewhat against] any of all the commandments of Jehovah [in things] which should not be done, and are guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:14
text: and the sin wherewith they have sinned against it have become known; then the congregation shall present a young bullock for the sin-offering, and shall bring it before the tent of meeting;

title: Leviticus 4:15
text: and the elders of the assembly shall lay their hands on the head of the bullock before Jehovah; and one shall slaughter the bullock before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 4:16
text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood into the tent of meeting;

title: Leviticus 4:17
text: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, before the veil;

title: Leviticus 4:18
text: and he shall put of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before Jehovah which is in the tent of meeting; and he shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:19
text: And all its fat shall he take off from it and burn on the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:20
text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock of sin-offering: so shall he do with it. And the priest shall make atonement for them; and it shall be forgiven them.

title: Leviticus 4:21
text: And he shall carry forth the bullock outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin-offering of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:22
text: ¶When a prince sinneth and through inadvertence doeth [somewhat against] any of all the commandments of Jehovah his God [in things] which should not be done, and is guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:23
text: if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge, he shall bring his offering, a buck of the goats, a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 4:24
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and slaughter it at the place where they slaughter the burnt-offering before Jehovah: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:25
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and shall pour out its blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:26
text: And he shall burn all its fat on the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him [to cleanse him] from his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 4:27
text: ¶And if any one of the people of the land sin through inadvertence, that he do [somewhat against] any of the commandments of Jehovah [in things] which should not be done, and be guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:28
text: if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge, then he shall bring his offering, a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

title: Leviticus 4:29
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering, and slaughter the sin-offering at the place of the burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:30
text: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put [it] on the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:31
text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace-offering; and the priest shall burn it on the altar, for a sweet odour to Jehovah; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 4:32
text: And if he bring a sheep for his offering for sin, a female without blemish shall he bring it.

title: Leviticus 4:33
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering, and slaughter it for a sin-offering at the place where they slaughter the burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:34
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put [it] on the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:35
text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace-offering; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, with Jehovah's offerings by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:1
text: ¶And if any one sin, and hear the voice of adjuration, and he is a witness whether he hath seen or known [it], if he do not give information, then he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 5:2
text: Or if any one touch any unclean thing, whether it be the carcase of an unclean beast, or the carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of an unclean crawling thing, and it be hid from him, --he also is unclean and guilty;

title: Leviticus 5:3
text: or if he touch the uncleanness of man, any uncleanness of him by which he is defiled, and it be hid from him, when he knoweth [it], then he is guilty.

title: Leviticus 5:4
text: Or if any one swear, talking rashly with the lips, to do evil or to do good, in everything that a man shall say rashly with an oath, and it be hid from him, when he knoweth [it], then is he guilty in one of these.

title: Leviticus 5:5
text: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these, that he shall confess wherein he hath sinned;

title: Leviticus 5:6
text: and he shall bring his trespass-offering to Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the small cattle, a sheep or doe goat, for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him [to cleanse him] from his sin.

title: Leviticus 5:7
text: ¶And if his hand be not able to bring what is so much as a sheep, then he shall bring for his trespass which he hath sinned two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, to Jehovah; one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:8
text: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall present that which is for the sin-offering first, and pinch off his head at the neck, but shall not divide it;

title: Leviticus 5:9
text: and he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin-offering on the wall of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:10
text: And he shall offer the other for a burnt-offering, according to the ordinance. And the priest shall make atonement for him [to cleanse him] from his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:11
text: But if his hand cannot attain to two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin-offering: he shall put no oil on it, neither shall he put frankincense thereon; for it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:12
text: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, the memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, with Jehovah's offerings by fire: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:13
text: And the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him; and it shall be the priest's, as the oblation.

title: Leviticus 5:14
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 5:15
text: If any one act unfaithfully and sin through inadvertence in the holy things of Jehovah, then he shall bring his trespass-offering to Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the small cattle, according to thy valuation by shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:16
text: And he shall make restitution for the wrong that he hath done in the holy things, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and shall give it unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:17
text: And if any one sin and do against any of all the commandments of Jehovah what should not be done, and hath not known [it], yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 5:18
text: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the small cattle, according to thy valuation, as trespass-offering, unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his inadvertence wherein he sinned inadvertently, and knew [it] not, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:19
text: It is a trespass-offering: he hath certainly trespassed against Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:2
text: If any one sin and act unfaithfully against Jehovah, and lie to his neighbour as to an entrusted thing or a deposit or [that in which] he hath robbed or wronged his neighbour,

title: Leviticus 6:3
text: or have found what was lost, and denieth it, and sweareth falsely in anything of all that man doeth, sinning therein;

title: Leviticus 6:4
text: then it shall be, if he hath sinned and transgressed, that he shall restore what he robbed or that in which he hath defrauded, or the deposit, or the lost thing which he found,

title: Leviticus 6:5
text: or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; and he shall restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto; to [him to] whom it belongeth shall he give it, on the day of his trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 6:6
text: And his trespass-offering shall he bring to Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the small cattle according to thy valuation, as a trespass-offering, unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 6:7
text: And the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah, and it shall be forgiven him concerning anything of all that he hath done so as to trespass therein.

title: Leviticus 6:8
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:9
text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt-offering; this, the burnt-offering, shall be on the hearth on the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

title: Leviticus 6:10
text: And the priest shall put on his linen raiment, and his linen breeches shall he put on his flesh, and take up the ashes to which the fire hath consumed the burnt-offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:11
text: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

title: Leviticus 6:12
text: And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning on it: it shall not be put out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt-offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 6:13
text: A continual fire shall be kept burning on the altar: it shall never go out.

title: Leviticus 6:14
text: ¶And this is the law of the oblation: [one of] the sons of Aaron shall present it before Jehovah, before the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:15
text: And he shall take of it his handful of the fine flour of the oblation, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is on the meat-offering, and shall burn [it] on the altar: [it is] a sweet odour of the memorial thereof to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:16
text: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: unleavened shall it be eaten in a holy place; in the court of the tent of meeting shall they eat it.

title: Leviticus 6:17
text: It shall not be baken with leaven. As their portion have I given it [unto them] of my offerings by fire: it is most holy; as the sin-offering, and as the trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 6:18
text: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. [It is] an everlasting statute in your generations, [their portion] of Jehovah's offerings by fire: whatever toucheth these shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 6:19
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:20
text: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall present to Jehovah on the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour as a continual oblation, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

title: Leviticus 6:21
text: It shall be prepared in the pan with oil: saturated with oil shalt thou bring it: baken pieces of the oblation shalt thou present [for] a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:22
text: And the priest who is anointed of his sons in his stead shall prepare it: [it is] an everlasting statute; it shall be wholly burned to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 6:23
text: And every oblation of the priest shall be wholly burned; it shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 6:24
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:25
text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering. At the place where the burnt-offering is slaughtered shall the sin-offering be slaughtered before Jehovah: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:26
text: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 6:27
text: Everything that toucheth the flesh thereof shall be holy; and if there be splashed of the blood thereof on a garment--that whereon it is sprinkled shalt thou wash in a holy place.

title: Leviticus 6:28
text: And the earthen vessel wherein it hath been sodden shall be broken; and if it have been sodden in a copper pot, it shall be both scoured and rinsed with water.

title: Leviticus 6:29
text: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:30
text: And no sin-offering whereof blood hath been brought to the tent of meeting, to make atonement in the sanctuary, shall be eaten: it shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:1
text: ¶And this is the law of the trespass-offering--it is most holy:

title: Leviticus 7:2
text: in the place where they slaughter the burnt-offering shall they slaughter the trespass-offering; and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 7:3
text: And he shall present of it all the fat thereof; the fat tail and the fat that covereth the inwards,

title: Leviticus 7:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the net above the liver, which he shall take away as far as the kidneys.

title: Leviticus 7:5
text: And the priest shall burn them on the altar, an offering by fire to Jehovah: it is a trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 7:6
text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof; in a holy place shall it be eaten: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:7
text: As the sin-offering, so is the trespass-offering; [there shall] be one law for them: it shall be the priest's who maketh atonement therewith.

title: Leviticus 7:8
text: And [as to] the priest that presenteth any man's burnt-offering, the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath presented shall be the priest's for himself.

title: Leviticus 7:9
text: And every oblation that is baken in the oven, and all that is prepared in the cauldron and in the pan, shall be the priest's who offereth it; to him it shall belong.

title: Leviticus 7:10
text: And every oblation, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as the other.

title: Leviticus 7:11
text: ¶And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offering, which [a man] shall present to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 7:12
text: If he present it for a thanksgiving, then he shall present with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and fine flour saturated with oil, cakes mingled with oil.

title: Leviticus 7:13
text: Besides the cakes, he shall present his offering of leavened bread with the sacrifice of his peace-offering of thanksgiving.

title: Leviticus 7:14
text: And of it he shall present one out of the whole offering as a heave-offering to Jehovah; to the priest that sprinkleth the blood of the peace-offering, to him it shall belong.

title: Leviticus 7:15
text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offering of thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is presented; he shall not let any of it remain until the morning.

title: Leviticus 7:16
text: And if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or voluntary, it shall be eaten the same day that he presented his sacrifice; on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten;

title: Leviticus 7:17
text: and the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:18
text: And if [any] of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offering be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, it shall not be reckoned to him that hath presented it; it shall be an unclean thing, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 7:19
text: And the flesh that toucheth anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. And as to the flesh, all that are clean may eat [the] flesh.

title: Leviticus 7:20
text: But the soul that eateth the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offering which is for Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Leviticus 7:21
text: And if any one touch anything unclean, the uncleanness of man, or unclean beast, or any unclean abomination, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offering, which is for Jehovah, that soul shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Leviticus 7:22
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 7:23
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, No fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat shall ye eat.

title: Leviticus 7:24
text: But the fat of a dead carcase, and the fat of that which is torn, may be used in any other use; but ye shall in no wise eat it.

title: Leviticus 7:25
text: For whoever eateth the fat of the beast of which men present an offering by fire to Jehovah, the soul that hath eaten shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Leviticus 7:26
text: And no blood shall ye eat in any of your dwellings, whether it be of fowl or of cattle.

title: Leviticus 7:27
text: Whatever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, that soul shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Leviticus 7:28
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 7:29
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that presenteth the sacrifice of his peace-offering to Jehovah shall bring his offering to Jehovah of the sacrifice of his peace-offering.

title: Leviticus 7:30
text: His own hands shall bring Jehovah's offerings by fire, the fat with the breast shall he bring: the breast, that it may be waved as a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 7:31
text: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar; and the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

title: Leviticus 7:32
text: And the right shoulder of the sacrifices of your peace-offerings shall ye give as a heave-offering unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 7:33
text: He of the sons of Aaron that presenteth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for [his] part.

title: Leviticus 7:34
text: For the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the heave-offering, have I taken of the children of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons from the children of Israel by an everlasting statute.

title: Leviticus 7:35
text: ¶This is [the portion] of the anointing of Aaron and of the anointing of his sons, from Jehovah's offerings by fire, in the day [when] he presented them to serve Jehovah as priests,

title: Leviticus 7:36
text: which Jehovah commanded to be given them by the children of Israel in the day that he anointed them: [it is] an everlasting statute, throughout their generations.

title: Leviticus 7:37
text: This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the oblation, and of the sin-offering, and of the trespass-offering, and of the consecration-offering, and of the sacrifice of peace-offering,

title: Leviticus 7:38
text: which Jehovah commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to present their offerings to Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Leviticus 8:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 8:2
text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil, and the bullock of the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened [bread];

title: Leviticus 8:3
text: and gather all the assembly together at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:4
text: And Moses did as Jehovah had commanded him; and the assembly was collected at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:5
text: And Moses said to the assembly, This is the thing which Jehovah has commanded to be done.

title: Leviticus 8:6
text: And Moses brought Aaron near, and his sons, and bathed them with water.

title: Leviticus 8:7
text: And he put upon him the vest and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the cloak, and put the ephod on him, and he girded him with the girdle of the ephod, and fastened the ephod on him.

title: Leviticus 8:8
text: And he put the breastplate on it, and put on the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim;

title: Leviticus 8:9
text: and he put the turban upon his head; and upon the turban, on the front of it, he put the golden plate, the holy diadem; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:10
text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and hallowed them.

title: Leviticus 8:11
text: And he sprinkled thereof on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the laver and its stand, to hallow them.

title: Leviticus 8:12
text: And he poured of the anointing oil on Aaron's head, and anointed him, to hallow him.

title: Leviticus 8:13
text: And Moses brought Aaron's sons near and clothed them with the vests, and girded them with the girdles, and bound the high caps on them, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:14
text: ¶And he brought near the bullock for the sin-offering; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bullock for the sin-offering;

title: Leviticus 8:15
text: and he slaughtered [it], and Moses took the blood, and put [it] on the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and cleansed the altar from sin, and the blood he poured at the bottom of the altar, and hallowed it, making atonement for it.

title: Leviticus 8:16
text: And he took all the fat that was on the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned [them] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 8:17
text: And the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung he burned with fire outside the camp, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:18
text: And he presented the ram of the burnt-offering; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram;

title: Leviticus 8:19
text: and he slaughtered [it]; and Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 8:20
text: And the ram he cut up into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat;

title: Leviticus 8:21
text: and the inwards and the legs he washed in water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar: it was a burnt-offering for a sweet odour, it was an offering by fire to Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:22
text: And he presented the second ram, the ram of consecration; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram;

title: Leviticus 8:23
text: and one slaughtered [it]; and Moses took of its blood, and put [it] on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot;

title: Leviticus 8:24
text: and he brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 8:25
text: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and the right shoulder;

title: Leviticus 8:26
text: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Jehovah he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat and upon the right shoulder;

title: Leviticus 8:27
text: and he gave all into Aaron's hands, and into his sons' hands, and waved them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 8:28
text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burned [them] on the altar, over the burnt-offering: they were a consecration-offering for a sweet odour: it was an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 8:29
text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it as a wave-offering before Jehovah; of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:30
text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled [it] on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons' garments with him; and hallowed Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

title: Leviticus 8:31
text: ¶And Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of the consecration-offering, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 8:32
text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

title: Leviticus 8:33
text: And ye shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting seven days, until the day when the days of your consecration are at an end: for seven days shall ye be consecrated.

title: Leviticus 8:34
text: As he hath done this day, [so] Jehovah hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

title: Leviticus 8:35
text: And ye shall abide at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that ye die not; for so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 8:36
text: And Aaron and his sons did all things that Jehovah had commanded by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:1
text: ¶And it came to pass on the eighth day, [that] Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel,

title: Leviticus 9:2
text: and said to Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and present [them] before Jehovah;

title: Leviticus 9:3
text: and to the children of Israel shalt thou speak, saying, Take a buck of the goats for a sin-offering, and a calf and a lamb, yearlings, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;

title: Leviticus 9:4
text: and a bullock and a ram for a peace-offering, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and an oblation mingled with oil; for to-day Jehovah will appear to you.

title: Leviticus 9:5
text: And they brought what Moses commanded before the tent of meeting; and all the assembly approached and stood before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 9:6
text: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah has commanded that ye should do; and the glory of Jehovah shall appear to you.

title: Leviticus 9:7
text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go to the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Jehovah has commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:8
text: ¶And Aaron went to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin-offering which was for himself;

title: Leviticus 9:9
text: and the sons of Aaron presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put [it] on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:10
text: And the fat, and the kidneys, and the net above the liver, of the sin-offering, he burned on the altar, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:11
text: And the flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

title: Leviticus 9:12
text: And he slaughtered the burnt-offering; and Aaron's sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled on the altar round about.

title: Leviticus 9:13
text: And they delivered the burnt-offering to him, in the pieces thereof, and the head; and he burned [them] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:14
text: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burned [them] upon the burnt-offering, on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:15
text: And he presented the people's offering, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people and slaughtered it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

title: Leviticus 9:16
text: And he presented the burnt-offering and offered it according to the ordinance.

title: Leviticus 9:17
text: And he presented the oblation, and took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.

title: Leviticus 9:18
text: And he slaughtered the bullock and the ram of the sacrifice of peace-offering which was for the people. And Aaron's sons delivered to him the blood, and he sprinkled it on the altar round about;

title: Leviticus 9:19
text: and the pieces of fat of the bullock and of the ram, the fat tail and what covers [the inwards], and the kidneys, and the net of the liver;

title: Leviticus 9:20
text: and they put the pieces of fat on the breast-pieces, and he burned the pieces of fat on the altar;

title: Leviticus 9:21
text: and the breast-pieces and the right shoulder Aaron waved as a wave-offering before Jehovah, as Moses had commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:22
text: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and came down after the offering of the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offering.

title: Leviticus 9:23
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out and blessed the people; and the glory of Jehovah appeared to all the people.

title: Leviticus 9:24
text: And there went out fire from before Jehovah, and consumed on the altar the burnt-offering, and the pieces of fat; and all the people saw it, and they shouted, and fell on their face.

title: Leviticus 10:1
text: ¶And the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, took each of them his censer, and put fire in it, and put incense on it, and presented strange fire before Jehovah, which he had not commanded them.

title: Leviticus 10:2
text: And there went out fire from before Jehovah, and devoured them, and they died before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 10:3
text: ¶And Moses said to Aaron, This is what Jehovah spoke, saying, I will be hallowed in them that come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron was silent.

title: Leviticus 10:4
text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

title: Leviticus 10:5
text: And they went near, and carried them in their vests out of the camp, as Moses had said.

title: Leviticus 10:6
text: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar his sons, Your heads shall ye not uncover, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come on all the assembly; but your brethren, the whole house of Israel, shall bewail the burning which Jehovah hath kindled.

title: Leviticus 10:7
text: And ye shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting, lest ye die; for the anointing oil of Jehovah is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:8
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:9
text: Thou shalt not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, and thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tent of meeting, lest ye die--[it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations,

title: Leviticus 10:10
text: that ye may put difference between the holy and the unholy, and between unclean and clean,

title: Leviticus 10:11
text: and that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Jehovah hath spoken to them by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:12
