text: ¶And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the oblation that is left of Jehovah's offerings by fire, and eat it with unleavened bread beside the altar; for it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 10:13
text: And ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of Jehovah's offerings by fire; for so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:14
text: And the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the heave-offering shall ye eat in a clean place, thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee; for [as] thy due, and thy sons' due, are they given of the sacrifices of peace-offerings of the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 10:15
text: The shoulder of the heave-offering and the breast of the wave-offering shall they bring, with the fire-offering of the pieces of fat, to wave [them] as a wave-offering before Jehovah; and they shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, for an everlasting statute, as Jehovah has commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:16
text: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, and behold, it was burnt up: then he was wroth with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:17
text: Why have ye not eaten the sin-offering in a holy place? for it is most holy, and he has given it to you that ye might bear the iniquity of the assembly, to make atonement for them before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 10:18
text: Lo, its blood was not brought in within the sanctuary: ye should certainly have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:19
text: And Aaron said to Moses, Behold, to-day have they presented their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before Jehovah; and such things have befallen me; and had I to-day eaten the sin-offering, would it have been good in the sight of Jehovah?

title: Leviticus 10:20
text: And Moses heard it; and it was good in his sight.

title: Leviticus 11:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

title: Leviticus 11:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the animals which ye shall eat of all the beasts which are on the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:3
text: Whatever hath cloven hoofs, and feet quite split open, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts--that shall ye eat.

title: Leviticus 11:4
text: Only these shall ye not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those with cloven hoofs: the camel, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

title: Leviticus 11:5
text: and the rock-badger, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

title: Leviticus 11:6
text: and the hare, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

title: Leviticus 11:7
text: and the swine, for it hath cloven hoofs, and feet quite split open, but it cheweth not the cud--it shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:8
text: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch: they shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:9
text: ¶These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatever hath fins and scales in waters, in seas and in rivers, these shall ye eat;

title: Leviticus 11:10
text: but all that have not fins and scales in seas and in rivers, of all that swarm in the waters, and of every living soul which is in the waters--they shall be an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:11
text: They shall be even an abomination unto you: of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase ye shall have in abomination.

title: Leviticus 11:12
text: Whatever in the waters hath no fins and scales, that shall be an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:13
text: And these shall ye have in abomination of the fowls; they shall not be eaten; an abomination shall they be: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the sea-eagle,

title: Leviticus 11:14
text: and the falcon, and the kite, after its kind;

title: Leviticus 11:15
text: every raven after its kind;

title: Leviticus 11:16
text: and the female ostrich and the male ostrich, and the sea-gull, and the hawk, after its kind;

title: Leviticus 11:17
text: and the owl, and the gannet, and the ibis,

title: Leviticus 11:18
text: and the swan, and the pelican, and the carrion vulture,

title: Leviticus 11:19
text: and the stork; the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

title: Leviticus 11:20
text: ¶Every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four shall be an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:21
text: Yet these shall ye eat of every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four: those which have legs above their feet with which to leap upon the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:22
text: These shall ye eat of them: the arbeh after its kind, and the solam after its kind, and the hargol after its kind, and the hargab after its kind.

title: Leviticus 11:23
text: But every winged crawling thing that hath four feet shall be an abomination unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:24
text: And by these ye shall make yourselves unclean; whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:25
text: And whoever carrieth [ought] of their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:26
text: Every beast that hath cloven hoofs, but not feet quite split open, nor cheweth the cud, shall be unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:27
text: And whatever goeth on its paws, among all manner of beasts that go upon all four, those are unclean unto you: whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:28
text: And he that carrieth their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: they shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:29
text: And these shall be unclean unto you among the crawling things which crawl on the earth: the mole, and the field-mouse, and the lizard, after its kind;

title: Leviticus 11:30
text: and the groaning lizard, and the great red lizard, and the climbing lizard, and the chomet, and the chameleon.

title: Leviticus 11:31
text: These shall be unclean unto you among all that crawl: whoever toucheth them when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:32
text: And on whatever any of them when they are dead doth fall, it shall be unclean; all vessels of wood, or garment, or skin, or sack, every vessel wherewith work is done--it shall be put into water, and be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.

title: Leviticus 11:33
text: And every earthen vessel into which [any] of them falleth--whatever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

title: Leviticus 11:34
text: All food that is eaten on which [such] water hath come shall be unclean; and all drink that is drunk shall be unclean, in every [such] vessel.

title: Leviticus 11:35
text: And everything where upon [any part] of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; oven and hearth shall be broken down: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:36
text: Nevertheless, a spring or a well, a quantity of water, shall be clean. But he that toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:37
text: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing-seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean;

title: Leviticus 11:38
text: but if water have been put on the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

title: Leviticus 11:39
text: And if any beast which is to you for food die, he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:40
text: And he that eateth of its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: he also that carrieth its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 11:41
text: And every crawling thing which crawleth on the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 11:42
text: Whatever goeth on the belly, and whatever goeth on all four, and all that have a great many feet, of every manner of crawling thing which crawleth on the earth--these ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

title: Leviticus 11:43
text: ¶Ye shall not make yourselves abominable through any crawling thing which crawleth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

title: Leviticus 11:44
text: For I am Jehovah your God; and ye shall hallow yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy; and ye shall not make yourselves unclean through any manner of crawling thing which creepeth on the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:45
text: For I am Jehovah who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

title: Leviticus 11:46
text: This is the law of cattle, and of fowl, and of every living soul that moveth in the waters, and of every soul that crawleth on the earth;

title: Leviticus 11:47
text: to make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that is to be eaten and the beast that is not to be eaten.

title: Leviticus 12:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 12:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a male, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the separation of her infirmity shall she be unclean.

title: Leviticus 12:3
text: And on the eighth day shall the flesh of his foreskin be circumcised.

title: Leviticus 12:4
text: And she shall continue thirty-three days in the blood of her cleansing; no holy thing shall she touch, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her cleansing are fulfilled.

title: Leviticus 12:5
text: And if she bear a female, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation; and she shall continue sixty-six days in the blood of her cleansing.

title: Leviticus 12:6
text: ¶And when the days of her cleansing are fulfilled, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a yearling lamb for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon or a turtle-dove for a sin-offering, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 12:7
text: And he shall present it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be clean from the flux of her blood. This is the law for her that hath borne a male or a female.

title: Leviticus 12:8
text: And if her hand cannot find what is sufficient for a sheep, she shall bring two turtle-doves or two young pigeons; one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her; and she shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 13:2
text: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising or a scab, or bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh a sore [as] of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests.

title: Leviticus 13:3
text: And when the priest looketh on the sore in the skin of the flesh, and the hair in the sore is turned white, and the sore looketh deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the sore of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him and pronounce him unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:4
text: But if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and look not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the sore seven days.

title: Leviticus 13:5
text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day; and behold, in his sight, the sore remaineth as it was, the sore hath not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days a second time.

title: Leviticus 13:6
text: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day, and behold, the sore is become pale and the sore hath not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is a scab; and he shall wash his garments and be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:7
text: But if the scab have spread much in the skin, after that he hath been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again;

title: Leviticus 13:8
text: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the scab hath spread in the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:9
text: When a sore [as] of leprosy is in a man, he shall be brought unto the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:10
text: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, there is a white rising in the skin, and it hath turned the hair white, and a trace of raw flesh is in the rising:

title: Leviticus 13:11
text: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and he shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:12
text: But if the leprosy break out much in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the sore, from his head even to his foot, wherever the eyes of the priest look,

title: Leviticus 13:13
text: and the priest looketh, and behold, the leprosy covereth all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the sore; it is all turned white; he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:14
text: And on the day when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:15
text: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and shall pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean, it is leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:16
text: But if the raw flesh change again, and be turned white, he shall come unto the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:17
text: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the sore is turned white; then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the sore: he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:18
text: ¶And the flesh--when in the skin thereof cometh a boil, and it is healed,

title: Leviticus 13:19
text: and there is in the place of the boil a white rising, or a white-reddish bright spot, it shall be shewn to the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:20
text: and the priest shall look on it, and behold, it looketh deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof is turned white; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy broken out in the boil.

title: Leviticus 13:21
text: But if the priest look on it, and behold, there are no white hairs therein, and it is not deeper than the skin, and is pale, the priest shall shut him up seven days;

title: Leviticus 13:22
text: and if it spread much in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore.

title: Leviticus 13:23
text: But if the bright spot have remained in its place, [and] have not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

title: Leviticus 13:24
text: Or if in the flesh, in the skin thereof, there is a burning inflammation, and the place of the inflammation become a bright spot white-reddish or white,

title: Leviticus 13:25
text: and the priest look on it, and behold, the hair is turned white in the bright spot, and it looketh deeper than the skin, it is a leprosy which is broken out in the inflammation; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:26
text: But if the priest look on it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is no deeper than the skin, and is pale, the priest shall shut him up seven days.

title: Leviticus 13:27
text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day, and if it have spread much in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 13:28
text: But if the bright spot have remained in its place, [and] not spread in the skin, and is pale, it is the rising of the inflammation; and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar of the inflammation.

title: Leviticus 13:29
text: And if a man or a woman have a sore on the head or on the beard,

title: Leviticus 13:30
text: and the priest look on the sore, and behold, it looketh deeper than the skin, and there is in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a scall, the leprosy of the head or the beard.

title: Leviticus 13:31
text: And if the priest look on the sore of the scall, and behold, it is not in sight deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the sore of the scall seven days.

title: Leviticus 13:32
text: And when the priest looketh on the sore on the seventh day, and behold, the scall hath not spread, and there is in it no yellow hair, and the scall doth not look deeper than the skin,

title: Leviticus 13:33
text: he [that hath the sore] shall shave himself; but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days a second time.

title: Leviticus 13:34
text: And the priest shall look on the scall on the seventh day, and behold, the scall hath not spread in the skin, nor is in sight deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his garments, and be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:35
text: But if the scall have spread much in the skin after his cleansing,

title: Leviticus 13:36
text: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the scall hath spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair: he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:37
text: But if the scall have in his sight remained as it was, and there is black hair grown up therein, the scall is healed: he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

title: Leviticus 13:38
text: ¶And if a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, white bright spots,

title: Leviticus 13:39
text: and the priest look, and behold, there are in the skin of their flesh pale white spots, it is an eruption which is broken out in the skin: he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:40
text: And if a man's hair have fallen off his head, he is bald: he is clean;

title: Leviticus 13:41
text: and if he have the hair fallen off from the part of the head towards his face, he is forehead-bald: he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:42
text: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white-reddish sore, it is a leprosy which hath broken out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

title: Leviticus 13:43
text: And the priest shall look on it, and behold, the rising of the sore is white-reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of the leprosy in the skin of the flesh;

title: Leviticus 13:44
text: he is a leprous man, he is unclean; the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his sore is in his head.

title: Leviticus 13:45
text: And as to the leper in whom the sore is, --his garments shall be rent, and his head shall be uncovered, and he shall put a covering on his beard, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean!

title: Leviticus 13:46
text: All the days that the sore shall be in him he shall be unclean: he is unclean; he shall dwell apart; outside the camp shall his dwelling be.

title: Leviticus 13:47
text: ¶And if a sore of leprosy is in a garment, in a woollen garment, or a linen garment,

title: Leviticus 13:48
text: either in the warp or in the woof of linen or of wool, or in a skin, or in anything made of skin,

title: Leviticus 13:49
text: and the sore is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is the sore of leprosy, and shall be shewn unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 13:50
text: And the priest shall look on the sore, and shall shut up [that which hath] the sore seven days.

title: Leviticus 13:51
text: And he shall see the sore on the seventh day: if the sore have spread in the garment, either in the warp or in the woof, or in a skin, in any work that may be made of skin, the sore is a corroding leprosy: it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:52
text: And they shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, of wool or of linen, or anything of skin, wherein the sore is; for it is a corroding leprosy: it shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 13:53
text: But if the priest look, and behold, the sore hath not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin,

title: Leviticus 13:54
text: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the sore is, and he shall shut it up seven days a second time.

title: Leviticus 13:55
text: And the priest shall look on the sore after the washing, and behold, if the sore have not changed its appearance, and the sore have not spread, it is unclean: thou shalt burn it with fire: it is a fretting sore on what is threadbare or where the nap is gone.

title: Leviticus 13:56
text: But if the priest look, and behold, the sore hath become pale after the washing of it, then he shall rend it from the garment, or from the skin, or from the warp, or from the woof.

title: Leviticus 13:57
text: And if it appear still in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is a [leprosy] breaking out: thou shalt burn with fire that wherein the sore is.

title: Leviticus 13:58
text: But the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin which thou hast washed, and the sore departeth from them, it shall be washed a second time, and it is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:59
text: This is the law of the sore of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, to cleanse it, or to pronounce it unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 14:2
text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest,

title: Leviticus 14:3
text: and the priest shall go out of the camp; and when the priest looketh, and behold, the sore of leprosy is healed in the leper,

title: Leviticus 14:4
text: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two clean living birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

title: Leviticus 14:5
text: And the priest shall command that one bird be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

title: Leviticus 14:6
text: as to the living bird--he shall take it, and the cedar-wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water;

title: Leviticus 14:7
text: and he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

title: Leviticus 14:8
text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his garments, and shave all his hair, and bathe in water, and he shall be clean; and afterwards shall he come into the camp, and shall abide outside his tent seven days.

title: Leviticus 14:9
text: And it shall come to pass on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair, his head, and his beard, and his eyebrows, even all his hair shall he shave, and he shall wash his garments, and shall bathe his flesh in water, and he is clean.

title: Leviticus 14:10
text: ¶And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one yearling ewe-lamb without blemish, and three tenth parts of fine flour mingled with oil, for an oblation, and one log of oil.

title: Leviticus 14:11
text: And the priest that cleanseth [him] shall present the man that is to be cleansed and those things before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 14:12
text: And the priest shall take one he-lamb, and present it for a trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:13
text: And he shall slaughter the he-lamb at the place where the sin-offering and the burnt-offering are slaughtered, in a holy place; for as the sin-offering, so the trespass-offering is the priest's: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 14:14
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 14:15
text: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into his, the priest's, left hand;

title: Leviticus 14:16
text: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:17
text: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 14:18
text: And the remainder of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:19
text: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterwards shall he slaughter the burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 14:20
text: And the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the oblation upon the altar; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:21
text: ¶But if he be poor, and his hand be not able to get it, then he shall take one lamb for a trespass-offering, for a wave-offering, to make atonement for him; and one tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation; and a log of oil,

title: Leviticus 14:22
text: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, as his hand may be able to get: the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 14:23
text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day of his cleansing unto the priest, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:24
text: And the priest shall take the he-lamb of the trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:25
text: And he shall slaughter the he-lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 14:26
text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into [his], the priest's, left hand,

title: Leviticus 14:27
text: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:28
text: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 14:29
text: And the remainder of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:30
text: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, of what his hand was able to get;

title: Leviticus 14:31
text: of what his hand was able to get shall the one be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering, with the oblation; and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 14:32
text: This is the law for him in whom is the sore of leprosy, whose hand cannot get what is [regularly prescribed] in his cleansing.

title: Leviticus 14:33
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 14:34
text: When ye come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a leprous plague in a house of the land of your possession,

title: Leviticus 14:35
text: then he whose house it is shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me like a plague in the house;

title: Leviticus 14:36
text: and the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean; and afterwards the priest shall go in to see the house.

title: Leviticus 14:37
text: And when he looketh on the plague, and behold, the plague is in the walls of the house, greenish or reddish hollows, and their look is deeper than the surface of the wall,

title: Leviticus 14:38
text: then the priest shall go out of the house to the entrance of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

title: Leviticus 14:39
text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and when he looketh, and behold, the plague hath spread in the walls of the house,

title: Leviticus 14:40
text: then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them out of the city, in an unclean place.

title: Leviticus 14:41
text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar that they have scraped off, out of the city in an unclean place.

title: Leviticus 14:42
text: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and they shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

title: Leviticus 14:43
text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered,

title: Leviticus 14:44
text: then the priest shall come, and when he looketh, and behold, the plague hath spread in the house, it is a corroding leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:45
text: And they shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house, and shall carry them forth out of the city to an unclean place.

title: Leviticus 14:46
text: And he that goeth into the house as long as it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 14:47
text: And he that sleepeth in the house shall wash his garments, and he that eateth in the house shall wash his garments.

title: Leviticus 14:48
text: But if the priest shall come in and look, and behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house hath been plastered, the priest shall pronounce the house clean; for the plague is healed.

title: Leviticus 14:49
text: And he shall take, to purge the house from the defilement, two birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop;

title: Leviticus 14:50
text: and he shall kill one bird in an earthen vessel over running water;

title: Leviticus 14:51
text: and he shall take the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times;

title: Leviticus 14:52
text: and he shall purge the house from the defilement with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar-wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

title: Leviticus 14:53
text: and he shall let the living bird loose out of the city into the open field; and he shall make atonement for the house, and it is clean.

title: Leviticus 14:54
text: ¶This is the law for every sore of leprosy, and for the scall,

title: Leviticus 14:55
text: and for the leprosy of garments, and of houses,

title: Leviticus 14:56
text: and for the rising, and for the scab, and for the bright spot,

title: Leviticus 14:57
text: to teach when there is uncleanness, and when it is purified: this is the law of leprosy.

title: Leviticus 15:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 15:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man have a flux from his flesh, because of his flux he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:3
text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his flux: whether his flesh run with his flux, or his flesh be closed from his flux, it is his uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 15:4
text: Every bed whereon he lieth that hath the flux shall be unclean; and every object on which he sitteth shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:5
text: And whoever toucheth his bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:6
text: And he that sitteth on any object whereon he sat that hath the flux shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:7
text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the flux shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:8
text: And if he that hath the flux spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:9
text: And what carriage soever he rideth upon that hath the flux shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:10
text: And whoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even; and he that carrieth them shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:11
text: And whomsoever he toucheth who hath the flux and hath not rinsed his hands in water--he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:12
text: And the vessel of earth that he toucheth who hath the flux shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

title: Leviticus 15:13
text: And when he that hath a flux is clean of his flux, then he shall count seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and he shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:14
text: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 15:15
text: And the priest shall offer them, one as a sin-offering, and one as a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his flux.

title: Leviticus 15:16
text: And if any man's seed of copulation pass from him, then he shall bathe his whole flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:17
text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon the seed of copulation shall be, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:18
text: And a woman with whom a man lieth with seed of copulation--they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:19
text: ¶And if a woman have a flux, and her flux in her flesh be blood, she shall be seven days in her separation, and whoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:20
text: And everything that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean; and everything that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:21
text: And whoever toucheth her bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:22
text: And whoever toucheth any object that she sat upon shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:23
text: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:24
text: And if a man lie with her at all, and the uncleanness of her separation come upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:25
text: And if a woman have her flux of blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if she have the flux beyond the time of her separation, all the days of the flux of her uncleanness shall she be as [in] the days of her separation: she is unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:26
text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her flux shall be unto her as the bed of her separation; and every object on which she sitteth shall be unclean, according to the uncleanness of her separation.

title: Leviticus 15:27
text: And whoever toucheth them shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.

title: Leviticus 15:28
text: And if she be cleansed of her flux then she shall count seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:29
text: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 15:30
text: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin-offering, and the other as a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the flux of her uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 15:31
text: And ye shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.

title: Leviticus 15:32
text: This is the law for him that hath a flux, and for the one whose seed of copulation goeth from him, and who is defiled therewith:

title: Leviticus 15:33
text: and for a woman who is sick in her separation, and for him that hath his flux; for the man and for the woman, and for him that lieth with her that is unclean.

title: Leviticus 16:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Jehovah and died;

title: Leviticus 16:2
text: and Jehovah said to Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the sanctuary inside the veil before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark, that he die not; for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.

title: Leviticus 16:3
text: In this manner shall Aaron come into the sanctuary: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:4
text: A holy linen vest shall he put on, and linen trousers shall be upon his flesh, and he shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.

title: Leviticus 16:5
text: ¶And of the assembly of the children of Israel shall he take two bucks of the goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:6
text: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.

title: Leviticus 16:7
text: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah, before the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 16:8
text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats: one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.

title: Leviticus 16:9
text: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer it [as] a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:10
text: And the goat upon which the lot fell for Azazel shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement with it, to send it away as Azazel into the wilderness.

title: Leviticus 16:11
text: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall slaughter the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself.

title: Leviticus 16:12
text: And he shall take the censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and both his hands full of fragrant incense beaten small, and bring it inside the veil.

title: Leviticus 16:13
text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat which is upon the testimony, that he die not.

title: Leviticus 16:14
text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle with his finger upon the front of the mercy-seat eastward; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood seven times with his finger.

title: Leviticus 16:15
text: ¶And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin-offering, which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat;

title: Leviticus 16:16
text: and he shall make atonement for the sanctuary, [to cleanse it] from the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and from their transgressions in all their sins; and so shall he do for the tent of meeting which dwelleth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

title: Leviticus 16:17
text: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the sanctuary until he come out; and he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and for the whole congregation of Israel.

title: Leviticus 16:18
text: And he shall go out unto the altar which is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about;

title: Leviticus 16:19
text: and he shall sprinkle upon it of the blood with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 16:20
text: ¶And when he hath ended making atonement for the sanctuary, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the living goat;

title: Leviticus 16:21
text: and Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the living goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away to the wilderness by the hand of a man standing ready;

title: Leviticus 16:22
text: that the goat may bear upon him all their iniquities to a land apart [from men]; and he shall send away the goat into the wilderness.

title: Leviticus 16:23
text: And Aaron shall go into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the sanctuary, and shall leave them there;

title: Leviticus 16:24
text: and he shall bathe his flesh with water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and go forth, and offer his burnt-offering, and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself, and for the people.

title: Leviticus 16:25
text: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.

title: Leviticus 16:26
text: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water; and afterwards he may come into the camp.

title: Leviticus 16:27
text: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the sanctuary, shall one carry forth outside the camp; and they shall burn with fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

title: Leviticus 16:28
text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water; and afterwards he may come into the camp.

title: Leviticus 16:29
text: ¶And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you. In the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, the home-born, and the stranger that sojourneth among you;

title: Leviticus 16:30
text: for on that day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you: from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 16:31
text: A sabbath of rest shall it be unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls: [it is] an everlasting statute.

title: Leviticus 16:32
text: And the priest who hath been anointed, and who hath been consecrated, to exercise the priesthood in his father's stead, shall make atonement; and he shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments.

title: Leviticus 16:33
text: And he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and for the tent of meeting, and for the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests, and for the whole people of the congregation shall he make atonement.

title: Leviticus 16:34
text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel [to cleanse them] from all their sins once a year. And he did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 17:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 17:2
text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,

title: Leviticus 17:3
text: Every one of the house of Israel that slaughtereth an ox, or sheep, or goat, in the camp, or that slaughtereth it out of the camp,

title: Leviticus 17:4
text: and doth not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah, before the tabernacle of Jehovah, blood shall be reckoned unto that man: he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people,

title: Leviticus 17:5
text: to the end that the children of Israel bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they bring them to Jehovah, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace-offerings to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 17:6
text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 17:7
text: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto demons, after whom they go a whoring. This shall be an everlasting statute unto them for their generations.

title: Leviticus 17:8
text: And thou shalt say unto them, Every one of the house of Israel, and of the strangers who sojourn among them, that offereth up a burnt-offering or sacrifice,

title: Leviticus 17:9
text: and bringeth it not to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to offer it up to Jehovah--that man shall be cut off from his peoples.

title: Leviticus 17:10
text: ¶And every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, --I will set my face against the soul that hath eaten blood, and will cut him off from among his people;

title: Leviticus 17:11
text: for the soul of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls, for it is the blood that maketh atonement for the soul.

title: Leviticus 17:12
text: Therefore have I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall the stranger who sojourneth among you eat blood.

title: Leviticus 17:13
text: And every one of the children of Israel, and of the strangers who sojourn among them, that catcheth in the hunt a beast or fowl that may be eaten, he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with earth;

title: Leviticus 17:14
text: for as to the life of all flesh, its blood is the life in it; and I have said unto the children of Israel, Of the blood of no manner of flesh shall ye eat, for the life of all flesh is its blood: whoever eateth it shall be cut off.

title: Leviticus 17:15
text: And every soul that eateth of a dead carcase, or of that which was torn, be it one home-born, or a stranger, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even: then he shall be clean.

title: Leviticus 17:16
text: And if he wash them not nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 18:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 18:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 18:3
text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do; and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their customs.

title: Leviticus 18:4
text: Mine ordinances shall ye do and my statutes shall ye observe to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 18:5
text: And ye shall observe my statutes and my judgments, by which the man that doeth them shall live: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:6
text: ¶No one shall approach to any that is his near relation, to uncover his nakedness: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:7
text: The nakedness of thy father, and the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother: thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:8
text: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:9
text: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, born at home, or born abroad--their nakedness shalt thou not uncover.

title: Leviticus 18:10
text: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter--their nakedness shalt thou not uncover; for theirs is thy nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:11
text: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father: she is thy sister: thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:12
text: The nakedness of thy father's sister shalt thou not uncover: she is thy father's near relation.

title: Leviticus 18:13
text: The nakedness of thy mother's sister shalt thou not uncover; for she is thy mother's near relation.

title: Leviticus 18:14
text: The nakedness of thy father's brother shalt thou not uncover; thou shalt not approach his wife: she is thine aunt.

title: Leviticus 18:15
text: The nakedness of thy daughter-in-law shalt thou not uncover: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:16
text: The nakedness of thy brother's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy brother's nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:17
text: The nakedness of a woman and her daughter shalt thou not uncover; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, nor her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness: they are her near relations: it is wickedness.

title: Leviticus 18:18
text: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness beside her, during her life.

title: Leviticus 18:19
text: ¶And thou shalt not approach a woman in the separation of her uncleanness to uncover her nakedness.

title: Leviticus 18:20
text: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to become unclean with her.

title: Leviticus 18:21
text: And thou shalt not give of thy seed to let them pass through [the fire] to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 18:22
text: And thou shalt not lie with mankind as one lieth with a woman: it is an abomination.

title: Leviticus 18:23
text: And thou shalt lie with no beast to become unclean therewith; and a woman shall not stand before a beast to lie down with it: it is confusion.

title: Leviticus 18:24
text: Make not yourselves unclean in any of these things; for in all these have the nations which I am casting out before you made themselves unclean.

title: Leviticus 18:25
text: And the land hath become unclean; and I visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out its inhabitants.

title: Leviticus 18:26
text: But *ye* shall observe my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of all these abominations: the home-born, and the stranger that sojourneth among you;

title: Leviticus 18:27
text: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, who were before you, and the land hath been made unclean);

title: Leviticus 18:28
text: that the land vomit you not out, when ye make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

title: Leviticus 18:29
text: For whoever committeth any of these abominations, ...the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 18:30
text: And ye shall observe my charge, that ye commit not [any] of the abominable customs which were committed before you; and ye shall not make yourselves unclean therein: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 19:2
text: Speak unto all the assembly of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Holy shall ye be, for I Jehovah your God am holy.

title: Leviticus 19:3
text: Ye shall reverence every man his mother, and his father, and my sabbaths shall ye keep: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:4
text: Ye shall not turn unto idols, and ye shall not make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:5
text: And if ye sacrifice a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.

title: Leviticus 19:6
text: On the day when ye sacrifice it shall it be eaten, and on the morrow; and that which remaineth until the third day shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 19:7
text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an unclean thing: it shall not be accepted.

title: Leviticus 19:8
text: And he that eateth it shall bear his iniquity; for he hath profaned the hallowed thing of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his peoples.

title: Leviticus 19:9
text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, and the gleaning of thy harvest thou shalt not gather.

title: Leviticus 19:10
text: And thy vineyard shalt thou not glean, neither shalt thou gather what hath been left of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and the stranger: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:11
text: ¶Ye shall not steal, and ye shall not deal falsely, and ye shall not lie one to another.

title: Leviticus 19:12
text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:13
text: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbour, neither rob him. The wages of the hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

title: Leviticus 19:14
text: Thou shalt not revile a deaf person, and thou shalt not put a stumbling-block before a blind one; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:15
text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment; thou shalt not respect the person of the lowly, nor honour the person of the great; in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

title: Leviticus 19:16
text: Thou shalt not go about as a talebearer among thy people; thou shalt not stand up against the life of thy neighbour: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:17
text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart; thou shalt earnestly rebuke thy neighbour, lest thou bear sin on account of him.

title: Leviticus 19:18
text: Thou shalt not avenge thyself, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:19
text: ¶My statutes shall ye observe. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with another sort; thou shalt not sow thy field with seed of two sorts; and a garment woven of two materials shall not come upon thee.

title: Leviticus 19:20
text: And if a man lie with a woman for copulation, and she is a bondwoman betrothed to a husband, but not at all ransomed, nor hath freedom been given to her, there shall be a chastisement: they shall not be put to death, for she was not free.

title: Leviticus 19:21
text: And he shall bring his trespass-offering to Jehovah, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram for a trespass-offering.

title: Leviticus 19:22
text: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath done; and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 19:23
text: And when ye come into the land and plant all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count its fruit as uncircumcised, three years shall it be uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of;

title: Leviticus 19:24
text: and in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy for praise to Jehovah;

title: Leviticus 19:25
text: and in the fifth year shall ye eat the fruit thereof, that it may increase unto you the produce thereof: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:26
text: Ye shall eat nothing with the blood. --Ye shall not practise enchantment, nor use auguries.

title: Leviticus 19:27
text: --Ye shall not shave the corners of your head round, neither shalt thou mutilate the corners of thy beard.

title: Leviticus 19:28
text: And cuttings for a dead person shall ye not make in your flesh, nor put any tattoo writing upon you: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:29
text: --Do not profane thy daughter, to give her up to whoredom; lest the land practise whoredom, and the land become full of infamy.

title: Leviticus 19:30
text: ¶--My sabbaths shall ye keep, and my sanctuary shall ye reverence: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:31
text: --Turn not unto necromancers and unto soothsayers; seek not after them to make yourselves unclean: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:32
text: Before the hoary head thou shalt rise up, and shalt honour the face of an old man; and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 19:33
text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not molest him.

title: Leviticus 19:34
text: As one born among you shall the stranger who sojourneth with you be unto you; and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 19:35
text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measure of length, in weight, and in measure of capacity:

title: Leviticus 19:36
text: just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

title: Leviticus 19:37
text: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 20:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 20:2
text: Thou shalt say also to the children of Israel, Every one of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech, shall certainly be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

title: Leviticus 20:3
text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, so as to make my sanctuary unclean, and to profane my holy name.

title: Leviticus 20:4
text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, that they kill him not,

title: Leviticus 20:5
text: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:6
text: --And the soul that turneth unto necromancers and unto soothsayers, to go a whoring after them, I will set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 20:7
text: Hallow yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 20:8
text: And ye shall observe my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who hallow you.

title: Leviticus 20:9
text: Whatever man revileth his father and his mother shall certainly be put to death: he hath reviled his father and his mother; his blood is upon him.

title: Leviticus 20:10
text: ¶And a man that committeth adultery with a man's wife, who committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, --the adulterer and the adulteress shall certainly be put to death.

title: Leviticus 20:11
text: And a man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:12
text: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall certainly be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood is upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:13
text: And if a man lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:14
text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is infamy: they shall burn him and them with fire, that there be no infamy among you.

title: Leviticus 20:15
text: And if a man lie with a beast for copulation, he shall certainly be put to death; and ye shall kill the beast.

title: Leviticus 20:16
text: And if a woman approach unto any beast to gender therewith, thou shalt kill the woman and the beast: they shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.

title: Leviticus 20:17
text: And if a man take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness, that is a disgrace; and they shall be cut off before the eyes of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 20:18
text: And if a man shall lie with a woman in her infirmity, and uncover her nakedness, her flux doth he lay bare, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood; and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:19
text: And the nakedness of thy mother's sister, and of thy father's sister shalt thou not uncover; for he hath laid naked his near relation: they shall bear their iniquity.

title: Leviticus 20:20
text: And if a man lie with his aunt, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: their sin shall they bear: they shall die childless.

title: Leviticus 20:21
text: And if a man take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness: they shall be childless.

title: Leviticus 20:22
text: ¶And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them, that the land whither I bring you to dwell therein vomit you not out.

title: Leviticus 20:23
text: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for all these things have they done, and they became an abomination to me.

title: Leviticus 20:24
text: And I have said unto you, Ye shall possess their land, and I will give it unto you for a possession; a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who have separated you from the peoples.

title: Leviticus 20:25
text: And ye shall make a separation between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean, and ye shall not make yourselves an abomination by beast, or by fowl, or by anything that creepeth on the ground which I have separated for you, declaring [it] as unclean.

title: Leviticus 20:26
text: And ye shall be holy unto me; for I Jehovah am holy, and have separated you from the peoples to be mine.

title: Leviticus 20:27
text: And if there be a man or a woman in whom is a spirit of Python or of divination, they shall certainly be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood is upon them.

title: Leviticus 21:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none make himself unclean for a dead person among his peoples,

title: Leviticus 21:2
text: except for his immediate relation, who is near unto him--for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother;

title: Leviticus 21:3
text: and for his sister, a virgin, that is near unto him, who hath had no husband, for her may he make himself unclean.

title: Leviticus 21:4
text: He shall not make himself unclean [who is] a chief among his peoples, to profane himself.

title: Leviticus 21:5
text: They shall not make any baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

title: Leviticus 21:6
text: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they present Jehovah's offerings by fire, the bread of their God; therefore shall they be holy.

title: Leviticus 21:7
text: They shall not take as wife a whore, or a dishonoured woman; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband; for he is holy unto his God.

title: Leviticus 21:8
text: And thou shalt hallow him; for the bread of thy God doth he present: he shall be holy unto thee; for I, Jehovah, who hallow you am holy.

title: Leviticus 21:9
text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 21:10
text: ¶And the high priest among his brethren, on whose head the anointing oil was poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his garments.

title: Leviticus 21:11
text: Neither shall he come near any person dead, nor make himself unclean for his father and for his mother;

title: Leviticus 21:12
text: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 21:13
text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

title: Leviticus 21:14
text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a dishonoured one, a harlot, these shall he not take; but he shall take as wife a virgin from among his peoples.

title: Leviticus 21:15
text: And he shall not profane his seed among his peoples; for I am Jehovah who do hallow him.

title: Leviticus 21:16
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 21:17
text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Any of thy seed throughout their generations that hath any defect, shall not approach to present the bread of his God;

title: Leviticus 21:18
text: for whatever man hath a defect, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or one limb longer than the other,

title: Leviticus 21:19
text: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,

title: Leviticus 21:20
text: or hump-backed, or withered, or that hath a spot in his eye, or hath the itch, or scabs, or his testicles broken.

title: Leviticus 21:21
text: No man of the seed of Aaron the priest that hath defect shall come near to present Jehovah's offerings by fire: he hath a defect; he shall not come near to present the bread of his God.

title: Leviticus 21:22
text: The bread of his God, of the most holy and of the holy, shall he eat;

title: Leviticus 21:23
text: only he shall not come in unto the veil, nor shall he draw near unto the altar; for he hath a defect: that he profane not my sanctuaries; for I am Jehovah who do hallow them.

title: Leviticus 21:24
text: And Moses told it to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 22:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:2
text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in the things that they hallow unto me: I am Jehovah.
